Texas has the second-largest population of young voters in the nation, and they’re helping make Texas one of the most competitive battleground states in America.
**That’s why we’re traveling across the great state of Texas to meet young voters where they are, visiting every major college campus in all of Texas’s 254 counties.[Pitch in here to fuel our efforts →](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=pbp-em-20240904.RV_7k-&refcode=ema20240904-239797&t=1&akid=239797%2E444211%2EtO82sb)**

[](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=pbp-em-20240904.RV_7k-&refcode=ema20240904-239797&t=2&akid=239797%2E444211%2EtO82sb)

This is so much more than a Texas problem, Team. So many of these bills -- like the other underhanded tactics that opponents of voting rights use -- were written by think tanks as generic legislation and when these dark money groups have success with something in one state they export it for use in other states.
RUSH $25 or more right now to fight back against these voter purges and the other sketchy practices the vote suppressors use to protect their power and tip the playing field in our elections >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=090424_3&amount=25]
Voter Action Project Logo [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-weekly?refcode=090424_3&amount=25]
Newsweek: Greg Abbott Removes 1 Million People From Texas Voter Rolls [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=090424_3&amount=25]
Team: Texas Gov. Greg Abbott trumpeted Texas' purging of more than 1,000,000 voters under their 2021 voter suppression law. “ That removal process has been, and will continue to be, ongoing ,” Abbot’s office said.
Partisan election officials conduct these mass registered voter removals, as required by recent Texas voter suppression laws -- laws that include limits on mail-in ballots, drop boxes, laws targeting only Harris County (home to Houston), and so much more.
T hese purges disenfranchise legitimate registered voters who haven’t moved or had other changes to their status as voters . It's legalized voter suppression at its worst.
Abbott's office continues to malign voters without proof. " Illegal voting in Texas will never be tolerated. We will continue to actively safeguard Texans' sacred right to vote while also aggressively protecting our elections from illegal voting ." They said this even after spending millions of taxpayer dollars looking for voter fraud in the 2020 election and finding nothing.
Voter suppression is real, Team, not just in Texas but across the country. Push back on these cynical purges with $25 or whatever you can today to protect the right to vote nationwide >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=090424_3&amount=25]

name: AOC
subject: If we actually want to change things
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
body:
#
Someone recently asked me, ‘Why do leftists attack you?’
There are likely a few reasons — probably more than I can list — but one thought:
Repair is hard! It is _so easy_ in the short term to dispose of people and toss them in the trash the moment you don’t like something.
We are all human. It’s easier to be pissed off on the internet than actually build community and power around a just cause.
**But if we actually want to change things, we need to get real about building power.** And our movement can’t build power by recreating the punitive, angry, expulsion-focused cultures that we seek to replace. It will require new skills from us.
**It’s enough to be right: we need to be right and _win._**
I believe that we have a moral obligation to be _effective_ , in addition to having a just stance — otherwise who are we doing this for? We must accomplish, build, strengthen, repair, grow, win, survive, and that is hard, hard, hard, work.
And we are going to disagree on the way. If we can’t handle that in good faith, we will stay small.
**And we owe the people we are fighting for way more than that.**
In solidarity,
Alexandria

Democrats, Since 1992, the California Democratic Party has been dedicated to defending voter rights and ensuring that every vote is counted through our Voter Protection Program. As we prepare for this election season, CADEM is looking for dedicated volunteers to join our team as Voter Protection Hotline Operators and/or serve as Volunteer Attorneys. We need your help to reach more voters and inform them about how the CADEM Voter Protection Team will support every individual in the voting process. **What are Voter Protection Team Hotline Operators?** If any California voters have questions or encounter issues related to elections and voting, our CADEM Voter Protection Hotline Operators will take calls from voters who call 1-877-321-8683(VOTE) until the polls close on Election Day! By recruiting and training volunteer operators who will be ready for the job, CADEM Voter Protection team will ramp up its effort from Thursday, October 17, 2024, to the Election, Tuesday, November 5, 2024, until the polls close. CADEM Voter Protection Hotline Operators will answer calls from all voters who call into the hotline to give guidance and assist voters, and will:
* Assist any voter, regardless of the candidate or the political party they support. We are a safe place for voters to get assistance or report any voting-related issue or incident;
* Not engage in any act of voter suppression or dissuade any voter from voting;
* Not challenge voters or ballots in the Democratic process;
* Assist in helping voters find information on polling locations, Early Votes Centers, how to track their ballots, and by providing voters with information about the candidates listed on their ballots. No prior experience is necessary to be a CADEM Voter Protection Volunteer Operator.

Prior to all call center shifts, all volunteer operators will receive technology training for the remote call center system. Our Voter Protection Hotline Operators will be trained to:
* Assist voters with voting-related questions regarding the Election:
* Review and provide ballot measure information
* Provide access to the CADEM Endorsement Look-Up Tool for endorsements of the California Democratic Party
* Report and troubleshoot election-related issues or incidents such as:
* Lack of Bilingual assistance
* Asking for Identification from voters who are not flagged on the roster as needing to show ID
* Asking for proof of residency or citizenship
* Refusing to issue Provisional Ballots
* Polling Place/Vote Center workers allowing electioneering within 100 feet
* Refusing to allow assistance to those in need
* Provide voter protection resources and training to Democratic campaigns, county central committees, Clubs/Organizations, activists, and allied/partnered organizations.

**What are Voter Protection Team Volunteer Attorneys?** Our mission is to recruit hundreds of trained volunteer attorneys who will be dispatched around the state to handle questions and field potential voter disenfranchisement issues. Since 1992, CADEM has worked tirelessly to protect the rights of all voters across the state. We believe that every vote counts and should be counted! In addition, our volunteer-powered Voter Protection Hotline simultaneously serves as a clearinghouse for all election issues. Now more than ever, we NEED your help! California is also leading the electoral path to wrestle back control of the U.S. House of Representatives. Getting to 218 Democratic seats in the House means winning 7 competitive seats in California in some of the most hotly contested races in the country, from Orange County to the Inland Empire to the Central Valley. While Trump and MAGA Republicans have an ambitious laundry list of unconstitutional and authoritarian “tasks” with the goal of undoing all of our progress, CADEM is taking a stand and ramping up efforts to counteract voter disenfranchisement in making sure voting is accessible to ALL Californians. **[SIGN UP AND JOIN THE CADEM VOTER PROTECTION TEAM NOW!](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/92181668/496302618/2104872848?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzUvMS84MDk5NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlZjFkYWRiZS0yZTZiLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=WkulWHl0j9YvVb2t9YgeZj4KkVPFJvogErG_Ru4zFH8=&emci=941e580a-f46a-ef11-991a-6045bdd9e096&emdi=ef1dadbe-2e6b-ef11-991a-6045bdd9e096&ceid=560478)** Thank you in advance, Team CADEM

As we prepare for this election season, CADEM is looking for dedicated volunteers to join our team as Voter Protection Hotline Operators and/or serve as Volunteer Attorneys. We need your help to reach more voters and inform them about how the CADEM Voter Protection Team will support every individual in the voting process. What are Voter Protection Team Hotline Operators? If any California voters have questions or encounter issues related to elections and voting, our CADEM Voter Protection Hotline Operators will take calls from voters who call 1-877-321-8683(VOTE) until the polls close on Election Day! By recruiting and training volunteer operators who will be ready for the job, CADEM Voter Protection team will ramp up its effort from Thursday, October 17, 2024, to the Election, Tuesday, November 5, 2024, until the polls close. CADEM Voter Protection Hotline Operators will answer calls from all voters who call into the hotline to give guidance and assist voters, and will: Assist any voter, regardless of the candidate or the political party they support. We are a safe place for voters to get assistance or report any voting-related issue or incident; Not engage in any act of voter suppression or dissuade any voter from voting; Not challenge voters or ballots in the Democratic process; Assist in helping voters find information on polling locations, Early Votes Centers, how to track their ballots, and by providing voters with information about the candidates listed on their ballots. No prior experience is necessary to be a CADEM Voter Protection Volunteer Operator. Prior to all call center shifts, all volunteer operators will receive technology training for the remote call center system. Our Voter Protection Hotline Operators will be trained to: Assist voters with voting-related questions regarding the Election: Review and provide ballot measure information Provide access to the CADEM Endorsement Look-Up Tool for endorsements of the California Democratic Party Report and troubleshoot election-related issues or incidents such as: Lack of Bilingual assistance Asking for Identification from voters who are not flagged on the roster as needing to show ID Asking for proof of residency or citizenship Refusing to issue Provisional Ballots Polling Place/Vote Center workers allowing electioneering within 100 feet Refusing to allow assistance to those in need Provide voter protection resources and training to Democratic campaigns, county central committees, Clubs/Organizations, activists, and allied/partnered organizations. What are Voter Protection Team Volunteer Attorneys? Our mission is to recruit hundreds of trained volunteer attorneys who will be dispatched around the state to handle questions and field potential voter disenfranchisement issues. Since 1992, CADEM has worked tirelessly to protect the rights of all voters across the state. We believe that every vote counts and should be counted! In addition, our volunteer-powered Voter Protection Hotline simultaneously serves as a clearinghouse for all election issues. Now more than ever, we NEED your help! California is also leading the electoral path to wrestle back control of the U.S. House of Representatives. Getting to 218 Democratic seats in the House means winning 7 competitive seats in California in some of the most hotly contested races in the country, from Orange County to the Inland Empire to the Central Valley. While Trump and MAGA Republicans have an ambitious laundry list of unconstitutional and authoritarian “tasks” with the goal of undoing all of our progress, CADEM is taking a stand and ramping up efforts to counteract voter disenfranchisement in making sure voting is accessible to ALL Californians. name: Texas Organizing Project
subject: Helping set a Texas man free and fighting for structural change / Ayudando a liberar a un hombre de Texas y luchando por un cambio estructural
body:
Lea el boletín en español abajo [#Español]
Community steps up to help exonerate a Texas man behind bars for 34 years
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Ben%20Spencer%20exonerated%20Dallas.png]
Wrongfully imprisoned for three decades, Ben Spencer of Dallas is now an exonerated and free man. Read all about it here. [https://www.keranews.org/news/2024-08-29/delayed-justice-exoneration-for-benjamin-spencer-convicted-of-killing-a-man-in-1987]
This past Thursday, in the courtroom of state District Judge Lela Mays, Ben was surrounded by family, friends, and community members as the exoneration ceremony made it official.
This emotional day was the culmination of years of grit and determination from Ben's loving mother -- Ms. Lucille Spencer, the rest of his family, Ben’s legal team, community allies, the office of Dallas County District Attorney John Creuzot, and TOP members. Relentless community organizing and advocacy made Ben's release and exoneration possible.
Recognizing the heightened urgency because of the spread of COVID in prisons and jails in 2020 and 2021, TOP members kicked our efforts to get Ben Spencer released into overdrive, ramping up pressure with petitions, rallies, phone-a-thons, and a letter-writing campaign to make sure Ben got his shot at freedom.
In the 2018 general election race, TOP members in Dallas County endorsed and got out the vote for D.A. Creuzot based on his vision for reforming our local justice system, with one of the criteria being that he would advocate for Ben Spencer’s release. We were glad to see him deliver on this campaign promise, and years later, Ben Spencer is now exonerated.
SURVEY: Organizing for a more humane probation system in Bexar County
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/MAC%20Bexar%20County%20TOP%20group%20shot.jpg]
Texas taxpayers are spending huge sums on an inefficient probation system each and every year. We need to reconsider the system to make it safe and effective, not costly and ineffective. More people are on probation in Texas than are serving time in every county jail -- that's 254 counties put together and then multiplied by three. Mounting a statewide intervention to disrupt how probation works in Texas is yet another way we chip away at mass incarceration in our state.
TAKE THIS SURVEY if you're a Bexar County resident, to share with us your thoughts on the county's probation system. [https://secure.everyaction.com/Mshuu6fauEG23vOgLeWFfg2]
For more information about TOP’s Right2Justice work in Bexar County, contact Laquita Garcia at lgarcia@organizetexas.org [lgarcia@organizetexas.org] .
Celebrating movement power this Labor Day
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Black%20fist%20air.jpeg]
The following statement is from Tempestt McHenry, Staff Union Co-President of TOP located in Dallas County, on the organization’s observance of Labor Day this year:
“Make no mistake, it's the ever-growing vibrancy of our labor movement that helps hold our country's democracy together while driving its economic prosperity.
“This resurgence of organized labor we're seeing is putting unprecedented pressure on wealthy mega-corporations and the political establishment to challenge racial capitalism and address equity and justice in ways they have not prior. It's laying the groundwork for better wages, labor rights, worker protections, and a social safety net — which historically have provided many in our nation, particularly Black and Latino Americans, with an added sense of economic stability and security for generations.
"Now in TOP's third year as a unionized workplace, we as an organization recognize unapologetically that workers’ rights are human rights. This assertion has and will continue to connect right to the soul of our year-round community organizing and electoral engagement work.”
Shyda Blake, TOP Staff Union Co-President based in Harris County, added:
“As Dr. Martin Luther King Jr. famously stated, "All labor that uplifts humanity has dignity and importance and should be undertaken with painstaking excellence."
“At a volatile political time, when implementation of Donald Trump's Project 2025 is not a distant possibility, we as workers will not have our voices silenced while our fundamental rights are stripped away.
“The millions of Black and Latino Texas workers who proudly reside in this state have the opportunity to flex the collective power required to create a future where ALL Texans can live free and thrive — regardless of our race, faith, gender, or preferred language. THAT is a future we are fighting for, because as proud workers, we are stronger together."
TOP Tips: Take action against book bans through EveryLibrary
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/EveryLibrary.png]
Right-wing extremists are exerting their influence to ban more and more books in libraries across our state and nation. They're targeted attacks, and we have a way to fight back. Check out EveryLibrary to see how you can plug in to efforts to protect our school and community libraries for years to come. [https://www.everylibrary.org/]
Español
La comunidad se une para ayudar a exonerar a un hombre de Texas que estuvo tras las rejas durante 34 años
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Ben%20Spencer%20exonerated%20Dallas.png]
Ben Spencer, de Dallas, que estuvo encarcelado injustamente durante tres décadas, ahora es un hombre exonerado y libre. Lea todo sobre esto aquí. [https://www.keranews.org/news/2024-08-29/delayed-justice-exoneration-for-benjamin-spencer-convicted-of-killing-a-man-in-1987]
El jueves pasado, en la sala del tribunal de la jueza de distrito estatal Lela Mays, Ben estuvo rodeado de familiares, amigos y miembros de la comunidad cuando se hizo oficial la ceremonia de exoneración.
Este día emocional fue la culminación de años de coraje y determinación por parte de la amorosa madre de Ben, la Sra. Lucille Spencer, el resto de su familia, el equipo legal de Ben, aliados comunitarios, la oficina del Fiscal del Distrito del Condado de Dallas, John Creuzot, y los miembros de TOP. La organización comunitaria y la defensa incansable hicieron posible la liberación y exoneración de Ben.
Al reconocer la mayor urgencia debido a la propagación de COVID en prisiones y cárceles en 2020 y 2021, los miembros de TOP impulsaron nuestros esfuerzos para lograr la liberación de Ben Spencer, aumentando la presión con peticiones, manifestaciones, maratones telefónicas y una campaña de redacción de cartas para asegurarnos de que Ben tuviera su oportunidad de ser libre.
Reconociendo la urgencia aumentada debido a la propagación de COVID en las prisiones y cárceles en 2020 y 2021, los miembros de TOP intensificaron nuestros esfuerzos para lograr la liberación de Ben Spencer, aumentando la presión con peticiones, manifestaciones, maratones de llamadas telefónicas y una campaña de cartas para asegurar que Ben tuviera su oportunidad de obtener su libertad. Nos alegró verlo cumplir esta promesa de campaña y, años después, Ben Spencer ahora está exonerado.
ENCUESTA: Organizando por un sistema de libertad condicional más humano en el condado de Bexar
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/MAC%20Bexar%20County%20TOP%20group%20shot.jpg]
Los contribuyentes de Texas están gastando enormes sumas de dinero en un sistema de libertad condicional ineficiente cada año. Necesitamos reconsiderar el sistema para hacerlo seguro y efectivo, no costoso e ineficaz. Hay más personas en libertad condicional en Texas que cumpliendo condena en todas las cárceles del condado, lo que equivale a los 254 condados juntos y luego multiplicado por tres. Montar una intervención a nivel estatal para interrumpir el funcionamiento de la libertad condicional en Texas es otra forma de reducir la encarcelación masiva en nuestro estado.
RESPONDA ESTA ENCUESTA si es residente del condado de Bexar para compartir con nosotros sus opiniones sobre el sistema de libertad condicional del condado. [https://secure.everyaction.com/Mshuu6fauEG23vOgLeWFfg2]
Para obtener más información sobre el trabajo Right2Justice de TOP en el condado de Bexar, comuníquese con Laquita García en lgarcia@organizetexas.org [lgarcia@organizetexas.org] .
Celebrando el poder del movimiento este Día del Trabajo
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Black%20fist%20air.jpeg]
La siguiente declaración es de Tempestt McHenry, Copresidenta del Sindicato de trabajadores de TOP en el Condado de Dallas, sobre la observancia del Día del Trabajo este año por parte de la organización:
“No se equivoquen, es la vitalidad cada vez mayor de nuestro movimiento laboral lo que ayuda a mantener unida la democracia de nuestro país al mismo tiempo que impulsa su prosperidad económica.”
“Este resurgimiento del movimiento sindical que estamos viendo está ejerciendo una presión sin precedentes sobre las megacorporaciones ricas y el establecimiento político para desafiar el capitalismo racial y abordar la equidad y la justicia de maneras que no lo habían hecho antes. Está sentando las bases para mejores salarios, derechos laborales, protecciones para los trabajadores y una red de seguridad social, que históricamente han brindado a muchos en nuestra nación, particularmente a los estadounidenses negros y latinos, una mayor sensación de estabilidad y seguridad económica durante generaciones.”
"Ahora, en el tercer año de TOP como lugar de trabajo sindicalizado, nosotros como organización reconocemos sin pedir disculpas que los derechos de los trabajadores son derechos humanos. Esta afirmación ha estado y seguirá estando conectada directamente con el alma de nuestro trabajo de organización comunitaria y participación electoral durante todo el año."
Shyda Blake, copresidenta del sindicato de trabajadores de TOP en el condado de Harris, agregó:
“Como dijo el Dr. Martin Luther King Jr., "Todo trabajo que eleva a la humanidad tiene dignidad e importancia y debe llevarse a cabo con una excelencia minuciosa."
“En un momento político volátil, cuando la implementación del Proyecto 2025 de Donald Trump no es una posibilidad lejana, nosotros como trabajadores no permitiremos que se silencien nuestras voces mientras se nos quitan nuestros derechos fundamentales.
“Los millones de trabajadores negros y latinos de Texas que residen con orgullo en este estado tienen la oportunidad de ejercer el poder colectivo necesario para crear un futuro en el que TODOS los tejanos puedan vivir libres y prosperar, independientemente de nuestra raza, fe, género o idioma preferido. ESE es un futuro por el que luchamos, porque como trabajadores orgullosos, somos más fuertes juntos.”
Consejos de TOP: Tome medidas contra las prohibiciones de libros a través de EveryLibrary
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/EveryLibrary.png]
Los extremistas de derecha están ejerciendo su influencia para prohibir cada vez más libros en las bibliotecas de nuestro estado y de la nación. Son ataques dirigidos y tenemos una forma de contraatacar. Visite EveryLibrary para ver cómo puede sumarse a los esfuerzos para proteger nuestras bibliotecas escolares y comunitarias en los próximos años. [https://www.everylibrary.org/]

La organización comunitaria y la defensa incansable hicieron posible la liberación y exoneración de Ben. Al reconocer la mayor urgencia debido a la propagación de COVID en prisiones y cárceles en 2020 y 2021, los miembros de TOP impulsaron nuestros esfuerzos para lograr la liberación de Ben Spencer, aumentando la presión con peticiones, manifestaciones, maratones telefónicas y una campaña de redacción de cartas para asegurarnos de que Ben tuviera su oportunidad de ser libre. Reconociendo la urgencia aumentada debido a la propagación de COVID en las prisiones y cárceles en 2020 y 2021, los miembros de TOP intensificaron nuestros esfuerzos para lograr la liberación de Ben Spencer, aumentando la presión con peticiones, manifestaciones, maratones de llamadas telefónicas y una campaña de cartas para asegurar que Ben tuviera su oportunidad de obtener su libertad. Nos alegró verlo cumplir esta promesa de campaña y, años después, Ben Spencer ahora está exonerado. ENCUESTA: Organizando por un sistema de libertad condicional más humano en el condado de Bexar [] Los contribuyentes de Texas están gastando enormes sumas de dinero en un sistema de libertad condicional ineficiente cada año. Necesitamos reconsiderar el sistema para hacerlo seguro y efectivo, no costoso e ineficaz. Hay más personas en libertad condicional en Texas que cumpliendo condena en todas las cárceles del condado, lo que equivale a los 254 condados juntos y luego multiplicado por tres. Montar una intervención a nivel estatal para interrumpir el funcionamiento de la libertad condicional en Texas es otra forma de reducir la encarcelación masiva en nuestro estado. RESPONDA ESTA ENCUESTA si es residente del condado de Bexar para compartir con nosotros sus opiniones sobre el sistema de libertad condicional del condado. [] Para obtener más información sobre el trabajo Right2Justice de TOP en el condado de Bexar, comuníquese con Laquita García en lgarcia@organizetexas.org [lgarcia@organizetexas.org] . Celebrando el poder del movimiento este Día del Trabajo [] La siguiente declaración es de Tempestt McHenry, Copresidenta del Sindicato de trabajadores de TOP en el Condado de Dallas, sobre la observancia del Día del Trabajo este año por parte de la organización: “No se equivoquen, es la vitalidad cada vez mayor de nuestro movimiento laboral lo que ayuda a mantener unida la democracia de nuestro país al mismo tiempo que impulsa su prosperidad económica.” “Este resurgimiento del movimiento sindical que estamos viendo está ejerciendo una presión sin precedentes sobre las megacorporaciones ricas y el establecimiento político para desafiar el capitalismo racial y abordar la equidad y la justicia de maneras que no lo habían hecho antes. Está sentando las bases para mejores salarios, derechos laborales, protecciones para los trabajadores y una red de seguridad social, que históricamente han brindado a muchos en nuestra nación, particularmente a los estadounidenses negros y latinos, una mayor sensación de estabilidad y seguridad económica durante generaciones.” "Ahora, en el tercer año de TOP como lugar de trabajo sindicalizado, nosotros como organización reconocemos sin pedir disculpas que los derechos de los trabajadores son derechos humanos. Esta afirmación ha estado y seguirá estando conectada directamente con el alma de nuestro trabajo de organización comunitaria y participación electoral durante todo el año." Shyda Blake, copresidenta del sindicato de trabajadores de TOP en el condado de Harris, agregó: “Como dijo el Dr. Martin Luther King Jr., "Todo trabajo que eleva a la humanidad tiene dignidad e importancia y debe llevarse a cabo con una excelencia minuciosa." “En un momento político volátil, cuando la implementación del Proyecto 2025 de Donald Trump no es una posibilidad lejana, nosotros como trabajadores no permitiremos que se silencien nuestras voces mientras se nos quitan nuestros derechos fundamentales. “Los millones de trabajadores negros y latinos de Texas que residen con orgullo en este estado tienen la oportunidad de ejercer el poder colectivo necesario para crear un futuro en el que TODOS los tejanos puedan vivir libres y prosperar, independientemente de nuestra raza, fe, género o idioma preferido. ESE es un futuro por el que luchamos, porque como trabajadores orgullosos, somos más fuertes juntos.” Consejos de TOP: Tome medidas contra las prohibiciones de libros a través de EveryLibrary [] Los extremistas de derecha están ejerciendo su influencia para prohibir cada vez más libros en las bibliotecas de nuestro estado y de la nación. Son ataques dirigidos y tenemos una forma de contraatacar. name: Kristan Hawkins, Students for Life Action
subject: behind the scenes last week with Trump
body:
I knew something was wrong when my phone started blowing up late last Thursday afternoon...
Dear Pro-Life Friend,

I knew something was wrong when my phone started blowing up late last Thursday afternoon with one frantic call and text after another from _Students for Life Action’s_ best canvassers.

They were seething mad – as I’m sure many pro-lifers across the country were after NBC news reported that President Trump “seemed” to indicate he was supporting Florida’s _Amendment 4_ pro-abortion, ballot referendum.

If you didn’t hear about President Trump’s comments, when asked how he would vote on _Amendment 4,_ he told NBC:

_“I think six weeks is too short. There has to be more time. I’ve told them that I want more weeks. I’m going to be voting that we leave more than six weeks [for legal abortion].”_
The full video NBC posted on X is **[here](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-gtkkluk-duchtdja-y/),** if you’d like to see it.

Not long after that news report, the Trump campaign stated that NBC’s reporting was wrong and that former Donald Trump hadn’t yet decided how he would vote on _Amendment 4_.

Then, late Friday afternoon, President Trump announced he would be voting against Florida’s _Amendment 4,_ stating:

_“So, I think six weeks, you need more time than six weeks. I’ve disagreed with that right from the early primaries when I heard about it, I disagreed with it._
_“At the same time, the Democrats are radical, because the nine months is just a ridiculous situation where you can do an abortion in the ninth month. ... So I’ll be voting no for that reason.”_
First off, you and I have a shot of defeating Florida’s _Amendment 4_ this year as Governor Ron DeSantis is – to date – the only GOP Governor bothering to campaign HARD, _including fundraising money,_ against these state pro-abortion referendums.

**So, despite his comments about Florida’s _Heartbeat Abortion Prevention Law (which are horribly wrong and misguided),_ President Trump’s decision to join with Governor DeSantis in opposition to _Amendment 4_ will be an important boost to our efforts in the Sunshine State.**

And it’s a boost we need in other ballot referendum states as well.

**[That’s why I’m counting on you to sign your petition urging former President Trump to come out against ALL of the ballot referendums the Abortion Lobby is pushing in 2024](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-gtkkluk-duchtdja-j/).**

But please act quickly.

Early voting in many states begins in just three weeks!

The good news is, **your action does make a difference._You just saw proof_!**

In fact, last week, after the initial news reports regarding President Trump’s comments on Florida’s _Amendment 4, The Washington Post_ reported:

_“On Thursday night, hours after Trump’s comments on IVF and the Florida ban, a close Trump adviser took a call with six top female antiabortion leaders to hear their grievances and explain the campaign’s strategy on the issue, according to Kristan Hawkins, president of Students for Life, one of the country’s largest antiabortion groups, who was on the call . . ._
_“Antiabortion leaders in interviews with The Washington Post strongly urged Trump to stop criticizing antiabortion wins, like Florida’s six-week ban, warning that he might lose their support.”_
**While the media is “blaming” me, in part, for President Trump’s decision to come out against _Amendment 4_ in Florida, _it’s really good people like you that deserve a pat on the back_.**

The reason the Trump campaign wanted my thoughts on the President’s comments has nothing to do with me personally and everything to do with you and the grassroots muscle you provide for _Students for Life Action._

I am just one person.

You and good people like you across the country turn us into a movement.

And movements have to be reckoned with by politicians – _no matter how big of a deal that politician is._

That’s the TRUTH pro-abortion media elites don’t want you to understand.

I actually believe the biggest threat we face right now isn’t any one politician – or even _Planned Parenthood._

_It’s ourselves – _our mindsets_ – which will lead to decreased recruitment, training, and fewer live-saving victories_.

The media’s goal is to confuse voters about the state of American abortion laws and depress the Pro-Life Movement.

This is why the media continues to write the stories of pro-lifers, understandably, upset and angered by the commentary coming from the Trump-Vance campaign _(which could and should be A LOT better)._

_I’m not here to make apologies for the Campaign and their political miscalculations, which are dividing our movement and could very well lead to their defeat_.

But I can tell you with 100% certainty what the pro-abortion media and the Harris-Walz campaign want, they want us frustrated, angry, and disengaged.

Don’t give in, Pro-Life Friend.

Don’t fall for it.

Instead, fight harder than ever and make sure President Trump hears from you.

**[Please help me convince President Trump take the next step and announce his opposition to ALL pro-abortion ballot referendums this year by signing your petition today](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-gtkkluk-duchtdja-t/).**

This should be an easy decision for the former President as the other pro-abortion ballot measures are all AT LEAST as bad as the one we are fighting against in Florida, which would:

• Overturn the _Heartbeat Abortion Prevention Law,_ which _Students for Life Action_ fought tooth and nail to ensure it passed & currently prohibits abortions after six weeks of a pregnancy. It’s the only thing stopping Florida from becoming the abortion sanctuary of the South;
• Immediately legalize abortion through six months of a pregnancy, at least;
• Allows for “health” abortions – which would allow sadness _(mental health)_ about being pregnant as a reason to obtain a legal abortion at any stage. This would effectively mean Florida would be no different than states that allow abortion up until birth; and
• Allow abortionists to commit abortions on minors WITHOUT parental “approval” on the killing.
But, Pro-Life Friend, President Trump’s swampy advisors are clearly telling him to run as far away as he can from the abortion issue.

So, he won’t take this next step in opposing all abortion ballot referendums without your urging.

**The good news is, as he has proven in the past, President Trump does listen when grassroots patriots like you send a message.**

You are the best advisor he has.

With so much on the line in 2024 – and so many babies’ lives at stake – you and I have to act fast, especially with early voting just a few weeks away.

**[That’s why I’m counting on you to sign your petition urging former President Trump to come out against ALL of the ballot referendums the Abortion Lobby is pushing in 2024](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-gtkkluk-duchtdja-i/).**

For Life,

Kristan Hawkins
President, _Students for Life Action_

P.S. – President Trump’s announcement that he is opposing Florida’s pro-abortion _Amendment 4_ Ballot Referendum is good news, but it’s time to insist he do more.

**[That’s why I’m counting on you to sign your petition urging former President Trump to come out against ALL of the ballot referendums the Abortion Lobby is pushing in 2024](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-gtkkluk-duchtdja-d/).**

Your support can make all the difference!

Students for Life Action is a non-profit, tax-exempt advocacy organization under section 501(c)(4) of the IRC. Contributions or gifts to Students for Life Action are not tax deductible for IRS purposes; they do, however, avoid recognition of gain on appreciated assets. Students for Life Action's mailing address is 600 Princess Anne St #7667, Fredericksburg, VA 22401. Any donations raised above or short of the goal will be used in the next area of greatest need towards our mission, as determined by the organization.
---
This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. If you are no longer interested you can [unsubscribe instantly](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-u-gtkkluk-duchtdja-l/).

# [Don't let Russia steal the election](https://default.salsalabs.org/T4a561973-a043-4291-a393-496a93d2f419/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)
---
| | [](https://default.salsalabs.org/T136bb31c-dd7b-4671-9f3b-60af8aac6aff/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)
---
| | | Russia is trying to steal the election, and hand it to Trump. Through a sophisticated effort know as "Doppelganger", it is creating and distributing content favorable to Trump, and [hiding the source](https://default.salsalabs.org/T147c0de0-a8c1-4cf3-81a8-add3829104fa/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9). This is illegal in about a thousand different ways. **But the Biden-Harris administration, and the Justice Department in particular, is fighting back:** _" As part of the Doppelganger investigation, the DOJ said it seized 32 internet domains used in the effort, and named Russian companies Social Design Agency (SDA), Structura National Technology (Structura), and ANO Dialog as being involved in the effort._ _The effort involved Russian President Vladimir Putin's inner circle, including First Deputy Chief of Staff of the Presidential Executive Office Sergei Vladilenovich Kiriyenko, it said. " ([source](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tab688c50-b520-490b-a8d3-5cabaafa0c98/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9))_ We can't afford to have a hostile foreign power steal our election, and put Trump back in power as a puppet. The Justice Department needs to fight back hard, use all the resources necessary, and ensure that our elections are free, fair, and not the plaything of Vladimir Putin. And if Republican leaders try to block the effort, they should be charged as well. [**Add your name and show your support: Don't let Russia steal the election**](https://default.salsalabs.org/T43dc6646-fb9a-4a47-a5fe-a87a308e2104/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

subject: Can we count on your support?
body:

http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/os8pwIHWNp

Please see a special message from our
sponsor:

Dear
Fellow American,

Are you
enjoying your Imprimis subscription?

Do you
look forward to reading speeches from America's smartest and most
interesting conservatives each month?

I hope
so.

You will
never have to pay for Imprimis because we want its message in
defense of liberty and the American way of life to reach as many
citizens as possible.

We're
grateful that you read Imprimis, and we hope you share your copy
with others after you've read it-and that you encourage others
you know to sign up for their own free subscriptions.

Hillsdale
relies on a nationwide network of supporters-people like you-to
help in our efforts to promote the ideas of limited government,
free enterprise, individual rights, personal responsibility, and
strong national defense.

You're a
longtime Imprimis subscriber, so you're certainly aware of how
the far-Left attacks the moral and political foundations of our
country.

And you
understand that to defeat the powerful forces that seek to
undermine our freedom, we need to ramp up our efforts to educate
the American people about our founding principles of
liberty…the importance of reviving limited constitutional
government…the need to defend the rule of law…and
the fact that prosperity is dependent on a system of free
enterprise.

That's
why I want to know if you can offer your support to Hillsdale
College.

Other
colleges and universities have fallen prey to moral and cultural
relativism and the oppression of "political
correctness"-Hillsdale has not-and it continues to fulfill its
mission of defending civil and religious liberty through
education.

Will you
help?

In
addition to sending Imprimis to more Americans, you will help
us…

Teach
Americans of all ages who wish to learn about the Declaration of
Independence, the Constitution, free-market economics, American
Heritage, the Great Books, and more through free online courses
(to date, more than 4 million students have registered for one or
more courses);

Launch and support dozens more classical K-12 schools
nationwide-schools where students receive an education rooted in
the liberal arts and sciences and learn the importance of moral
character and civic virtue. More than 15,000 students currently
attend over 90 Hillsdale-affiliated K-12 schools, and thousands
more are on waiting lists.

Your
support is especially needed today because Hillsdale College does
not accept one penny in taxpayer support-not even indirectly in
the form of federal or state student grants and loans. We refuse
to allow the government to interfere with our internal affairs.

So, we
rely on the support of informed patriots like you, who understand
the importance of education to liberty.

Whatever
amount you give today, whether it's…

>> $25
>> $35
>> $50
>> $100
>> $250

…will help us defend the freedom of the American people
and the American way of life through education.

Simply
click the link below and let us know if we can count on your
support.
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/63528642:s8pwIHWNp:m:3:2627245898:EE87716A8307A68ABDF6352E8D85C00E:r

Thank you
in advance for your help in reaching and teaching millions more
Americans on behalf of liberty.

Warm
regards,

Larry P.
Arnn

President, Hillsdale College
Pursuing
Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

name: Kristan Hawkins, Students for Life Action
subject: the final countdown . . .
body:
Can you feel the shift in seasons?
Dear Pro-Life Friend,

With early voting beginning in just a matter of days, campaigns dashing to the finish line, and many Americans just now starting to tune in on what’s at stake this November, **this is crunch time!**

I don’t know about you, but with Labor Day now behind us, I can feel the shift in the political atmosphere, _and I’m worried._

The pro-abortion national media is telling everyone who will listen that Kamala Harris is going to ride the abortion issue to victory in November – _and there’s nothing we can do to stop them!_

But Pro-Life Friend, the army of young activists we’re just now beginning to deploy in Swing and Referendum States certainly can – _**just like they did during 2024’s Republican Primaries!**_

I’ll tell you more about one of our most recent successes shortly.

**[But first, I’m counting on your generous contribution of $250, $100, $50, or even $25 to help keep our canvassers knocking on doors through Election Day](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-giylrdk-duchtdja-y/)!**

Your generosity will make a tremendous impact.

In fact, if you haven’t yet heard, _Students for Life Action_ notched ANOTHER major victory in Wyoming just recently, with the GOP Primary defeat of Wyoming State Representative Ember Oakley.
[](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-giylrdk-duchtdja-j/)
You see, Rep. Oakley used her position on the Wyoming House’s Revenue Committee to try and water down and kill our _Chemical Abortion Prevention Act,_ which outlaws Chemical Abortion Pills in Wyoming.

**For that, we dubbed her “One of Biden’s Favorite Republicans” for her work keeping Wyoming’s ONE abortion facility open.**

As the watered-down bill was headed to the floor, our students and staff sprung into action, knocking thousands of doors in Oakley’s district and others nearby, and her pro-abortion amendments were reversed.

After _Students for Life Action_ educated voters in Wyoming, EXPOSING what Rep. Oakley had done, pro-life voters in her district sent her packing just last month.

And soon, my hopes and prayers are that the last abortion facility in Wyoming will soon be closing!

Pro-Life Friend, media elites want you and me to believe that we’ve already lost the battle over abortion.

But the truth is, we’re winning.

Supporting abortion is a losing issue – as Rep. Oakley found out.

The sooner national Republicans learn that lesson, the faster you and I will finally abolish abortion nationwide.

**[Today, with November right around the corner, I’m counting on your IMMEDIATE generosity](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-giylrdk-duchtdja-t/)!**

I included my original email detailing our **2024 Election Year Programs** and how you can get involved below.

I do hope you’ll take the time to read it.

Lives are on the line, **[and we need your support](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-giylrdk-duchtdja-i/).**

For Life,

Kristan Hawkins
President, _Students for Life Action_

_\---------- Begin Forwarded Message ----------_

Dear Pro-Life Friend,

Just imagine PRESIDENT Kamala Harris cackling for her pals in the press as she signs national abortion legislation into law that:

• Eradicates any and all life-saving laws for babies across the country;
• Forces abortion up until birth on all 50 states; and
• Forces taxpayers like you and me to pay for it all.
If the Abortion Lobby gets its way in November, that nightmare scenario I just told you about could very well come true as early as January.

That’s why, with Labor Day now behind us – _the traditional start of all campaigns' mad dashes to the finish_ – I’m counting on your IMMEDIATE action and generosity before it’s too late.

You see, we’re now just two weeks from the start of early voting in many states!

So, we have to act now.

The good news is, _Students for Life Action_ is ready to start deploying activists and start door-knocking in key Battleground and Referendum States!

I’ll share with you __what__ exactly these programs entail and __where__ our students will be deployed shortly, **[but first can I count on you to make your most generous contribution to _Students for Life Action_ right away to bolster our Election Year Efforts](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-giylrdk-duchtdja-d/)?**

**Here’s the deal, Pro-Life Friend . . .**

The Abortion Lobby is practically already popping the champagne corks, believing nothing can stop them from installing Kamala Harris in the Oval Office, seizing back control of the U.S. House, and holding onto a slim Senate Majority.

Should they succeed, there could be no stopping their radical agenda, including:

*****_PACKING THE U.S. SUPREME COURT_** with as many as five new justices who will serve as rubber stamps for _Planned Parenthood’s_ radical and bloody agenda;

*****_DESTROYING THE U.S. SENATE FILIBUSTER_ ,** which is a Senate rule that effectively requires all major legislation to gain 60 Senate votes for passage; and

*****_RAMMING PRO-ABORTION LEGISLATION FAR WORSE THAN _ROE V. WADE_ INTO LAW_,** that would force all 50 states to allow abortion-on-demand up until _(and even up to a week after)_ birth – _and force taxpayers to fund it all!_
_So, if we don’t fight back NOW, we could be toast._

That’s why, right now, _Students for Life Action_ is recruiting hundreds of young, enthusiastic pro-life student activists to participate in our **2024 Election Year Programs** and then deploying them in the following towns/states:

• Bozeman, Montana: _September 7-8 th_
• Sioux Falls, South Dakota: _September 7-8 th_
• Kearney, Nebraska: _September 21-22 nd_
• Phoenix, Arizona: _October 5-6 th_
• Tucson, Arizona: _October 5-6 th_
• Wayne, Michigan: _October 5-6 th_
• Rochester, New Hampshire: _October 12-13 th_
• Elizabeth City, North Carolina: _October 12-13 th_
• Concord, North Carolina: _October 12-13 th_
• Celebration, Florida:_October 19-20 th_
• St. Charles, Missouri: _October 19-20 th_
• Oklahoma City, Oklahoma: _October 26-27 th_
• (CITY TBD), Pennsylvania: _November 2-3 rd_
These deployments are so critical, you and I can’t afford to miss out on even a SINGLE ONE.

_That is, unless we want to watch a Harris-Walz Presidency snuff out the lives of countless little preborn boys and girls for the next four years . . ._

But of course, I’m counting on you to please keep these deployments rolling before these dates get too close, and it’s too late.

**[So, will you please consider making your most generous contribution to _Students for Life Action’s_ 2024 Election Year Programs so we can run them at full steam ahead as we head into the final stretch of election season](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-giylrdk-duchtdja-h/)?**

Pro-Life Friend, here’s the crux of everything I’ve shared with you so far . . .

Through these deployments, if we can educate pro-life voters regarding the records of legislators and candidates on protecting the preborn this spring, we’ll have a greater chance to pass and enact strong pro-life legislation in 2025, which will save thousands of babies from abortion.

Our involvement will also have national impact by finally DESTROYING this false narrative that being pro-life is a political liability!

With that goal in mind, _Students for Life Action_ is mobilizing the Pro-Life Generation by:

body:
In just 60 seconds per day, you can help us spread our message. Big changes start with lots of people taking small, meaningful actions.
| | | |

# Change the World in 47 Minutes
By Mark Robertson, Candidate for Nevada's First Congressional District
---
Dear Peter,
Happy Labor Day! I'm happy to express my gratitude to the men and women working daily to support themselves and their families. As they labor away, they are building strong families, strong communities, and a strong nation. Here's a simple way for you to support our campaign. Each day, we add at least one post to our Facebook page. With over 10,000 friends and followers, if each of you, with an average of 50 friends, hits the "share" button below our post, we could reach a staggering 500,000 people every day. Your share could be the one that makes a difference! Think about it! Half a million people would receive our message every day. That would be huge! There are only 47 days remaining until early voting begins on October 19th. If you share a post each day, it will take just 47 minutes of your time. I promise this will be time well spent. It is easy to share a post. Here are the steps: 1. Go to our Facebook page at: [https://www.facebook.com/RobertsonforNV/](https://dwhdqsbbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001kw9dKU2oej5iRU-ZT8zrVouBSi01ZJN0Lb5OlCgo1NmnJGVdtFlRejHT2JsCrXRnWcuLhinpFBZ7-OZ4poWiuFqtFrV91v6X90FtU8kco08GXP6i27dRhlElJsabMvJQylB_lqMQYqQRzRWVP6VB8QdAYr6miVybZB5Q78ZUpW4YOI1s0wX7yg==&c=lN9GxOO3ub1pEM-0WjbUkmvHvbiTmaK8btGBIheDizGt16TFxC_UBA==&ch=NNBQgV2XhaWadknlRxX1tuFFZHLaJz1ouK0rqAkMCIbPHj3Ntu7-0g==) 2. Choose one or two of the posts we've made 3. Hit the "share" arrow below the post. 4. Write a quick comment. (For example, I'm supporting Mark Robertson for Congress) 5. Bookmark our Facebook page so you can quickly return the next day. That's it. With your help, many people will learn who I am and hopefully vote for me. Before I go, there is one more easy thing you can do to help get my name in front of people. We have magnetic bumper stickers that you can put on your car. They do not hurt the paint and are easy to put on and remove. If you want a bumper sticker, respond to this email with your address, and someone will deliver one to your door. Thanks for your support! Enjoy Labor Day! Mark *******
---
Your Questions--Mark's Answers
Mark Robertson answers your questions with direct and honest answers. Here are two questions Mark was asked recently:
Q: When you consider your views on a wide range of issues from economic and social matters to foreign policy and religious liberty, how would you describe yourself?
A: Very conservative, but not extreme. Our nation's founders created a system of checks and balances that require compromise. Indeed, our very nation was born from compromise. That being said, I will fight for conservative causes such as smaller government, securing the border, balancing the budget, parental rights, protecting children and seniors, 2nd Amendment, religious freedom, and a strong military.
Q: Do you support school choice, including voucher programs, tax credits, charter schools, private schools, and home schools.
A: Yes. Nevada public schools are failing our children. We consistently rank near the bottom in math, science, and reading. I have taught in public, private, and chartered schools. Competition among and between these schools will raise the performance of all. Education dollars should follow the child, and parents should have the option to choose the best school for their child.
Please share this message with friends and neighbors. Have questions for me? Simply reply to this email to ask me a question.

name: Julia Kortrey, Evergreen
subject: A game-changer for industry and union labor in PA
body:
Join us next week to learn more about this exciting program
| | | | [](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/2833754/87SdQ4wZ) |
---|---|---
|
## ⚡EVENT ALERT⚡
Join us, Ohio River Valley Institute, PA DEP, Conservation Voters of PA, and labor and industry groups to discuss a game-changing Pennsylvania pollution reduction program that will create upward of 6,000 new jobs! The conversation takes place **next Wednesday, September 11 at 12 p.m. ET.** [RSVP NOW](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/2833755/87SdQ4wZ)
---
---
| Friend—

Earlier this summer, the Biden-Harris administration awarded **$4.3 billion** in Climate Pollution Reduction Implementation Grants to select states, cities, and coalitions.

And Pennsylvania is getting **a whopping $396 million of it** to cut industrial pollution across the state.

How? By implementing a new program called **Reducing Industrial Sector Emissions in Pennsylvania (RISE PA)** , which will provide grants and incentives to industrial facilities for decarbonization projects, while creating jobs with prevailing wage and apprenticeship requirements that ensure equitable workforce development.

In fact, it’s estimated that RISE PA will decrease climate pollution by 9.2 million metric tons of climate pollution cumulatively between 2025 and 2050 (the equivalent of powering _over 2 million homes for a year!_)—making it a slingshot into the more equitable clean energy future we all want and deserve.

**We're excited to dive deeper into this incredible program next Wednesday, September 11 at 12 p.m. ET.**[**If you want to know more about RISE PA and what it means for industry, labor, and the climate, you should join us!**](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/2833756/87SdQ4wZ) |
[](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/2833757/87SdQ4wZ)

---
| We're bringing together industrial leaders, labor groups, and Pennsylvania environmental organizations to talk about RISE PA and what happens next. You'll hear from me and: |
---
|
* **Jeff Mauk** , Director, Policy Network, Eastern Region, CERES
* **Rob Bair** , President, PA Building and Construction Trades Council
* **Katie Blume** , Political and Legislative Director, Conservation Voters of Pennsylvania
* **Louie Krak** , Infrastructure Implementation Coordinator, PA Department of Environmental Protection

|
---
| By tackling the state's biggest source of climate pollution, RISE PA will make sure Pennsylvania residents experience improved air quality, along with more good-paying job opportunities. But to effectively do so, the program needs to solicit as much feedback as possible during the next few months.

**Don't miss this opportunity to learn more about RISE PA and how it will help communities like yours thrive.**[**RSVP today!**](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/2833756/87SdQ4wZ)

And bring your questions!

See you online, |

By implementing a new program called Reducing Industrial Sector Emissions in Pennsylvania (RISE PA) , which will provide grants and incentives to industrial facilities for decarbonization projects, while creating jobs with prevailing wage and apprenticeship requirements that ensure equitable workforce development. In fact, it’s estimated that RISE PA will decrease climate pollution by 9.2 million metric tons of climate pollution cumulatively between 2025 and 2050 (the equivalent of powering over 2 million homes for a year!)—making it a slingshot into the more equitable clean energy future we all want and deserve. We're excited to dive deeper into this incredible program next Wednesday, September 11 at 12 p.m. ET. | | We're bringing together industrial leaders, labor groups, and Pennsylvania environmental organizations to talk about RISE PA and what happens next. You'll hear from me and: | | Jeff Mauk , Director, Policy Network, Eastern Region, CERES Rob Bair , President, PA Building and Construction Trades Council Katie Blume , Political and Legislative Director, Conservation Voters of Pennsylvania Louie Krak , Infrastructure Implementation Coordinator, PA Department of Environmental Protection | | By tackling the state's biggest source of climate pollution, RISE PA will make sure Pennsylvania residents experience improved air quality, along with more good-paying job opportunities. But to effectively do so, the program needs to solicit as much feedback as possible during the next few months. Don't miss this opportunity to learn more about RISE PA and how it will help communities like yours thrive. And bring your questions! ## Heavy Rains Bring Flooding
Heavy rains over the past few days have caused severe flooding in parts of the state. Midland received 3.63 inches of rain on Monday, the [sixth-highest daily total.](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJxskLFyqzAQAL9GdGKEAGEKFa-h82tTMifuZN9ESB5JATtfn4nr1LvFzn5c1ytw4Hj7DzvZ-vRpha3yQessR6mHdWjQOoVz15DtJj2O_WUedXO33jj0RhESdaZzajYKFSjjYYDuQrphq5Ue1KzGTo2mN-2EU0cjuMlt2AOBGBQh15TbeqdKTyg-vNJBud3S3gR7r_VRRP9P6EXo5TzP9pW-soPC8dcQeol0FqEXz7lUmak8UkTKRUIpXKrE9E2xyOQlZj7eYGeUmbaUUbpM8MnxJjNw9BCC0EuTLT5ODoGLmcSgbjtweOfUv-ccVv8EAAD__9bEa3M) The downpour flooded roads and prompted 26 high-water rescue calls in Odessa and 41 in Midland. A San Antonio man documented [getting submerged by floodwater](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJxskLGO6yAUBb_G7rAAgzEFxWvS5bVbWsC9ttFiEwEx2b9fJfW2R0ea0Xzdl7sNMZzbf3ugqa81LdbXcOGiiSRcLKIH4yho1qNhiks5zlryfjdOOomKaq2BTbPno5rUOM0wW8WEZ6IPhlMuqKaSUTmN06BAMZTWKedhtGg7QRFCTXmoO1Z82bLGn3RhHnw6-mj2Wh-lG_91_NbxW2ttOLGVhvj9PnT85m0upDzdgXlDIHt6FnwPOafnCQgkhhVJ3TPaimc4N7LGlKCQD4wwLWYuWJ8NPFqIMZRJdYJuhw3xo1D_DnIZ_hsAAP__nxFlOw) in his car before being rescued, while another video shows several homes in Coleman surrounded by water. Llano ISD [canceled classes Wednesday](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJxskLGS2yAQQL8GdesBJJApKNKou7QpPbtiJTPBcAOcOf99xqmvesWr3vvzcfvAmGI-f-ODff8-yg33Hp98c2BAL7dlCp5kcGpir1ZtzHx1Rk93j_N-VdLMKK-KmKSRbiYdyB4GlbLHFL2WepFOGiWNne1lDatig7TSHmZkFIvkEHupl37nzt_YjvQqT66XvTym5O-9fzYx_xJ6E3obY1z-Pr_4LYXesPa4JxZ6yzya0FsqO6Y3E-YCsQXoo8C9fFUInPAFRyolxHxCKgMGdq6w19JazGeDwSFzC_iCR6k55lPoTVsHjgMR0QHSSgULXWcgSwirXDSR44XDOlUfPkdMKTa7ikWeD4zpf0P_-ejT638BAAD__wZDedE) after receiving nearly seven inches of rain Tuesday, closing roads and forcing the Lower Colorado River Authority to open floodgates at Lake LBJ and Lake Marble Falls.
## Shaquille O'Neal Opens Restaurant in Fort Worth
Dozens of people lined up for days in the rain for the Tuesday opening of [Shaquille O'Neal's Big Chicken](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJxskL2O2zAQBp-G6taQKP5IhYo06i5tSmNF7lqL0KRD0dZdnj5w6qu-D5hq5tfH9QMlSb79xDst7ZPLFUOTF11nsKDN1XRx2fo4Dx0tg9fWjtNsdbcvZpvY8hQG6xkHNtbNm2MX5tE7Z33oZNG9Nv3c26G3bnQXH_1AFje_hTgioTI9RWmlXtpOjT7x4PRVXlQvody7tOytPQ41_lB6VXo9z_NyMuIbKr1ibRISKb0m4fdwKVHpNZa_lA9IkinC8wGSoaJk4FJhL896QMSvA3AnjFAYyoOy5Nv7Hjv-eUpKBCWTJNjkBmGX8JsyVDoaPivmpvSqJw-9jTORRZiNnsBEdjChc8BbZKN5mLZgu7rExykpyeG8Mv3tjpL-y7XvU78W_S8AAP__bRCCGQ) restaurant in Fort Worth. The first 34 customers received free food for a year, and some have been camping out since Sunday to secure their spot. The restaurant, part of a chain founded by O'Neal and his partners in 2018, features menu items inspired by the [basketball star's childhood favorites](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJxskL1u8yAYRq8Gb1jwAiYeGL7FW761o8XP64BKTGqoSe--Suauz6OjI52P63q1Kaf99t_e0bTnVlbrWzpxnamiIFc5BONYmPmAhmtQSlxmBUM0mnMvLpuaeBBOsomLbXYXEDLoYCcph2SAgWQzU5ypSUyjDpqjsk47H4RFSyTDkFo5xhax4dPWLf-UE4_Rl_uQTWztUYn4R2AhsPTeR-_qjr2-fgLLGyGwvCYCi0s36mPyn7jTGu3Xd8oZadnRZrqVo9FejhYJLMNhwqOnnFOdNJHsdrcpv53t7wKngd8AAAD__24PX0U). Shaq made an appearance at the opening, taking pictures with customers at the new North Texas location. Can You Help Out on Election Day?
---
Election Day is right around the corner and we are recruiting volunteers to help us next Tuesday, September 10th.
Can you help out by pollstanding at your polling station for part of the day?
Pollstanders hold signs outside of polling stations and greet voters as they walk in to vote. This is our last chance to get Vikram's name in front of voters before they cast their ballot. Even just pollstanding for an hour or two can have a big impact.
We also need help putting lawn signs near polling stations. Can you help out by putting some signs out by your polling station?
If you can help, just reply YES to this email and we will get in touch with you to get you set up.
Thank you for all of your help and support!

| Senator Fattman and Senator Durant join the MassGOP in Condemning Out-of-State EBT Spending in Vacation Hotspots
---
---
| Boston- A recent report from the Boston Herald revealed that EBT cards issued to Massachusetts welfare recipients have been used out of state, including in popular vacation destinations such as Hawaii, the Virgin Islands, Alaska, and in 165 cities and towns in California, as well as 293 cities and towns in Florida, among many others across the nation. The Department of Transitional Assistance, the agency responsible for administering these EBT cards, states that its mission is to "empower low-income individuals and families to meet their basic needs, improve quality of life, and achieve long-term economic self-sufficiency." While spending hundreds of taxpayer dollars on trips to Hawaii may enhance one's quality of life, this is clearly not the intended purpose of the program.
MassGOP Chair Amy Carnevale commented on this shocking revelation, stating, "This is yet another example of the extreme lack of government oversight of taxpayer dollars. Ordinary Massachusetts taxpayers are already struggling with inflation and the high cost of living in our state. It's a slap in the face that the Healey-Driscoll Administration shows such little respect for how Massachusetts residents' hard-earned money is being spent."
State Sen. Peter Durant (R-Spencer) joined the MassGOP Chair stating,"On the face of it, it seems these EBT cards are being used in posh vacation destinations while many Massachusetts taxpayers who fund this program struggle to pay for a modest vacation weekend on the Cape," said Durant. "We have allowed a level of trust for people who receive this assistance and we've believed that they would use the funds to help their families in a time of need. It's a sad day when we again have to consider legislating common sense and honesty."
State Sen. Ryan Fattman (R-Sutton) expressed his outrage, stating, "This is outrageous and needs to change through reform. Taxpayers shouldn't be paying for others to spend money intended to assist Massachusetts residents who have fallen on hard times in other states. There is no doubt that the Governor should be figuring out who is abusing these tax dollars and how they're removed from the system. More can and must be done to ensure that those who need assistance are receiving it and those who are abusing the system can no longer benefit from it."

body:
We're trusting you with some inside information that is critically important to the success of Kamala's presidential campaign.
# [](https://act.kamalaharris.com/go/65?t=1&akid=47%2E2563979%2ES1Sycv)

This is a bit of a different request, but we're trusting you with some inside information that is critically important to the success of Kamala's presidential campaign.
First, as you probably already know, the emails we send are responsible for an enormous share of our campaign's volunteer activity and record number of donations.
If anything were to happen and we lost access to sending emails, it would be catastrophic for our campaign.
So like any good campaign, we have a backup for critical infrastructure. Like our email tool. That's why you're getting this message -- you are a part of us setting that up.
When you set up a back-up mailer, you can't just start sending to millions and millions of people or gmail.com will flag those messages and send them to junk.
But gmail.com looks at other things as well. They look at how many people open the emails, click the emails, reply to the emails, add us to their contacts and more.
Getting these messages delivered is CRITICALLY important ahead of next week's debate and especially when we start letting people know when to vote. We’re talking win-or-lose stuff.
So we're sending this message to the most active Kamala Harris supporters asking them to do a few things today:
1\. [**Click on this link or the image below. It will take you to a video of Kamala Harris's launch video. It's a good watch, even if you've seen it before.**](https://act.kamalaharris.com/go/23?t=2&akid=47%2E2563979%2ES1Sycv)
[](https://act.kamalaharris.com/go/23?t=3&akid=47%2E2563979%2ES1Sycv)
2\. **Reply to this email.** Just let us know how you think things are going or any advice you may have.
3\. **Add us to your contacts.** That will really go a long way toward what we're trying to do here.
For today, this is a pretty important ask. Think of it as doing more than your fair share in the campaign to defeat Trump and elect Vice President Harris as our next president.
Thank you,
Kamala Harris for President
* * *

**Before you click away!**
This is the most important election of our lifetime, and it's critical we do everything we can to defeat Donald Trump and JD Vance this November.
If everyone reading this email donated just $20, we would reach our fundraising goals and have what it takes to win. But not everyone gives.
We are counting on supporters like you who know the stakes of this election to chip in today. [**If electing Kamala Harris and Tim Walz and defeating Donald Trump seems worth $20, donate to the campaign today:**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-hfp-september-2024?refcode=kh_em_fr_20240905_b10_kh_tier1&refcode2=47_2563979_S1Sycv&akid=47%2E2563979%2ES1Sycv)

subject: GREATER GEORGIA ANNOUNCES SIX-FIGURE CAMPAIGN TO EXPOSE FAILURES OF FULTON COUNTY DISTRICT ATTORNEY FANI WILLIS
body:
| | | |
---
| FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE THURSDAY, SEPTEMBER 5 GREATER GEORGIA ANNOUNCES SIX-FIGURE CAMPAIGN TO EXPOSE FAILURES OF FULTON COUNTY DISTRICT ATTORNEY FANI WILLIS ATLANTA - Today, Greater Georgia [announced](https://fsdy8nbbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001woQId4llZy3pRwgYfZ8IbINa5RqdsHlcEEnfvN4FWGD1WUHpUE1hmjojuBkwLsGR0JWB0pW9Eu2Wij416B2USKm1cVfhNT_Yj9i9tVAjfqsckTxfn1Rm-1kYGK5fqbrRA5fIoN8SQ3wwervEsvU3_k85FaHVDawHlWTJbbnLz24OHb4PO5mfp8hM40lvd927WNFQFq1MaTn_OWbk4DmuyIup5d_JERa8xtKxVUnGhpKJRNG4w3ZjTce3NBtpNb8bjibEWTgt9uQpfMFDGETnSA==&c=78esylgthSM7Dv0rplVYNEU8uVstANZF49uo6UHRtaJjZwyJL_G0_g==&ch=Eycmb9atY-PCXzjRMMtmxLRcf5PmFGqv8Hg9i_DlWRfECqnqVC-k9w==) a six-figure campaign to expose the costly failures of District Attorney Fani Willis that continue to impact Fulton County residents. The campaign includes digital ads and text messages, reaching Atlanta-area voters ahead of the Fulton County District Attorney election on November 5th. The awareness effort launched today with a video ad entitled "Failed," which is running on streaming and programmatic media including Fox News, CNN, WSB TV, Hulu, Roku, and Fubo. Click [HERE](https://fsdy8nbbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001woQId4llZy3pRwgYfZ8IbINa5RqdsHlcEEnfvN4FWGD1WUHpUE1hmjojuBkwLsGRq7cxbt1qVej3ireBZSbShn6t-ZAICpKpZfjkVwMo_c1LqQ0P0HQpborGJbqEdRb1BWggqaycsHoeDWXygRX_e6N6LGn5mjuk&c=78esylgthSM7Dv0rplVYNEU8uVstANZF49uo6UHRtaJjZwyJL_G0_g==&ch=Eycmb9atY-PCXzjRMMtmxLRcf5PmFGqv8Hg9i_DlWRfECqnqVC-k9w==) or on the image below to watch the ad. "Fani Willis had one job when voters put their trust in her in 2020: prosecute violent career criminals in order to protect the residents of Fulton County. Instead, she's spent the last four years chasing vanity cases to grow her celebrity, line her pockets, and fuel her political ambitions," said Greater Georgia Chairwoman and Former U.S. Senator Kelly Loeffler. "On her watch, prosecutions are down, crime is up, and more citizens have been needlessly victimized - then denied justice because she is too distracted or too incompetent to deliver it. Willis' conduct is an embarrassment to the state of Georgia and a profound threat to public safety. She must be ousted this November to restore law and order in Fulton County - and end the era of partisan, personal, taxpayer-funded distractions."
---
| [](https://fsdy8nbbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001woQId4llZy3pRwgYfZ8IbINa5RqdsHlcEEnfvN4FWGD1WUHpUE1hmjojuBkwLsGRq7cxbt1qVej3ireBZSbShn6t-ZAICpKpZfjkVwMo_c1LqQ0P0HQpborGJbqEdRb1BWggqaycsHoeDWXygRX_e6N6LGn5mjuk&c=78esylgthSM7Dv0rplVYNEU8uVstANZF49uo6UHRtaJjZwyJL_G0_g==&ch=Eycmb9atY-PCXzjRMMtmxLRcf5PmFGqv8Hg9i_DlWRfECqnqVC-k9w==)
---
| The Greater Georgia campaign will highlight three significant categories of failures of Willis' tenure as D.A. including: Presiding over rising crime rates, failure to prosecute criminals, and dozens of inmate deaths.

* Homicides increased by 8% in Fulton County from 2021 to 2022. Since 2023, homicides have increased by 13% in the City of Atlanta. (Georgia Bureau of Investigation [Uniform Crime Reporting Program](https://fsdy8nbbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001woQId4llZy3pRwgYfZ8IbINa5RqdsHlcEEnfvN4FWGD1WUHpUE1hmjojuBkwLsGRi4fgk19S5b-fXZK4HYzuCz4_UXcFzmJj2bxQiop8tBkrjsWKSaXi8a1zmEjDZT-0OarkQcv3IGoNzUfm996Z4bPyENNtup3BvSyK0jVGIhn4ahNsn1uzQ0PdkepTCz75&c=78esylgthSM7Dv0rplVYNEU8uVstANZF49uo6UHRtaJjZwyJL_G0_g==&ch=Eycmb9atY-PCXzjRMMtmxLRcf5PmFGqv8Hg9i_DlWRfECqnqVC-k9w==), accessed August 29, 2024; [Atlanta Journal-Constitution](https://fsdy8nbbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001woQId4llZy3pRwgYfZ8IbINa5RqdsHlcEEnfvN4FWGD1WUHpUE1hmjojuBkwLsGRC0rDEREqAFBiigGeOqd94mm8jfMsBbxzY6zfRPJX9ITdlooWMwRpB9zqoSRtmDkgtU4ObvBlC9DyFtD1GZX3qiQ6fPRirTTa3un244pjr04JlRmO-oTe2K-OBIBdhazo2xSMoblnJ3T38PMT9X50RdFZHXLI9DRHWNWFHzsT0D5zsj8t4qTEpMFIR9wxMEw75ir98hcMWVUdTHcyjwGB__l51KqtSSDo&c=78esylgthSM7Dv0rplVYNEU8uVstANZF49uo6UHRtaJjZwyJL_G0_g==&ch=Eycmb9atY-PCXzjRMMtmxLRcf5PmFGqv8Hg9i_DlWRfECqnqVC-k9w==), July 16, 2024)

* 13,787 people were arrested for felonies in 2023 but never indicted. At the end of 2023, the Fulton County D.A. still had a backlog of 11,700 unindicted cases. ([Atlanta News First](https://fsdy8nbbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001woQId4llZy3pRwgYfZ8IbINa5RqdsHlcEEnfvN4FWGD1WUHpUE1hmjojuBkwLsGR6dwsqqB2kMk18ihVSbmbsbRGZ_CeO-we4_VgdrtSZ0G7kCtelThOQLGxqu6dKi53OfxhA2YsgZQYMzhGw5G_vyWgQkw2uJ4zWz8bQsvLrSikYPgHE_jvNSt-OwP8oXwjpHTHNCTbq9VnUvPe3I99vo8tRgxilThZmc1BatGfDkMf2x2WwPmfO27xHFkaR0f7ClrnOT8-7ZvIsa-tSM1GgQ==&c=78esylgthSM7Dv0rplVYNEU8uVstANZF49uo6UHRtaJjZwyJL_G0_g==&ch=Eycmb9atY-PCXzjRMMtmxLRcf5PmFGqv8Hg9i_DlWRfECqnqVC-k9w==), June 12, 2024; [Atlanta News First](https://fsdy8nbbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001woQId4llZy3pRwgYfZ8IbINa5RqdsHlcEEnfvN4FWGD1WUHpUE1hmjojuBkwLsGRq521Ft_7G_s5A_tdNANVG3JsEpzNzyDF4aoDGeX_58B2NsS58pfFo5UXNZf3cQXPWPOxLh8DhX9BKDxZ34vnyHDO8qrTUqvEafFOc6ul8bjyklpazV0rJk4ocgdT0lpXvCYKvqj0icNjkfg6sPfnjPL_xkQPnm2QWwQ505TvZ-Ewi9hOHt1EFWb5Rby4bCPVNvWylZHWQB5Ab7g3Qg9bNOaDPaH3H56MuNFtkhJ0mV14IkUdcqkETkz5G2Su8RViEAAGWxHBa2E=&c=78esylgthSM7Dv0rplVYNEU8uVstANZF49uo6UHRtaJjZwyJL_G0_g==&ch=Eycmb9atY-PCXzjRMMtmxLRcf5PmFGqv8Hg9i_DlWRfECqnqVC-k9w==), October 30, 2023)

* 36% of the Fulton County Jail population, or over 900 inmates, are being held without indictment as of the latest publicly available data. name: Shelby County Republican Party
subject: Fwd: Haitian Refugee Crisis in Ohio
body:
Hello Shelby County Patriots,

We had an amazing Meet the Candidates Night last Tuesday at Shelby Oaks
Golf Club.

The first speaker was Kyle Koehler from Springfield, and I felt it was
important to share his words with you quickly. If you’re not already on
high alert, doing all you possibly can to make sure we win every race in
Ohio, this should help to increase your sense of urgency. These are our
neighbors Kyle is talking about here. I spoke to one of our commissioners
and Shelby County is already experiencing budget problems in the county for
similar (although at this point, less severe) reasons.

More will follow, but below is the transcript of the speech that Kyle
Koehler delivered Tuesday evening.

Cheers...Dan Cecil, Chairman
(937) 206-2970
cecilda.usaf@gmail.com

Good evening, thank you for being here tonight.

My name is Kyle Koehler and I am a former State Representative for
Springfield Ohio and the Clark County area. I am currently a candidate for
the State Senate covering Clark, Greene and Clinton counties.

There are going to be several very good speakers sharing tonight. I am
going to tell you right now; I will not be remembered as someone delivering
good news. Instead, I am bringing some bad news.

Chairman Dan Cecil has asked if I would share what is going in my hometown
of Springfield and the Haitian REFUGEES that have settled in our community.

Over the last four years Haitians who are crossing the border (or in fact,
flown to our country as refugees)... have been given Temporary Protected
Status by the Federal Government. Under the Biden/Harris administration –
they not only are protected but they are given between $600 to $1600/MONTH
on Debit Cards through the Refugee Cash Assistance program and allowed
access to all the public assistance programs available to US citizens

Since early 2020, a temporary staffing company in Springfield, started
actively bringing Haitian refugees to our city. First a few hundred, then
thousands. As of this month, our local Job and Family Services has
registered over 20,000 Haitian refugees in our county and
city. Springfield, which had a steady population of 58,000...now has an
additional 20,000 new residents in and around Springfield. 20,000 people in
just under four years.

Our public school system (with just over 8,000 students) suddenly has over
1,600 non-english speaking students. Nineteen-year-old Haitian men and
women are being enrolled as high-school freshman and are in class with
13-year-old boys and girls.

The staffing company that started this “migration” is owned by a man that
has over 63 rental properties in the Springfield area. Instead of getting
the normal $600-$800 in rent each month, he rents cots for $250/month to as
many at 20 to 25 Haitians per home. He charges them $25 for roundtrips to
work each day. They work under contracts preventing them from being hired
full time at their place of employment. This AND the barrier of not
speaking English causes them to become basically indentured servants *in my
opinion*.

Since no one over the age of 18 requires driver’s education in Ohio –
Haitians are allowed to take the permit test *with an interpreter*... who
basically gives them all the answers. Since “permit” in the Haitian
language of Creole is interpreted “permission” most never take the actual
driving test. This means hundreds of Haitians, who cannot speak English and
have no idea what the driving laws actually say... are NOW causing accidents
all over our community. There are Facebook pages created by individuals
dedicated to reporting accidents involving Haitians. The number of
overturned cars being reported each day on streets where the speed limits
are 35MPH or less... would shock you.

One year ago, a Haitian man pulled in front of the school bus causing the
bus to overturn, ejecting children and resulting in the death of an
11-year-old student.

Our county health department has reported an increase in HIV cases over the
last five years. Based on their numbers we will hit an increase of 871%
over the previous five years. Nurses have confirmed that an entire wing of
our regional hospital has nothing but Haitian patients being treated for
HIV.

A delivery nurse reports that 70% of all scheduled Cesareans are for
Haitian women who cannot deliver naturally because of HIV.

TB cases are up over 500% for this same period.

Our Federally Qualified Health Care (FQHC) called Rocking Horse is
overwhelmed with the increase in Haitians that are automatically qualified
for Medicaid services.

Our public safety officials have confirmed that charges against most
Haitians who break the law are almost immediately dismissed because of lack
of translators... meaning that courts cannot provide a speedy trial so they
are simply arrested and released.

City, county, and state leaders are overwhelmed with complaints that they
can do very little about fixing.

Last month, a group calling themselves the “Blood Tribe” marched past a
Jazz and Blues Festival carrying large Swastika flags and rifles. Their
leader showed up last week at a city commission meeting and publicly warned
the mayor of impending “savagery” if he didn’t stop the migration of
Haitians to our community.

I told you I was bringing the bad news.

Let me tell you this is NOT about race. As a grandfather of seven children...
FIVE OF WHOM are wonderfully loved children of color, I can assure you this
has nothing to do with race or the color of someone’s skin.

I understand that these folks are fleeing a “hellhole” of a country run by
gangs. They are thankful to be here. BUT OUR COMMUNITY simply cannot
handle an influx of 20,000 new residents who do not understand our
language, our culture, our laws, and are being treated (*in my opinion*) as
indentured servants.

The bad news - is that the current administration has allowed millions of
individuals to come across the border and (and in this case) even be flown
into our country. Our communities in Ohio are only just beginning to
understand the full impact of the last four years. Your community could be
next.

Now the good news. The good news is that the answer lies in your hands as
voters. The good news lies in changing things in Washington. The good news
lies in electing Bernie Moreno as our next US Senator from Ohio. The good
news lies in putting Donald Trump back in the White House. The good news
comes in 60 days when we take back our country, seal our borders and bring
sanity back to the United States of America.

>From the Ohio Supreme Court to the US Senate race. From electing local
officials up to electing Donald Trump... our nation depends on your vote. Our
state depends on your vote and the community of Springfield Ohio depends on
your vote. Please don’t let us down.

Friend,

I've spent my life fighting for Ohioans and for the Dignity of Work – the belief that hard work should pay off for everyone, no matter who you are, where you live, or what kind of work you do. The belief that no one should have to work a second or third job _just to get by_. The belief that folks who play by the rules deserve to retire with dignity.
When we fight for workers, we fight for all people. So whether you punch a time clock or swipe a badge, you work for tips or for a salary, you're raising children or caring for an aging parent – I promise to fight for you.
**But I'll be honest: I can't win this fight alone, friend. Peter,
