Dear Peter,

We thought you may be interested to read this BREAKING news from Illinois Review, the largest conservative media source in Illinois, and the only source that has been shared by President Donald Trump.
U.S. Sen. Tim Scott Headlining Black Conservative Summit in Tinley Park, Todd Ricketts Appearing as Special Guest (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/09/u-s-sen-tim-scott-headlining-black-conservatives-summit-in-tinley-park-todd-ricketts-appearing-as-special-guest.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=b11104ef28-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)
https://subsplash.com/freedomsjournalinstitute/lb/ev/+rqbbf35?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=b11104ef28-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D
(Freedom's Journal Institute)
By Illinois Review

The Freedom’s Journal Institute (FJI (https://freedomsjournalinstitute.org/?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=b11104ef28-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) ) for the Study of Faith and Public Policy – an Illinois-based nonprofit organization designed to “advance the Kingdom of God through socio-political, education and engagement,” is hosting their annual Black Conservative Summit beginning this Friday, as national conservative political figures headline the 3-day conference.

The summit, which takes place at Insight Church in Tinley Park, is expected to draw hundreds of attendees from across the country. The
agenda (https://freedomsjournalinstitute.org/bcs-2024-agenda?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=b11104ef28-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) , which includes the tagline, “Black America at a Crossroads: Cultural Marxism vs. A Biblical Worldview,” is timely, just months before a historic presidential election in November.

The 3-day conference, which begins on Friday and ends on Sunday, incluses breakout sessions throughout the day and keynote speakers in the evening. On Saturday evening, U.S. Sen. Tim Scott (R-NC) will headline the dinner program after a private VIP meet-and-greet, which will include special guest and Chicago Cubs co-owner Todd Ricketts.
https://subsplash.com/freedomsjournalinstitute/lb/ev/+rqbbf35?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=b11104ef28-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D
CLICK TO READ FULL ARTICLE (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/09/u-s-sen-tim-scott-headlining-black-conservatives-summit-in-tinley-park-todd-ricketts-appearing-as-special-guest.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=b11104ef28-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)
In 2019, President Donald Trump selected Ricketts to serve as Finance Chairman for Trump Victory. Ricketts was also listed as a co-chair for the Palm Beach fundraiser last April that raised a record $50.5 million for President Trump’s presidential campaign.

In 2011, Dr. Eric Wallace and his wife, Jennifer, founded FJI. Dr. Wallace serves as president, while his wife Jennifer, is the senior fellow for marriage and family life.

The Black Conservative Summit (BCS) is an annual event designed to bring together national, state, and local leaders to discuss prominent issues facing today’s society on a national stage. In the past, keynote speakers have included Ken Blackwell, Larry Elderand former Arkansas Gov. Mike Huckabee.

# Confirm your voter registration status and get a free NFT
Stand With Crypto is committed to mobilizing and activating the crypto community in America to make a difference in our country. One of the easiest and most effective ways to make a difference is simple: making sure you're registered to vote.

Voters make the ultimate decision about who makes the rules that govern crypto, and who gets to decide crypto's legal future in the United States. And while it's critical to make your voice heard throughout the year, casting your ballot for candidates who believe in crypto will have perhaps the largest impact of any action you can take.

Luckily, SWC makes it easy to register to vote. You can check your voter registration right here on SWC's website. After you do, make sure to encourage other members of the crypto community to do the same by posting on X and tagging us [@StandWithCrypto](http://url5163.communication.standwithcrypto.org/ls/click?upn=u001.US1FHkkdDigX3McDHDMZk0o9FjsmuoF3083AqEc985nNO4n7K4PNiN5iQworpShTxcs__9XnTPLnaEjN9OHWhKYUffDeECIVzR9M-2B5LaO5RH8NVCiVUBhHXK-2FOWWwUh48VSqm9hCOrPqyQtcxx-2FiO7aD38E0b0H6CFVBR9a-2B5GttbCpz-2FeAliH6y2ymya4-2BnQZJCJneVk5GUh1KuzdpIfhDAEMQSOdOSj5LUQ9N3mmD2dUjdnqGED-2BbAer79Zd4i6p9aDZSW0gO9qHfgMULfuxNYUKEYf-2B8hU2Th-2BtGaaM4YXdIFq3sDlyB1pTOHsYjhkGD662h3hVn9y0SMiWYw1lrQUyEuJ5zTW3-2B-2BJhqAmyoVWaYg-3D).

body:
Thank you so much, Peter.
#
Hi Peter, it’s Lucas Kunce with a quick update about our August fundraising.
**We just had our best fundraising month _ever_ — entirely thanks to your support.** You’ll hear more from me and my team about that later, but for now I just wanted to reach out to say thank you.
Insiders thought I was crazy when I decided to run this campaign the right way — without any money from corporate PACs or Big Oil + Big Pharma execs. But real people like you have stepped up to prove them wrong by helping us hit our goals at nearly every single deadline.
That support has allowed us to hold Josh Hawley accountable for crusading against reproductive rights and embarrassing our state. It’s helped us earn major in-state and national endorsements from groups like the Missouri AFL-CIO, Missouri Fire Fighters, VoteVets, and End Citizens United. And it’s made this race our best chance to flip a U.S. Senate seat this November.
We’ve got some serious MO-mentum. **But now, with Election Night just two months away, we’ve still got the most important work ahead of us.**
From keeping our ads on TV and getting organizers on the ground, we’ve got to make sure our campaign has the resources to keep exposing Hawley’s record and getting our message in front of voters. And your continued support is what makes that possible for our movement.
I can’t tell you how much it means to me that you’re part of this team, Peter. I know that together, we can defeat Josh Hawley, flip Missouri’s U.S. Senate seat, and take back power for working Missourians this November.
Now, let’s keep moving.
— Lucas Kunce

Can I tell you a story about my family farm? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024-tester]
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024-tester [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024-tester]
In 1910, my grandfather came to Montana. He found a piece of grassy land, took a look at it, and said, “This is the place.” And that’s where the farm began.
He farmed the land until the early 1940s, and then passed it down to my folks. In 1978, my wife Sharla and I took over the farm and we’re still here today, three generations and more than 40 years later.
We’ve made a lot of progress here — Sharla and I built a new home, several steel buildings, and more storage.
The truth is, I love this work. Yes, it makes for early mornings and late nights during planting and harvest seasons, but it also keeps me grounded and gives me perspective on the issues we face every day.
When I think about climate change, I’m thinking of folks on farms like mine struggling with catastrophic droughts or historic levels of flooding. When I think about reforming the USPS, I’m thinking of the people in rural communities across Montana who rely on timely mail delivery for their medication or Social Security checks. And when I think about infrastructure, I’m thinking of the rural towns near mine that need access to affordable, high-speed internet.
These aren’t abstract issues or talking points. They’re very real challenges that deserve real solutions, and that’s what I’m fighting for in Washington. I spend every single day trying to do right by working families, farmers, students, and veterans here in Montana and across the country.
I’m running for reelection because there’s still work to be done. Just like my parents and grandparents on the family farm, when I commit to something, I see it through. Can you make a split donation of any amount today to help me keep up the fight in Washington? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024-tester]
DONATE NOW [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024-tester]
I’ll leave you with one last truth about farming: Some years, you get the right amount of rain, and things work out really well. Other years, you get a whole lot less.
That means it’s important to be prepared for any outcome and to have a support system by your side when things get difficult. We don’t know what this campaign will look like or what Republicans will throw our way over these final few months. But with your support, we’ll be ready.
I appreciate anything you can contribute. Thanks for your help, and I hope I make you proud.
—Jon Tester

body:
We are making history with the largest write-in campaign ever!

| | |
# Cornel West for President

[ ](https://www.cornelwest2024.com/writein?e=2c4ab4fbefc09c0d9c12f8df438b31c5&utm_source=cornelwest&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=write_in_win2&n=1)
---
# **When we stand together,****we can overcome.**
---
Dear Peter, I’m thrilled to share a monumental update from the campaign trail**—****Dr. Cornel West is officially on the ballot or eligible for write-in across states representing a total of 501 electoral votes!** This is a transformative step towards a presidency that embodies truth, justice, and love. As we push forward to the November elections, every single vote counts, and Dr. West’s vision has never been more important. We are on a path to make historical changes, and we need your support to ensure our message reaches every corner of the nation. **Here’s Where We Stand:**
* **Write-In Eligibility:** Voters in Alabama, Arizona, California, Connecticut, Delaware, Idaho, Illinois, Indiana, Iowa, Kansas, Kentucky, Maryland, Massachusetts, Missouri, Montana, New Hampshire, New Jersey, New York, North Dakota, Ohio, Rhode Island, Tennessee, Texas, Washington D.C., West Virginia, and Wyoming can write in 'Cornel West'—ensuring every vote will be counted.
* **Ballot Presence:** Dr. West is on the official ballot in 19 states, including Alaska, Oregon, Washington, Utah, Colorado, Nebraska, Vermont, Maine, South Carolina, North Carolina, Wisconsin, Michigan, Georgia, Florida, Minnesota, Mississippi, Louisiana, and pending successful legal resolutions, Pennsylvania, and Virginia.

---
| [](https://www.cornelwest2024.com/writein?e=2c4ab4fbefc09c0d9c12f8df438b31c5&utm_source=cornelwest&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=write_in_win2&n=2 "Donate") [Donate](https://www.cornelwest2024.com/writein?e=2c4ab4fbefc09c0d9c12f8df438b31c5&utm_source=cornelwest&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=write_in_win2&n=2)
---
**We Need Your Support:** Our campaign is currently engaged in urgent legal disputes with the establishment in Pennsylvania and Virginia to secure Dr. West’s position on the ballot. **Your contribution today is vital** as it helps fund these crucial efforts to overcome the barriers set by those who wish to limit the democratic process. Every dollar you donate strengthens our fight for justice and ensures that every voice is heard this November.
---
**Here's How You Can Help Immediately:**
1. **Donate:** Your contributions empower us to continue spreading our message and organizing voters. Every donation, no matter the size, makes a big difference.
2. **Volunteer:** Share our mission with your friends and family. Encourage them to join our movement and support Dr. West. Every new supporter brings us closer to victory.
3. **Spread the Word:** Join our dedicated team of volunteers. Whether it’s making phone calls, texting, or hosting virtual events, your time and energy are invaluable.

---
**Peter** \- a vote for West is a vote for a future we all believe in. This November, let’s vote our conscience and stand together for a presidency that truly represents us all. We are poised to make the largest write-in campaign ever a resounding success. **Together, we can reshape the presidency and create a future filled with justice and love. Let’s make history.** [Your donation today will make a difference. Together, we can continue to fight for a democracy that works for everyone. Thank you for standing with us.](https://www.cornelwest2024.com/writein?e=2c4ab4fbefc09c0d9c12f8df438b31c5&utm_source=cornelwest&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=write_in_win2&n=6)

## **Together, we are making history.**
The West/Abdullah campaign has the signatures and minor party nominations it needs to get on the ballot in 17 states. This includes 6 of the battleground states: Michigan, Georgia, Minnesota, Florida, Wisconsin and North Carolina. For more details on where and how you can vote for Dr. West, see our ballot access [map](https://www.cornelwest2024.com/ballotaccess?e=2c4ab4fbefc09c0d9c12f8df438b31c5&utm_source=cornelwest&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=write_in_win2&n=7). Thank you for your continued support. In solidarity, Edwin DeJesus
Director of Policy

Women and girls have a right to compete fairly, and to private locker rooms. I speak out strongly for all female athletes like me who’ve been forced to compete against men. **Just this year, a female golfer lost her spot in the U.S. Women’s Open qualifier at Bradenton to a man, James “Hailey” Davidson.** Then, USA Today _took down_ a brilliant op-ed by Republican Senator John Kennedy. | Peter, Do you remember ridiculous headlines like this from the 2020 pandemic?
* [99-year-old in New Jersey charged after attending party during state ban on gatherings](https://xtz223.keap-link016.com/v2/click/e1477660be404dab98285834f651c33e/eJyNkMFOwzAQRP_F5zh23UJpblVVVVFKDwjOyLJXxJCsLWfTNFT5d0xBPYHU8755o9kzI0CNVFpWsBN9KjVnGYtgXHCAtPFI2lyu6m4xm88y1jj82EXfB1ac_wxfgUvqfikzRmOAhDw_rTdVedi97stDlcigY-q4zbN8UFfP9nFd7tk0_SuG1tH2mNwdKyj28L3IurSKXmKT-JoodIUQwzDkBjE3vhVKKinkQkgl-k6sVnwEHblvLDe1jm9gOcLA3yF2MHLjo0d9dDGhDi2c8praJjXrEADt79sqGH_6py-igHW2)
* [Police break up New Jersey rabbi’s funeral, charge 15 men in another case of religion clashing with public health](https://xtz223.keap-link016.com/v2/click/3bd05cafb382efa13d49643b4dd23dc1/eJyNkMtOwzAQRf9l1mmdOoWi7KqqqqKULlBZIysxdEQ6Y9mTpA_l32sCgg1IrOfcc3XnCmLJkBQ15HCSi9YZJOBthQ4tyYpJTDVe9d18ls0SaJDeN55bB_n11_A3MKbuFzoBOTsbkf3TclUWu83LttiVkXTGx47_eRYPP57147LYwjD8KbZHlHUX3QFy8a39WFRjXCXPvon8QcSFXKm-76e9CQekN2FyHGRa8VGREWRSOtWpSucqzdRrS9abZlKxZzId-jZMOuRmBIOKlcY5S_XXv0p7_iwebhA1dJ0=)
* [We can go to Home Depot, but we can’t go to church? Let us fully open or we’ll sue, 67 N.J. pastors say.](https://xtz223.keap-link016.com/v2/click/ee31d6ef6a31a16f11f2054b86450a39/eJyNkM1OwzAQhN_F52ycpj9BuVVVVUUpPSA4I-OsSIpjW_a6IVR5d0xb9QQS5_lmdmbPjFALTVXDSvZJX3k-ZwlzKDvboaaN0STkRc2Xi9l8ljDV6Y-dM8Gy8vyr-Q5cXKtikTAaLUbk-Wm9qavD7nVfHepIWuHijf_lFA_5PWf7uK72bJr-DMa-o-0pZntWkgv4s6jp4ip6cSryLZH1JefDMKT6mErTc2mc0eLUueB5nuUZz5Z8QJBCw7sBMtCaHqFBawjeAsFVo5so2-BkCwoJggdjUYNxkVEKfEBYFaCPYIUn4zx4MaYt9SoWFTaize3LNY7XutM3N-KHGQ==)
* [About a third of N.J.’s small businesses have closed so far this year as COVID-19 fears mount](https://xtz223.keap-link016.com/v2/click/829b9858d358a85eff4d88ad0321ccea/eJyNkEFPwzAMhf9LznW7drBBb9M0TVXHDgjOKGtcNaNNothtKdP-O9lAO4HEzbK_9_zsk2A00nChRC4--DPL5iISHivtNBpeW8Oyuk6z-7t0nkai1eZ9623vRH76VXwDrqrFchEJnhwG5OV5tS6L_fZtV-zLQDrpw47_-SwfspvP5mlV7MT5_Kcxdpo3Q_AmkbPv8XKR0uEqfvVt4BtmR3mSjOMYm2Nc2S6prLdGDtr3lGSzbJakaSIPtmeQwI32CmwN5khAnWxbOPSkDRIhQSMHhKq1hArIQi39RUAwYagkQWUHrSB9hDo0CDrbG44b7toQVDqHRv18ucTpO-75C3ysh8M=)

They still make my blood boil. Nothing shows Left-wing lunacy quite like the authoritarian rules forced upon us during the COVID-19 pandemic. Governor Phil Murphy shut down schools, prevented people from gathering, and absolutely destroyed our economy by forcing small businesses to close their doors. We’re still dealing with the impacts today. As the headline says above **nearly one-third of New Jersey small businesses were permanently closed after COVID measures.** That’s insane! If that wasn’t enough, children in New Jersey schools are [still testing behind pre-pandemic levels](https://xtz223.keap-link016.com/v2/click/89f552ae06c2ea6ec557e775a65c73bc/eJyNkEFOwzAQRe_idVwnTmmi7KqqqqKULhCskbFHxCW1LXuSEKreHaegrkDqet68P3_OBMEIg7UiFfnEL85zkhAPUjsNBjfWoJDXKX9YZnmWkE6bj523vSPV-c_lG3DdWhVlQnByEJHnp_WmqQ-71319aCLphI8Z93mKkt8828d1vSeXy79iOGncDtEdSIW-h7mR0rEVvvgu8i2iCxVj4zgujPXYHsEHmBbSnlhA6ydmYAwMVC8FamsYT3nOMs7SgiEEpEFaD4GaIw3YqzmI9o7OFO3EO32DVhtFnQcq7aAV7WCALrAiK2OR5SqNnnimcA6M-v1xA9PPsZdvRriEqA==) in math, English, and science. And if you thought Phil Murphy was bad, let me tell you about what Vice Presidential candidate Tim Walz did as governor of Minnesota. He also shut down schools, banned small gatherings, and forced small-businesses to close. He even instituted a “snitch” line for people to tell the government when their neighbors were violating stay-at-home orders. Of course, stay-at-home orders were strictly enforced–unless you wanted to [join the destructive riots in Minneapolis after the death of George Floyd.](https://xtz223.keap-link016.com/v2/click/815e3e6eaf26b0a497c301894e10e29a/eJyNUMtOwzAQ_Bef44amPKrcqqqqopQeEJyRsTfpCte21huStMq_YwrqCSQuO4edmZ3Zs2BwynFlRCkGPhXFQmSCQGNAcLz2jpW-bIu72_lingmL7n1LvguiPP8qvhIuqvvlTSZ4DJAoz0-rdV3tt6-7al8nZlCUbvzP52FZXH02j6tqJ6bpT2M4Im8-kncUJVMHX40Mplb8QjbxD8whlnne9_2s8YODPs60P-bBW2TUMYdBNmCAlJWBfATdsSepD4paMLIFn1A21o9GEnoGiglDGsqgTqJe2ZO0wIyulRp5lG8duZRMhQDO_Ly1hvE73_QJsd-FLQ==) Kamala Harris and Tim Walz have the gall to campaign about “joy” while Americans still reel from the impacts of their destructive policies. **The Left is actually hoping we forget about what they did during COVID. Not a chance.** We need to call out their draconian COVID nonsense louder than ever before.

name: Team Harris-Walz
subject: Tough choices
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Harris for President
body:
This is one of the most important decision points of the campaign. | | |
---
We have some tough choices to make, and you need to know about them, Peter. It is hard to believe, but we are just days away from the first votes being cast in this election. And it goes without saying that we have to reach and convince persuadable voters before they turn in their ballots. **The choice we must make is this:** Can we expand our budgets a bit to reach voters we know we can flip in some of these states or do we just stick to the plan? We have received a historic number of donations to our campaign, and Kamala couldn't be more thankful. You might ask yourself: Why is the Virginia Attorney General, thousands of miles away at the Texas border?

It's simple, friend. _The border crisis has made every state a border state._

Thanks to the lawlessness spilling over our southern border, Virginia has been under threat from deadly fentanyl and violent crime.

Because of the Biden-Harris Administration's refusal to address the border, I've had to defend our Commonwealth by standing up to the President again and again. It's why I:
* Sued the Biden-Harris Administration when they attempted to **redefine some illegal crossings as "lawful pathways."**
* Filed a demand against the Biden-Harris Administration urging them to **end the catch-and-release program.**
* Joined with 26 other state attorneys general to **support Texas ' right to defend its own border.**
* Held the Biden-Harris Administration accountable for **losing track of tens of thousands of unaccompanied minors after they crossed the border.**
* Aggressively **prosecuted violent crimes** perpetrated by illegal migrants.
* __And I won 't stop fighting until our border is secure.__

**Securing our border is one of the SINGLE MOST important actions our federal government can take to secure public safety.** Do you agree, friend?

| Peter,

This week, many of you have received your property tax estimates in the mail. The frustration and anger are understandable — we never got the relief and reform promised by the legislature.

While the state continues to grow its surplus, hardworking North Dakotans are forced to stretch their paychecks even further.

Imagine what you could do with the money you are now paying in property taxes.

**At End Unfair Property Tax, our goal is simple** : replace the current property tax with existing state revenue, and change the method of local taxation to be more fair and transparent.

By doing this, we give YOU control of your hard-earned dollars while leaving local cities and counties fully in charge of their budgets.
**No services will be lost, and no revenue will be lost by the cities and counties.**

| **Unfortunately, politicians with bloated budgets and reckless spending habits continue to demand more from North Dakotans like you and me...**

This month's notice of estimated property tax reveals their inexcusable failure to provide real relief — forcing us to fund political pet projects that are often underutilized or ineffective.

If you refuse to pay, the government can and will take your home away.

In these hard economic times, when the cost of groceries and gasoline is already weighing heavily on families, property taxes are just another burden pushing North Dakotans to the brink. But we have a chance to change this.

**By voting YES on Measure #4 this November, we can end this unfair property tax system once and for all.**

Our proposition will allow you to keep more of your money year after year, while cities and counties continue to address their budgets using other revenue sources. This is not about cutting services. This is about fairness and giving North Dakotans relief from an outdated, unfair system.

But we can't do this alone. We need your help to spread the word, combat the misinformation being spread by those who want to maintain the status quo, and ensure we reach every North Dakotan before Election Day.

clean_body: Let’s make sure every North Dakotan knows that by voting YES on Measure #4, we can all keep more of our hard-earned money... | | | | | | | | Peter, This week, many of you have received your property tax estimates in the mail. The frustration and anger are understandable — we never got the relief and reform promised by the legislature. While the state continues to grow its surplus, hardworking North Dakotans are forced to stretch their paychecks even further. Imagine what you could do with the money you are now paying in property taxes. At End Unfair Property Tax, our goal is simple : replace the current property tax with existing state revenue, and change the method of local taxation to be more fair and transparent. By doing this, we give YOU control of your hard-earned dollars while leaving local cities and counties fully in charge of their budgets. No services will be lost, and no revenue will be lost by the cities and counties. | Unfortunately, politicians with bloated budgets and reckless spending habits continue to demand more from North Dakotans like you and me... This month's notice of estimated property tax reveals their inexcusable failure to provide real relief — forcing us to fund political pet projects that are often underutilized or ineffective. If you refuse to pay, the government can and will take your home away. In these hard economic times, when the cost of groceries and gasoline is already weighing heavily on families, property taxes are just another burden pushing North Dakotans to the brink. But we have a chance to change this. By voting YES on Measure #4 this November, we can end this unfair property tax system once and for all. Our proposition will allow you to keep more of your money year after year, while cities and counties continue to address their budgets using other revenue sources. This is not about cutting services. This is about fairness and giving North Dakotans relief from an outdated, unfair system. But we can't do this alone. We need your help to spread the word, combat the misinformation being spread by those who want to maintain the status quo, and ensure we reach every North Dakotan before Election Day. Help us combat the lies by selecting an option below and making a generous donation to our fight to END North Dakota’s unfair property tax today! This is our last opportunity to end the unfair property tax burden and shape a better North Dakota for ourselves and future generations. Let’s make sure every North Dakotan knows that by voting YES on Measure #4, we can all keep more of our hard-earned money. | | | Rick Becker Chairman End Unfair Property Tax | | | | | | | | | | Copyright (C) 2024 End Unfair Property Tax. # [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=1877%2E135344%2EjJQHmM)

Over the past month, since Vice President Harris became our presidential nominee, people have been asking me: what does this mean for winning Michigan?
Here’s what I’ve been saying: while we’ve undoubtedly seen a real surge of energy from Democrats on the ground, a fundamental truth remains — Michigan is a swing state, the 20% of independent voters are critical, and even the dynamic change of the ticket doesn’t change the basics.
And now, as the dust settles on the Democratic convention, we have new data to confirm it: polling conducted this week by the Detroit News and WDIV-TV shows Trump with a slight lead over Vice President Harris in Michigan:
Donald Trump: 44.7%
Kamala Harris: 43.5%
And with Michigan likely to be one of the few states – or even THE state – that decides the presidential election, it’s a reminder that we have a ton of work to do to make every day count between now and November 5th. The energy we’ve seen over the last month is not enough to take our foot off the gas. And winning here will take real work.
Because when a race is as close as this one, everything we do matters -- every ad that’s aired, every voter we talk to, every door we knock, and yes, every dollar we raise from people like you in response to emails like this.
And because our Senate race is next top of the ticket in November under the presidential race, our campaign will certainly affect the outcome of the presidential election in Michigan. And vice versa.
That’s especially true because I have a history of doing better in the redder parts of the state. Reaching those voters -- in places that haven’t seen a Democrat show up in 40 years -- impacts Democrats up and down the ticket.

ACROSS THE COMMONWEALTH
VOTE TODAY! [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP31/1/93159/images/Make%20A%20Plan%20To%20Vote.png]
You can vote for November's elections NOW! Vote at your Registrar's office during business hours. Saturday early voting is available October 28th and November 4th. Learn More [https://vote.elections.virginia.gov/VoterInformation/PublicContactLookup]
Find your local Registrar's office here: https://vote.elections.virginia.gov/VoterInformation/PublicContactLookup [https://vote.elections.virginia.gov/VoterInformation/PublicContactLookup]
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP31/1/93159/images/VWCC.jpeg] 15 years of the Community College Access Program at VWCC
Learn More [https://www.wdbj7.com/2023/09/26/virginia-western-celebrates-15th-anniversary-ccap-program/] CCAP is a successful public/private partnership that pays the cost of tuition for three years at Virginia Western Community College if a qualified student does not have sufficient financial aid to pay tuition costs.
This program has helped over 4,200 students achieve higher education!
CANDIDATE SPOTLIGHT
https://karenforvirginia.com/ [https://karenforvirginia.com/] Karen Jenkins for HB-89
Donate Here [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/karenforvirginia] Karen Jenkins is a life-long resident of the City of Suffolk. Throughout her lifetime she has passionately advocated for others and currently serves on the Suffolk School Board with a proven track record and history of accomplishments. She is running for the House of Delegates for the 89th District to continue delivering results for the people of Virginia.
She is a champion for education, public safety and mental health. As your next Delegate for the 89th District, she will continue to fight and vote for meaningful policies and legislation to support the needs of the district. At the state level, she will be positioned to write and sponsor bills and laws to benefit the schools and communities in the 89th District and throughout the commonwealth.
LOCAL CANDIDATE EVENTS

Canvass for Lily Franklin!
On Sundays, join Team Lily at the South County Library Parking Lot from 12 - 12:30 pm for a Roanoke canvassing event!
Bring your walking shoes, a charged cell phone, and water. When you arrive to their launch location you will receive a brief training and literature before being sent out to turf. Questions? Email Beth at egunter3@gmail.com [egunter3@gmail.com] or call 540-353-3645.
South County Library Parking Lot, 6303 Merriman Rd, Roanoke, VA 24018

Carilion Clinic vs. Lewis Gale Charity Softball Game - Oct. 1 Henrietta Lacks Statue Unveiling - Oct. 4
Join us for the 6th Annual Carilion Clinic vs. Lewis Gale Charity Softball Game, being held at the Home of the Salem Red Sox - Carilion Clinic Field. A dignified sculpture will commemorate the ongoing and long unrecognized contributions of Roanoke native Henrietta Lacks, who unknowingly provided the world with the HeLa cell, fueling decades of life-saving and life changing research.
Physicians, nurses and administrators will suit up for each hospital during the nine-inning contest. Proceeds will benefit the American Heart Association. Unveiling is October 4th at 11 am at Henrietta Lacks Plaza.
Admission is $5 at the gate, kids under 10 free. Gates open at 1pm and the game starts at 2pm. 410 3rd St SW, Roanoke, VA 24011

[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP31/1/93159/images/RCDC.jpeg] Join the Roanoke City Democrats!
Roanoke City Democratic Committee meetings are now in-person and open to non-members. We meet the 3rd Thursday of each month. This month we are meeting at 6 pm at the Main Library (706 S Jefferson St, Roanoke, VA 24016). Sign up for meeting reminders and other information here [https://www.roanokedemocrats.com/subscribe] .
Join us for a social hour every first Thursday of the month at Leonore Restaurant, 128 Campbell St. SW, 5-7 pm.
Join Roanoke Young Dems! [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP31/1/93159/images/RYD.png]
Meetings occur on the first Monday and third Sunday of every month in person and virtually. The goal of RYD is to help improve our community and to promote the names of Democratic candidates and policies.
Contact: YoungDemocratsRoanoke@gmail.com [YoungDemocratsRoanoke@gmail.com] to get involved!
Donate Today! [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/samrasoul]
Thank you for your support! If you have any questions, please do not hesitate to reach out to me anytime.
My very best,

| Stand Up Against Unjust Gun Legislation - Join the Fight!
---
---
| Dear Patriots,
We have a crucial opportunity to halt a dangerous bill, thanks to the vigilance of a dedicated group of civil liberties defenders. With your support, we can make a significant impact.
In July, Maura Healey signed a gun bill that defies reason. This legislation is filled with burdensome restrictions that unfairly target law-abiding gun owners, rather than addressing the real issue of crime. You and I both understand that this bill does nothing to enhance public safety.
Toby Leary from Cape Gun Works is spearheading a repeal petition to challenge this overreach. To learn how you can contribute, please join an informational Zoom call sponsored by the MassGOP on Thursday at 6:00 p.m. or Tuesday at 7:00 p.m.
For more details on the repeal effort, visit thecivilrightscoalition.com or fightbackma.org. Zoom Links:

* [Thursday at 6:00 p.m.](https://qgzxgy5ab.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001XX994dK0ZKd3Ebv37OsJiIGukD2cPFKbWqH9mGq46QWVv223LKtZZdriR_8XsO0BQ2XxR4VLtIaacdKcBlVJXAeyjyzD9N7xUyG75X38giPI9IOeF9sJ3qQFvCt-gvPylqHDuNKeIaCqSg9mNvxRqoqGrBaftpkHOp9TnIHM9cI2vJt9Iri1IoDPaTzcHynjm6bTWa6be9r7K6XujMqcejB2lHfwTqeM&c=CaQDG5TxwNLfAKt9ijnOwPV2jG9VLAwltZpudxeIRnTBgb6kbngAjw==&ch=7LbtNAvyMLODoR0FMBqrq5sUPgHBdd7UPtnm2wjC9uNyD-VbrYKRog==)
* [Tuesday at 7:00 p.m.](https://qgzxgy5ab.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001XX994dK0ZKd3Ebv37OsJiIGukD2cPFKbWqH9mGq46QWVv223LKtZZdriR_8XsO0BSFRnK7nZNayFePnCtXEcnX6xIyJBQHncjPvFFRPLTCIc4e3W9_kjhj730Kywvoy6kS2iCXlvhTcYmZtwwL-MKBuS8QcEARtBGiItF2VNL-EKrRls2eIsExtbDrInGsq1Cb-PH6-CzrACsiZeKqa6dZWIArPTbYBF&c=CaQDG5TxwNLfAKt9ijnOwPV2jG9VLAwltZpudxeIRnTBgb6kbngAjw==&ch=7LbtNAvyMLODoR0FMBqrq5sUPgHBdd7UPtnm2wjC9uNyD-VbrYKRog==)

Peter,

On Wednesday morning, Apalachee High School suffered a horrific shooting where four lives were tragically cut short and many more were injured.

We cannot begin to wrap our heads around another senseless and preventable school shooting unfolding, especially within our own state. We mourn the lives lost in yesterday’s devastating events, and our hearts break for all the students, families, and faculty impacted by this tragedy.

Our students should not have to fear for their lives when they walk into their classrooms. They should not have to attend the funerals of their peers whose lives were cut short by a gunman in their school. They should not have to endure the trauma of a school shooting or anguish that they could be next.

Our children must be protected. We cannot fail them again.

Our heartbreak is not enough to prevent another tragedy like this from occurring again. Apalachee High School is the 45th school to suffer from a shooting in 2024 alone.

Georgians need immediate, urgent action to improve gun safety measures. We must rid our communities of gun violence, and push for legislation that ensures what happened on Wednesday will never happen again.

I understand you may be feeling powerless right now, Peter. But, I urge you to turn some of your grief into action and honor the souls we lost yesterday by fighting for our children’s tomorrow.

Voting in this election has never been more dire. So, Peter, when you fill out your ballot this Fall, remember Apalachee High School and the countless lives forever changed on the morning of Wednesday, September 4th.

Never again.

Kevin
Executive Director
Democratic Party of Georgia

name: GIFFORDS
subject: Back-to-school season shouldn’t be like this
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Giffords PAC; not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee
body:
The crisis of school shootings is a uniquely American epidemic. But it doesn’t have to be this way.
#

Friends -
We are not just devastated by yesterday’s mass shooting at Apalachee High School in Winder, Georgia. We are angry.
It should outrage all of us that yesterday in Georgia, kids and teachers died at school. And that students who survived shared on TV how they didn’t even cry because it felt “normal” that someone might bring a gun to school and shoot their classmates. There’s nothing normal about what happened yesterday.
It should outrage us that teachers in America go to work with the fear of getting shot, and that during their back-to-school training they have to learn how to barricade their classroom doors with desks and chairs to keep a shooter from entering.
It should outrage us that parents send their children to school every day afraid they may not come home.
The crisis of school shootings is a uniquely American epidemic. But it doesn’t have to be this way. There are commonsense solutions—such as universal background checks, extreme risk protection orders, and safe storage laws—that can prevent further tragedies like the one we saw yesterday in Georgia.
But to make change happen, we must elect leaders who put our safety over gun lobby profits.
Today marks two months until Election Day. That means we have two months left to make sure we maintain our slim gun safety majority in the Senate, take back the House of Representatives, and make sure that we elect Kamala Harris, a proven gun safety champion, as our next president.
[**So please: Can we count on you to make a contribution to GIFFORDS PAC today? We need you with us to fuel our work towards a future where we finally have freedom from gun violence.**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-sep24.n7q8o5&refcode=em240905-1-30&t=1&akid=8864%2E3935704%2E7m3IDe)

But to make change happen, we must elect leaders who put our safety over gun lobby profits. Today marks two months until Election Day. Hi folks,
I send you a lot of emails about the stakes of this election, and today is no different – but this time, it’s not about my own race.
This week marks the start of the DCCC’s Red Alert program, which identifies and highlights the Red to Blue candidates (who are trying to flip seats) and the Frontline members (incumbent House Democrats) running in some of the most competitive races across the country .
The program is designed to help folks channel their support to the races that need it most – and I’m sharing this with you because I know how much you care about helping Democrats take back the House majority.
These candidates are working around the clock to get their message out to voters to win in November and deliver for the American people in Congress. But they can’t do it alone. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/2024_redalert_1?refcode=sj]
Here are the details on 10 candidates who need our help today:
Red to Blue candidates Amish Shah (AZ-01) and Carl Marlinga (MI-10) recently came out of competitive primaries and urgently need resources to build up a strong general election campaign in these final weeks.
New Hampshire's primary election is coming up on September 10 – the latest primary of any state – where three Republicans are vying to take on Rep. Chris Pappas (NH-01) in the general election. With the high cost of communicating in the Boston media market, Rep. Pappas needs support to make sure he has the resources to run an aggressive general election campaign as soon as the primary is over.
Shomari Figures (AL-02), Rep. Val Hoyle (OR-04), and Rep. Andrea Salinas (OR-06) are facing dark money being poured into their districts by Republican super PACs, and they need our help fighting back.
Republicans have already spent almost $2 million in south Texas supporting an anti-choice extremist – just this week, Republicans started reserving broadcast television for negative attacks against Rep. Vicente Gonzalez’s (TX-34). He needs support to get on the air and communicate his message to South Texans.
Derek Tran (CA-45), Curtis Hertel (MI-07), and Laura Gillen (NY-04 ) are running their races in some of the most expensive media markets in the country . They need to be able to get their message out and compete against right-wing, extremist attacks.
The DCCC Red Alert candidates need resources today. These are candidates in incredibly competitive districts where your support will have an immediate impact, so I’m asking:
Will you make a contribution today, split between these 10 Democratic candidates? You can donate to all 10 of these races at once by following this link. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/2024_redalert_1?refcode=sj]
If we all come together to support these candidates running in some of the toughest races in the country, I know we can reach more voters, get out our key messages, increase turnout, and take back the House majority.
Thank you for all you do — and for taking the time to read this update and support these great Democrats!
-Sara Jacobs

Peter -
In the last few weeks we’ve seen more spending pour into Arizona than at any other time in this race.
We’re now tracking $24 million total in opposition spend on television, and that’s not counting digital advertisements or radio.
Two weeks ago Trump said he needed to win in Arizona to win the presidency, and that he needed Kari Lake with him. In the two weeks since, the entire right has taken notice. This is an absolutely relentless expansion with no signs that it’s slowing down.
And now, we’re seeing the effects. The most recent poll from CNN put Trump as a strong favorite in Arizona, and after weeks of big leads our U.S. Senate race has narrowed to well within the margin of error.
It’s not looking good, but we’ve got one shot at holding on. If this team steps up to the plate now, same as you always have, we’ll raise what we need to stand against Trump and Lake.

# Hello Peter!
---
| I hope you enjoyed your Labor Day as much as I did. This Labor Day, we celebrated the strength and solidarity of unions at the annual Labor Day Picnic in Eugene, reinforcing our shared values and commitment to workers' rights.
Our team has been busy door knocking and we’re about to start rapidly expanding where we’re hosting canvassing events.
And we're just getting started! We’re excited to announce the launch of our first round of ads, spreading our campaign message across the district.
Read below to see where we’ll be hosting volunteer events, the exciting events we have coming, and where to watch our new ad.
---
|
---
|
# Volunteer Opportunities
We have several exciting volunteer opportunities coming up, and we would love for you to be a part of them. Whether you have a few hours to spare or can commit to helping on a regular schedule, your help is invaluable to us.
**Canvasses** Help engage voters for the 2024 election through direct conversations about what is at stake this election. This is a great way to engage with your local community and help spread our campiagn’s message.
**Springfield Canvass with State Representative John Lively**
* Date and Time: Saturday September 7th at 11am
* Location: Jack B Lively Memorial Park 6100 Thurston Rd[Springfield, OR 97478](https://valhoyle.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=13266237d3ed15f5b786956d9&id=1de0715b92&e=9659e2eb5e)

**Florence Canvass with State Senate Candidate Jo Beaudreau**
* Date and Time: Saturday September 7th at 11am
* Location: Florence Senior Center 1570 Kingwood St [Florence, OR 97439](https://valhoyle.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=13266237d3ed15f5b786956d9&id=1ec2e25e3b&e=9659e2eb5e)

**Corvallis Canvass**
* Date and Time: Every Saturday and Sunday at 10:00am
* Location: Benton County Democrats Headquarters, 427 SW Madison Ave, Suite D, Corvallis, OR 97333

**Eugene Canvass**
* Date and Time: Every Saturday and Sunday at 10:00am
* Location: IAFF Firefighters Union Hall, 160 Madison St, Eugene, OR 97402

**Phone banking for Volunteers** Help our campaign recruit more volunteers by joining our phone bank. We’ll be reaching out to past volunteers and ask them to get involved this cycle.
* Date and Time: Every Wednesday at 6:00pm
* Location: Zoom-RVSP for the link!

| Our campaign recently launched an ad highlighting the story of Mariah, a single mom about to finish her apprenticeship as a pipefitter with UA 290. Since starting her education at an apprenticeship and working in the pipe trades, she’s quadrupled her income. These are exactly the kinds of job training programs that I led the fight to expand in Oregon. I will continue working to expand apprenticeships and invest in our community colleges so that we can create more good-paying jobs and grow the middle class in our state.
But I can't do this work without you. This is going to be a tough race with so much at stake this election. Together we can protect the freedoms we all believe in.
Sincerely,

Read below to see where we’ll be hosting volunteer events, the exciting events we have coming, and where to watch our new ad. | | Volunteer Opportunities We have several exciting volunteer opportunities coming up, and we would love for you to be a part of them. Whether you have a few hours to spare or can commit to helping on a regular schedule, your help is invaluable to us. Canvasses Help engage voters for the 2024 election through direct conversations about what is at stake this election. This is a great way to engage with your local community and help spread our campiagn’s message. Springfield Canvass with State Representative John Lively Date and Time: Saturday September 7th at 11am Location: Jack B Lively Memorial Park 6100 Thurston Rd Florence Canvass with State Senate Candidate Jo Beaudreau Date and Time: Saturday September 7th at 11am Location: Florence Senior Center 1570 Kingwood St Corvallis Canvass Date and Time: Every Saturday and Sunday at 10:00am Location: Benton County Democrats Headquarters, 427 SW Madison Ave, Suite D, Corvallis, OR 97333 Eugene Canvass Date and Time: Every Saturday and Sunday at 10:00am Location: IAFF Firefighters Union Hall, 160 Madison St, Eugene, OR 97402 Phone banking for Volunteers Help our campaign recruit more volunteers by joining our phone bank. We’ll be reaching out to past volunteers and ask them to get involved this cycle. Date and Time: Every Wednesday at 6:00pm Location: Zoom-RVSP for the link! | | Upcoming Events Kamala Harris Debate Watch Parties Benton County Debate Watch Party with the Benton County Democrats Date and Time: Tuesday September 10th at 5:30pm Location: Woodstock’s Pizza Parlor Woodstock's Pizza Parlor 1045 NW Kings Blvd | Lane County Debate Watch Party with the Democratic Party of Lane County Date and Time: Tuesday September 10th at 5:30pm Location: IAFF Firefighters Union Hall, 160 Madison St, Eugene, OR 97402 | | Lawn Signs If you would like a Val Hoyle Lawn Sign, you can either pick one up in person from your local County Democratic Party Headquarters or you can sign up on our website for one. | | Message from the Congresswoman | Our campaign recently launched an ad highlighting the story of Mariah, a single mom about to finish her apprenticeship as a pipefitter with UA 290. Since starting her education at an apprenticeship and working in the pipe trades, she’s quadrupled her income. These are exactly the kinds of job training programs that I led the fight to expand in Oregon. I will continue working to expand apprenticeships and invest in our community colleges so that we can create more good-paying jobs and grow the middle class in our state. But I can't do this work without you. This is going to be a tough race with so much at stake this election. Together we can protect the freedoms we all believe in. | | | Former GOP representative Liz Cheney -- one of the few Republicans left with any guts or moral fiber -- just announced that she endorses Kamala Harris, and will vote for her in November. [**Please join us in thanking her.**](https://default.salsalabs.org/T868b50de-2cd4-4454-a3dc-3433d82d64f2/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) _" Because of the danger that Donald Trump poses, not only am I not voting for Donald Trump, but I will be voting for Kamala Harris," Cheney said in a video of remarks posted to X. The university separately provided a clip of Cheney's remarks to NBC News...__The former congresswoman said in her remarks that it is "crucially important" for people to understand that people do not have "the luxury of writing in candidates' names, particularly in swing states." ([source](https://default.salsalabs.org/T37e08a19-45e4-42f6-ab8f-37dc9b2833ed/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9))_ We may disagree with her on just about every issue, but it took guts for her to stand up to Trump -- and hardly any other Republican did. in the US Senate.

Wisconsin’s elections are historically some of the closest in the country.

In 2022, Republican Ron Johnson won the Senate race here by just 1% after
the GOP poured $77 million toward reelecting him.

The last two presidential elections were decided by even less than that.

Our elections come down to the wire here in Wisconsin, and this year’s
Senate race is shaping up to be no different.

Tammy is statistically tied with her right-wing opponent, and she needs
your help to break through the tens of millions of dollars Eric Hovde and
his GOP allies have poured into Wisconsin to flip this seat red.

seat? Every donation makes a difference in a race as close as this one.

_The Epoch Times_ is a far-right news outlet known for spreading anti-vaccine misinformation and 2020 election conspiracies. They spent more money on advertising for Donald Trump in 2020 than any organization outside the Trump campaign.
**You may have seen their bizarre “#1 trusted news” billboards popping up in cities nationwide:**

This year hasn't been all good for _The Epoch Times_. In June, the Department of Justice indicted the Chief Financial Officer at The Epoch Times in a multinational $67 million money laundering scheme. **The scheme boosted revenues at The Epoch Times by about 410%, and some of those dollars went directly to efforts to re-elect Trump in 2020.**
While the DOJ has been working on the case, The Epoch Times has been up and running, and most importantly, _growing_ rapidly.
In April, _The Epoch Times_ announced its goal to support a new journalism school in the same city as its HQ. The outlet said the school would champion _The Epoch Times_ ’ values of “truth and traditional.” They’ve even promised internships and jobs to promising graduates at the outlet and its sister network, _NTD_ , an equally right-wing and conspiratorial television news station.
In August, they released their movie “The Firing Squad,” a drama starring Cuba Gooding Jr. about drug smugglers who find God behind bars. This move into faith-based films aims to tap into a lucrative market, which conservative filmmakers claim counters Hollywood’s “liberal” agenda.
**The _New York Times_ has already called _The Epoch Times_ “one of the country’s most powerful digital publishers.” If any of their new ventures succeed, their influence will only grow.**

Peter, Pramila sat down for an interview with PBS during the Democratic convention, and they asked whether the Harris-Walz ticket is “progressive enough.” Here’s what she had to say:
**“Perfection may not be on the ballot, but real progress is.** There’s no question that we can organize towards better policy under a Harris/Walz campaign. **Her focus on housing, raising taxes on the wealthiest corporations, the care economy, paid leave.** **And, of course, our freedoms.** The freedom to vote, the freedom to make choices about our own body. **These are critical issues.”**

AOC, another member of the House Progressive Caucus, was right last week when she said progressives have a **moral obligation to be effective** in advancing our agenda. Right now, making sure Kamala Harris and Tim Walz win this election is the best way to do that.

We love having you in our network, but if you no longer wish to hear from us, you can[unsubscribe here](https://default.salsalabs.org/T6558572b-2280-4015-b022-9e9fa33ecfae/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)._
---
| I don’t want to give it too much attention, Peter, but Trump spoke in Arizona twice last month, including one time with my opponent, Kari Lake, at a rally in Phoenix. He laid out his cynical and divisive worldview for the millionth time. He spoke about his extreme, radical, dangerous agenda. And he put us — our campaign — square in the middle of his warpath. He attacked me multiple times, said I "shouldn't even be allowed to run." But most importantly, he said if he wins in Arizona he wins the presidency. He said it himself: He has to go straight through us to have any chance at winning this November. But I’ve got a message for him: Show some respect. [](https://default.salsalabs.org/T5f423111-7bff-4b91-8113-7ae75a5e01b2/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) After years of attacking and insulting veterans like John McCain, or Gold Star Parents like the Khans, the fallen of Belleau Wood, even Medal of Honor recipients — show some respect for the military, for veterans, and for our families. We’ve got your number, Donald. And we will not let you win. This election is going to come down to Trump and Lake versus you and me, Peter. Can I count on you to have my back as I take the fight to them from now until November? [If you’re still with me, please, make a split $25 donation with Blue Amp Action and support our work out in Arizona. This will be one of the closest states in the country, and we need everyone on board and doing everything we can to win here. ](https://default.salsalabs.org/T46a1faec-77b8-4886-b5af-e80240532459/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
| | Colorado Parents & Grandparents,
I have an important “to do" for you today (Thursday, Sept 5). Can you come to the Ralph Carr Justice Center at 11am? It’s a critical opportunity to show up in a BIG way for mothers and children, rallying around one of the most important issues of our time, the protection of our children from abuse. Read more [here](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) or below.
This is the Mountain Minute for Thursday, September 5, 2024.
– Heidi Ganahl
---
|
---
| | **TODAY'S TOP STORIES**
---
**[A Broken System: The Fight to Protect Our Children from Our Own Family Courts](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY HEIDI GANAHL, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
Colorado Parents and Grandparents, I have an important “to do" for you today (Thursday, Sept 5). **[Can you come to the Ralph Carr Justice Center at 11am?](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
It’s a critical opportunity to show up in a BIG way for mothers and children, rallying around one of the most important issues of our time, the protection of our children from abuse.
One of my dear friends, Maralee McLean, is speaking about her daughter’s journey, her journey, and you won’t want to miss it. I met Maralee after I founded a non-profit called Moms Fight Back in 2013, to deal with the toughest issues we face as Moms, protecting our children from abuse, after my own daughter was sexually assaulted and treated horribly by our justice system. Maralee sat with me over coffee and told her story, her shocking, incredibly painful story, that will bring you to tears.
She showed me hundreds of messages on her phone from other mothers around the country, around the world, dealing with the same pain and horrible injustice she was, for simply believing their children and fighting for them.
Thirty years ago, Maralee embarked on a battle that no mother should ever have to fight. Her daughter, then just two years old, was being sexually abused by her father, Maralee’s abusive ex-husband, and despite overwhelming evidence—police reports, doctor’s records, and expert testimony—she was punished instead of protected. The more information that surfaced about the abuse, the more the court gave custody to the father.
Maralee was caught in a web of a broken system that continues to fail protective mothers today.
McLean, like so many protective mothers, became a casualty of a family court system that too often dismisses the voices of children and their mothers. She fought in courtrooms, draining her finances and spirit, to regain custody of her daughter. But her fight didn’t end when her daughter came home years later. McLean turned her pain into advocacy, working tirelessly to reform a system that repeatedly fails to protect the most vulnerable among us: our children.
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|

**[Colorado School District Had Trans-Identifying Female Supervise Young Boys Showering, Lawsuit Alleges](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [DAILY WIRE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Jefferson County School District has been assigning students on overnight trips rooms based on gender identity rather than biological sex, a policy not fully disclosed to parents or students.
* Parents, concerned about the lack of transparency and potential risks posed by the policy, have taken legal action against the district, arguing it infringes on parental rights and students' privacy, represented by [Alliance Defending Freedom](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.).
* The lawsuit highlights cases where students felt uncomfortable due to these assignments, including an 18-year-old trans-identifying female supervising young boys, and a young girl required to share a bed with a trans-identifying boy, without prior parental knowledge.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Legal filing aimed at compelling Colorado to ensure valid election](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* United Sovereign Americans, through the Colorado 2024 Election Project led by Kim Monson, has filed legal actions to ensure the 2024 Colorado election is conducted legally and transparently, targeting issues like "undeliverable" ballots.
* The initiative claims support across a wide political spectrum in Colorado, including moderate Democrats, Republicans, and various minor party affiliates, emphasizing the need for a fair and transparent electoral process.
* The project has raised $100,000 to fund its initial legal steps and has partnered with individuals like Peter Bernegger and Jay Valentine to address potential issues with inaccurate ballot mailing addresses, estimating around 143,000 could be affected.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Fabbricatore to be joined Thursday at Aurora rally for border security by U.S. Reps Boebert, Roy](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* John Fabbricatore, reacting to Governor Jared Polis's [dismissal of gang activities as "imagination,"](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) confirmed the presence of the Venezuelan gang Tren de Aragua in Aurora, using his social media as a tip line.
* Fabbricatore, along with U.S. Reps Lauren Boebert and Chip Roy, plans to discuss border security, the fight against fentanyl, and enhancing public safety at a rally in Aurora. This event aims to highlight their collective efforts in addressing these critical issues.
* Fabbricatore, a former regional director of ICE, is running for the U.S. House in Colorado’s 6th District against Democrat Rep. Jason Crow. His campaign focuses on immigration enforcement and border security, leveraging his background and support from prominent Republicans like Boebert, who emphasizes the importance of a secure southern border.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Libertarian Joss withdraws from 8th District race, endorses Evans in bid to unseat Caraveo](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Libertarian nominee Eric Joss has withdrawn from the 8th District U.S. House race to endorse Republican Gabe Evans, potentially swinging the vote by 2% or more.
* Evans has committed to the Liberty Pledge 2.0, signaling his support for key libertarian issues, though he stopped short of agreeing to abolish the intelligence community.
* The endorsement comes as part of a broader strategy to unite Republicans and Libertarians against Democrat Yadira Caraveo, whom Joss criticized for closely aligning with President Joe Biden's policies.
* Both Evans and Joss emphasized their shared commitment to reducing government size and spending. Evans highlighted their agreement on 90% of issues and stressed the importance of bipartisan dialogue and cooperation to address constituents' needs effectively.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[4 dead, one in custody in shooting at Apalachee H.S. in Barrow County, Ga., sources say](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [FOX NEWS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* A 14-year-old boy opened fire at Apalachee High School in Barrow County, Georgia, resulting in four deaths and nine other people hospitalized with gunshot wounds. The young suspect is now in custody and will be charged and tried as an adult for murder.
* Multiple law enforcement agencies responded to the shooting, which put the school on lockdown. The Georgia Bureau of Investigation is leading a "very, very fluid investigation" to uncover more details about the incident, which may take several days to resolve fully.
* President Biden and Vice President Harris expressed deep condolences and reiterated the urgency of addressing gun violence in America, with Biden calling for renewed efforts to pass gun safety legislation.

[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
|
---
**[Democrats want to keep the U.S. border wide open as an electoral strategy](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [THE FEDERALIST](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Democrats, including Vice President Kamala Harris, favor policies that would legalize the status of illegal immigrants already in the U.S., a stance exemplified by support for comprehensive immigration reform and mass amnesty.
* The Democratic party historically views immigration as a means to bolster their electoral base, believing that immigrants will predominantly vote Democratic, a strategy discussed openly in political analyses like the 2002 book "The Emerging Democratic Majority."
* Deep blue states have been pushing to allow illegal immigrants to vote in local and state elections, and efforts are ongoing to simplify the voter registration process for noncitizens, reflecting a long-term strategy to transform the electorate.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|

**[Jack: Initiative 138 reminds us to beware of the Greeks, even those bearing gifts](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY BILL JACK, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
_Once again, the nanny state is seeking to invade the jurisdiction of parents and the family. This time, however, government overreach is cleverly disguised as a gift to parents._
_Initiative 138, appearing on this November’s ballot, allegedly guarantees parents will always have the right to direct the education of their children through school choice. Read the fine print and you will see the threat hidden within the gift. These words will be added to the Colorado Constitution: “Each K-12 child has the right to school choice.” Those words are the Trojan Horse that mask an invasion by a hostile state into parental rights. What appears to be the surrender by the state to parental rights hides within its belly the invasion of state control of the family._
_Since children at the tender age of 12 are considered capable in Colorado of making life-changing decisions concerning sex with the support of the state, but without the consent or knowledge of their parents, it is no stretch of the imagination to consider that the state will determine whether a child is receiving a “quality education” and enforce the state’s definition of such on the family._

It’s a critical opportunity to show up in a BIG way for mothers and children, rallying around one of the most important issues of our time, the protection of our children from abuse. One of my dear friends, Maralee McLean, is speaking about her daughter’s journey, her journey, and you won’t want to miss it. I met Maralee after I founded a non-profit called Moms Fight Back in 2013, to deal with the toughest issues we face as Moms, protecting our children from abuse, after my own daughter was sexually assaulted and treated horribly by our justice system. Maralee sat with me over coffee and told her story, her shocking, incredibly painful story, that will bring you to tears. She showed me hundreds of messages on her phone from other mothers around the country, around the world, dealing with the same pain and horrible injustice she was, for simply believing their children and fighting for them. Thirty years ago, Maralee embarked on a battle that no mother should ever have to fight. Her daughter, then just two years old, was being sexually abused by her father, Maralee’s abusive ex-husband, and despite overwhelming evidence—police reports, doctor’s records, and expert testimony—she was punished instead of protected. The more information that surfaced about the abuse, the more the court gave custody to the father. Maralee was caught in a web of a broken system that continues to fail protective mothers today. McLean, like so many protective mothers, became a casualty of a family court system that too often dismisses the voices of children and their mothers. She fought in courtrooms, draining her finances and spirit, to regain custody of her daughter. But her fight didn’t end when her daughter came home years later. | | | **Support Our Campaign on the International Day of Charity**
---

Dear Peter,
Today, as we observe the International Day of Charity, we are reminded of the power of generosity and the importance of giving back to our communities. Here in Washington’s 8th Congressional District, we believe in the strength of compassionate conservatism – policies that empower individuals and communities to thrive through personal responsibility, economic opportunity, and strong family values.

Our campaign is dedicated to supporting the principles that enable charitable organizations and individuals to make a difference. We advocate for lower taxes, reduced regulations, and policies that allow charitable organizations to flourish and serve those in need more effectively.

On this International Day of Charity, we ask for your support to continue this important work.

---
| | | |
---
| Your donation to our campaign will help us fight for the values that sustain our community and ensure that everyone has the opportunity to contribute to the greater good.

Whether it’s $20, $50, or any amount, your contribution will make a meaningful impact. Together, we can build a stronger, more compassionate district where charity and community service thrive.

---

Team Goers

Thursday, September 05, 2024 | Peter -- _Breaking News Out of Utah - We're Fighting Back Against a Power Grab_ In a move that would curtail voter rights, Utah's Republican-controlled Legislature plans to ask citizens in the November election to grant lawmakers the power to alter or repeal state ballot measures after they have been approved.
Spurred by a [recent state Supreme Court ruling](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=rtTPSgvEp6UWncw5WXVsjEO-pY6qh4f5kKjxA9KAY7iKvXQwKjuk6DGXszgAfnydJCDAKyOitz1pK8QRnQWUPEAtdHz1p2zbdMWJkV-hwR17ShrE3sDkb9gDEwjHes0LppsK0b0Tx7gIN0dTGDfDfEn1uuX3GOqCIxvs0HvhUBN5R1l2Cp_j_mmr2ORsN7lh&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=a_fast_forward_50&n=2) that revived an anti-gerrymandering lawsuit, lawmakers hastily convened a special session on August 21st, where both legislative chambers swiftly approved a constitutional amendment expanding the Legislature's control over citizen initiatives. Invoking their broadly defined emergency powers, the Legislature called this special session to push through the amendment. If a majority of Utah voters endorse the measure this fall, it would grant lawmakers the constitutional authority to significantly rewrite or entirely repeal voter-approved ballot initiatives. **Fortunately, Forward and the Utah Forward Party are fighting back.** The state party, along with all FWD-endorsed candidates, including Michelle Quist, Miles Pomeroy, and Laura Johnson, are helping lead a **Vote No campaign** to defeat the amendment at the ballot box this November. Folks,
Opponents of voting rights in the U.S. House are attempting to pass the " Safeguard American Voter Eligibility (SAVE) Act ," a last-minute bill requiring proof of citizenship to vote in federal elections. Never mind that it is already against federal law for non-citizens to vote.
This proposal is nothing more than a blatant voter suppression tactic aimed at disenfranchising vulnerable communities , particularly minorities and low-income voters, who may struggle to produce the necessary documentation. Vote suppressors are using the ongoing government shutdown negotiations as leverage to push this harmful legislation through Congress.
Voting rights experts have sounded the alarm on this bill, warning that it could lead to widespread disenfranchisement. The nonpartisan Brennan Center for Justice highlighted that proof-of-citizenship requirements disproportionately affect naturalized citizens , who may be wrongly removed from voter rolls due to outdated or incorrect data. This bill would make it significantly harder for these legal citizens to participate in our democracy, all under the guise of "election integrity."
Sign our petition now: Demand that Congress act now to stop this dangerous legislation! >> [https://actionnetwork.org/petitions/reject-republicans-last-minute-voter-suppression-scheme-2?source=direct_link&referrer=group-integrity-first-voter-action-project&redirect=https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-actions]

By signing this petition, you're telling Congress to reject the SAVE Act and protect the voting rights of every American. We need to stand up against these voter suppression tactics and ensure that our democracy remains inclusive and fair.

Through his relentless work ethic and untamable entrepreneurial spirit, he turned the first car dealership that he purchased in 2005 into one of the largest dealership groups in America.

In 2016, Bernie recognized the value and transformational potential of blockchain technology, before it received mainstream attention, and moved much of his volunteer time and investment dollars into the space. In 2018 he co-founded ChampTitles, which grew to be quite successful as Bernie served as Chairman of the Board.

After a long, successful career, Bernie sold most of his business to begin focusing on his calling: protecting the American dream for another generation.

Solving our country’s problems requires common sense. In Washington, Bernie will fight to shrink government, protect our freedoms, stop the Chinese Communist party from taking our data and land, and always put America First.

Our Democratic base is fired up, and we’re dominating with women voters on both sides of the aisle because we’re the clear champions of women’s rights.
Independents and working-class voters are swinging our way in a big way.

Jon Tester’s DC allies are trying to carpet-bomb Montana with their out-of-state money and outrageous lies about me, my family, and my character. It is outrageous. My attacks on Tester are about his voting record, failure to lead, and allegiance to Democrat elites before the voters who put him in office. James Carville and Jon Tester know they can’t win on the truth, so they are trying to win on outright lies. Friend,
I hate doing this.
To be clear, I am loving almost every aspect of this campaign so far. I love talking about the issues. I love talking about my plans to move our community forward. I love getting out and meeting you and hearing what you want from our Congress.
But the one part of campaigning that I can’t stand is asking for money. I’m running to serve and support you, not the other way around.
Our current system is a joke. Instead of hearing from the people, politicians go from donor to donor, catering to the rich instead of the masses.
Sadly, raising money is a necessity in our current political system. In order to win, we need to be able to buy ad time, send mailers, and spread word about our campaign. And that takes money.
This a race is tightening, and we can’t afford to fall behind on fundraising. If you could donate anything you can spare to our campaign, it would be greatly appreciated. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/dan-ruby--friends-of-1?refcode=h8this]

Hi, this is Adam Schiff.

In a moment, I'm going to explain why we must do everything we can to protect the Democratic Senate majority this November, but first, **[will you pitch in $5 to the Democratic Senatorial Campaign Committee?](https://go.dscc.org/go/18983?amount=5&t=4&firstname=&lastname=&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&addr1=&addr2=&city=Cresco&state=Pennsylvania&zip=18326&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&ask=5&amounts=5%2C10%2C20%2C50&code=DPE-FD-20240905-AdamSchiff-SchiffSignedFR1-Pros-sl1&refcode=DPE-FD-20240905-AdamSchiff-SchiffSignedFR1-Pros-sl1&akid=17107%2E9716520%2EhJrvN3)**

Many of Donald Trump's biggest enablers are sitting in the United States Senate.

Where they attempted to overturn the results of the 2020 election, abetting a deadly insurrection on January 6th.

Where they fought tooth and nail against sensible and desperately needed pandemic relief.

Where they tried to get rid of health care for millions of Americans. Again and again.

Where they acquitted Trump not once, but twice in his Senate impeachment trials — paving the way for the scorched earth presidential campaign he's running right now.

And where we need a strong Democratic Senate majority to stand up for our democracy.

**[Chip in to the DSCC to help them defend our majority. We have to hold the Senate this November. We just _have_ to.](https://go.dscc.org/go/18983?amount=5&t=6&firstname=&lastname=&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&addr1=&addr2=&city=Cresco&state=Pennsylvania&zip=18326&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&ask=5&amounts=5%2C10%2C20%2C50&code=DPE-FD-20240905-AdamSchiff-SchiffSignedFR1-Pros-sl1&refcode=DPE-FD-20240905-AdamSchiff-SchiffSignedFR1-Pros-sl1&akid=17107%2E9716520%2EhJrvN3)**

Folks like Ted Cruz, Josh Hawley, Lindsey Graham, and Rick Scott have all stood strong alongside the former president, no matter how many times he has been criminally indicted or how outrageous his statements are.

No matter what Donald Trump says or does, GOP senators will stand behind him at campaign rallies or the court house, cheering him on and promising to support his radical MAGA agenda from the Senate.

**Folks, some of the toughest fights to defend our democracy — and make it stronger — are going to take place in the United States Senate. And we need a strong Democratic Senate majority to restore reproductive freedom, make the economy work for everyone, and protect our institutions and our Constitution.**

Because the truth is, with Donald Trump on the ballot, we need to stand strong in defense of our free and fair elections, affordable health care, a green economy, and so much more.

We need to elect and re-elect Democrats across the country.

| | Hi Friend,
---
Today is a special day.
---
It marks the anniversary of our 1st Congressional District special election primary in 2023. It was a night of hope, joy, and opportunity about what was to come. As I stated that night, it was an affirmation of our shared story: that our tomorrows can be better than today with some hard work, grit, resilience, and determination.
---
Once again, we have another election on the horizon.
---
On September 10, we will have a primary election here in Rhode Island.
---
On November 5, we will have the most consequential election of our lifetime.
---
I’ve seen first-hand from my travels to battleground states like New Hampshire, North Carolina, and Georgia, as well as right here at home in Rhode Island, that we’re unified in the defense of our freedoms, expansion of economic opportunity, and having a secure future.
---
---
With your support, Vice President Kamala Harris and Governor Tim Walz can ensure we defeat Donald Trump this November and elect Democrats up and down the ballot. I’m working hard to support the battleground state effort, help take back the U.S. House of Representatives, and ensure big victories at home.
---

# Why Fentanyl is the Center of Dr Garcia’s Campaign
---
| The people of Washington are certainly facing many problems that need solutions: Rising crime, a weak economy and high cost of living, the cost and availability of healthcare, and more.
But there’s one issue that poses such a threat to the lives of our children, our loved ones and our communities that it demands our immediate attention and action: It’s the threat posed by the proliferation of the deadly drug fentanyl.
---
|
---
|
### _Keep Reading to Learn More about Dr Garcia’s Plan of Action for the Fentanyl Crisis. But First...._
---
|
# We Need Your Help to Spread Dr Garcia’s Message About Fentanyl, and Win this Election!
---
| The fentanyl crisis is a concern to the vast majority of Washingtonians. And when Dr Garcia is able to connect on this issue with voters, whether Democrat, Republican or independent, he earns their vote.
But we need your help to make sure his message gets to as many voters as possible. And for that to happen, [we need your financial support](https://garciaforwa.us9.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fe0c756dc01af594bb0bab517&id=20551da0cd&e=3ed3552a03).
If you believe we need a U.S. Senator who will actually work for the people of Washington on problems and crises like fentanyl, [please donate to our campaign](https://garciaforwa.us9.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fe0c756dc01af594bb0bab517&id=30e8225f32&e=3ed3552a03)!
[Your contribution of $5, $10, $25, $50, $75, $100 — or whatever you can give — will make a difference as we get closer to the November election](https://garciaforwa.us9.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fe0c756dc01af594bb0bab517&id=df94498e60&e=3ed3552a03).
Sen. Cantwell has had more than two decades to be a champion for all Washingtonians. And on too many counts, she has failed. It’s time for new leadership.
[Click here](https://garciaforwa.us9.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fe0c756dc01af594bb0bab517&id=71db28cf62&e=3ed3552a03) to donate, or click on the Donate button below. Thank you!
---
[DONATE](https://garciaforwa.us9.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fe0c756dc01af594bb0bab517&id=9d1bbabcb2&e=3ed3552a03)
|
---
|
---
|
# The Fentanyl Crisis is an Emergency
---
| “In my 26 years as an ER doctor, I’ve never seen a killer like fentanyl,” says Dr Garcia. He sees at least two fentanyl overdoses or poisonings per shift in the Emergency Room, and his own son nearly died of fentanyl addiction. Fentanyl poisoning, overdoses and addiction affects children, teens and adults everywhere in the state, no matter what their socioeconomic status.
Whether someone knowingly uses fentanyl or unknowingly ingests it while taking a pill or using another drug that’s been laced with fentanyl, their life is immediately at risk. Fentanyl is highly addictive. And when pills and other drugs are laced with fentanyl, it’s often at fatal levels.
This is an emergency that requires immediate, drastic action. Thousands of Washingtonians are dying every year from fentanyl. Washington had the nation’s fourth highest rise in drug overdose & poisoning deaths, mostly from fentanyl, from January 2023 to January 2024, and the third highest increase in teen (age 14-18) fentanyl deaths from 2020 to 2022.
In King County alone, in 2023 more than 1,067 people died from fentanyl poisonings and overdoses. That is a 47 percent increase from 2022 when 714 people died.
---
|
---
|
## Sen. Cantwell’s Inaction
---
| Sen. Maria Cantwell, the incumbent, hasn’t done nearly enough to combat the fentanyl crisis. She’s supported some bills and proposed another — but none of them come close to what we need to overcome the threat of fentanyl and save lives.
If elected to the U.S. Senate, Dr Garcia will introduce the Americans Against Fentanyl Act, which will target serious fentanyl dealers with mandatory felony charges and significant prison time, and help addicts by allowing and reprioritizing federal funding for involuntary treatment & recovery programs. Dr Garcia researched policies that have been effective elsewhere in combating both the drug trade and drug addiction, and also sought the input of advocates and former addicts.
---
| In these video shorts, Dr Garcia gives a quick overview of the fentanyl crisis, and his proposed solution, The Americans Against Fentanyl Act:
