We're just a few weeks into back-to-school... and the shootings are back, too. Yesterday, two students and two teachers were murdered in a mass shooting at Apalachee High School in Georgia. The shooter used an 'AR-15-style rifle.' During my time in the Army, I ran willingly into gunfire and had friends of mine killed by assault weapons on the battlefield. No one should experience that in American schools. It doesn't have to be like this. **Assault weapons belong in battle, not our schools.** **Kevlar belongs in combat gear, not kids' backpacks.** **Our schools, streets, movie theaters, and houses of worship should not be battlefields.** **We do NOT have to live in a country where the #1 cause of death for kids is gun violence.** It makes me all the more disgusted by Brian Fitzpatrick's actions to single-handedly block commonsense gun legislation last year. Serving in combat? That takes courage. Voting "yes" for universal background checks and an assault weapons ban? Easy. As Sandy Hook survivor Emma Ehrens told ABC News this summer, "People that have the power to make change should do it – instead of 17, 18 year olds trying to do their work for them." It's really that simple. And it's why I'm determined to defeat Brian Fitzpatrick in November and be the fighter for policy and change that every single one of us deserves from our elected leaders. Thanks for being in this fight with me as my co-pilot, Ashley 🚁
---

| Press Release FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE
September 5, 2024

**PARROTT CAMPAIGN SURGING AHEAD**

### Washington County – The Gonzales Research and Media Services released poll results today that shows that Delegate Neil Parrott has now taken the lead in his race for Congress with 41% of the vote to April Delaney’s 39%.
###
### The poll also shows that Parrott has significantly higher name ID than his opponent. Parrott has 66% name ID, but the majority of people in the district do not recognize Delaney’s name.

Perhaps the biggest takeaway, however, is that this neutral new poll improves upon an internal poll that the Parrott campaign conducted 3 weeks prior to the Gonzales Poll. The internal poll showed a statistical tie, but this new poll shifts momentum in the other direction, showing Parrott ahead by 2 percentage points.

The momentum is clearly with the Parrott campaign coming out of a summer filled with local campaign events talking with voters in Garrett, Allegany, Washington, Frederick, and Montgomery Counties.

Parrott indicated, “I am very thankful for the support we are receiving. As a small business owner who lives right in the center of District 6, I understand the struggles of my friends and neighbors in a way that someone who lives in a DC suburb cannot.”

April Delaney must drive over 20 minutes to reach the District that she wants to represent. Her home in the DC suburbs, and her recent job working for the Biden Administration, surrounds her with people who are not facing the same economic difficulties as most people in Maryland’s District 6.

While Neil Parrott plans to vote for Parrott for Congress in November, April Delaney lives in Maryland’s District 8 and is planning to vote for her Congressman, Jamie Raskin, who is well known as an extremely radical, left-leaning Congressmen.

Maryland’s Congressional District 6 includes all of Garrett, Allegany, Washington and Frederick Counties as well as the northern portion of Montgomery County. Parrott has connections within the district having represented Washington County in the Maryland House of Delegates from 2011 to 2023. He also solved problems in Garrett, Allegany, Washington, and Frederick Counties while working for State Highway Administration from 1999-2006.
Thank you for reading! For our Country,

Friends,
After an exciting Labor Day weekend with Team Schultz and sending my boys back to school, I’m now in countdown mode as we move toward election day. We’ve talked to you about this before, but we’re preparing to launch our first ads of the campaign.
We’re planning to share my positive vision for our community, hold Pete Stauber accountable for his failure to represent us, and discuss issues that we know voters care about the most.
But we’re facing a budget gap to be able to launch these ads. We need to be on the airwaves before early voting starts in a few weeks. Can you rush a donation to help us close this budget gap? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/schultz-september-2024?refcode=20240905]

I don’t mean to sound alarmist, but this is crunch time.
The unfortunate reality is that winning campaigns takes serious resources. We have a lot of momentum – but we’re not seeing the same flow of resources into our campaign as you see in the headlines around the country.
We’re going to win this race because ordinary folks like you believe we can win. We’ve been building our campaign in a grassroots way, but now it’s time to shift into high gear so we can “Unseat Pete” for good.
Help us launch our ads and get on the air across the 8th district by rushing a donation so we can close our budget gap today! → [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/schultz-september-2024?refcode=20240905]
Thanks for being a part of this team!

Friend, **Yesterday, Caroline was at the Utah Supreme Court, standing with youth climate activists who were fighting for their right to a safe and healthy future.** Two years ago, seven young Utahns from across our state filed a constitutional lawsuit fighting for climate justice and breathable air called _Natalie R. v. State of Utah_. In this lawsuit, they argue that the anti-climate actions taken by our state violate their state constitutional right to life. _**We've seen the science, and we know where inaction on the climate can take us.**_ [**Friend, before we continue, can you chip in to help elect a driven climate advocate to the U.S. Senate? >>**](https://cg4ut.us/l/6mxU5AyiLAga)
---
| [ ](https://cg4ut.us/l/VEQ6RjS7qVM3)
---
As a longtime climate activist, Caroline organized to protect Bear's Ears and the Great Salt Lake, she testified before Congress urging them to act on the climate crisis, and she worked on bipartisan environmental policy with Ted Wilson, environmental advisor to Utah Governor Gary Herbert. Our opponent, John Curtis, on the other hand, voted to **_increase fossil fuel production on public land_** and founded the Conservative Climate Caucus, whose members (including John himself) have **_raked in hundreds of thousands in campaign contributions from the oil and gas industry_**. He has also **_voted to protect polluters_** numerous times! **Actions speak louder than words, Friend.**
[**Caroline knows that this issue affects every Utahn and that taking action now is how we will protect the next generation and our future. Will you please chip in what you can to help elect a true advocate for our climate to the U.S. Senate?**](https://cg4ut.us/l/VGmoTq70wa4A)

clean_body: Should politicians pick their voters? | Hi Peter, We’re reaching out to our community with a question on an issue that more people should be talking about — and we know you can help spread the word (maybe by asking this very question!) Should politicians be able to choose their voters? = Everyone’s in a whirlwind this election season, but our heads are screwed on straight. We’re focused on electing fair maps champions, defending the gains we’ve made on redistricting reform, and building the path to a truly representative democracy so that voters pick their leaders. But we know not enough Americans are thinking and talking about gerrymandering and fair maps. That’s why we’re asking you to take a minute to answer the question above. Building and shifting power takes long-term planning and a committed team ready to respond to attacks on our democracy as they come up — and we’re grateful to work alongside you in these crucial 61 days before the election. Thank you in advance, —Team NDRC | = = Since 2017, the NDRC has executed a comprehensive redistricting strategy that shifts the redistricting power, creating fair districts where Democrats can compete. Our victories have been made possible by our strong community of grassroots supporters. = If you want to receive periodic updates from the NDRC on our fight for fair maps, text MAPS to 36787. Text HELP for help, STOP to end. Msg & Data rates may apply. We know we send a lot of emails, but we think it's important to keep you updated with the latest information on Republican gerrymandering and voter suppression and how we're fighting back -- regardless of whether you choose to donate. = to make a donation. Peter,
The extremists’ strategy to keep Missouri’s near total and complete abortion ban in place even if a majority of voters decide to overturn it in November is starting to come into view.
Polls show that a majority of voters support repealing Missouri’s near total abortion ban that makes no exceptions for incest or rape—so the GOP extremists in power are preparing a legislative end-run in the event that Amendment 3 is approved by voters in November.
No matter what happens with Amendment 3, anti-choice extremists have pledged that they will pass a law which would provide the same legal rights and protections for embryos and fetuses as a person who has been born. It’s their “fetal personhood” law and its ramifications are widespread and terrifying. This move would classify every abortion at any point after conception, for almost any reason, as murder—and would effectively outlaw in vitro fertilization (IVF).

Friend,
I want to share a story about someone who, more than anyone, taught me the importance of listening and accountability.

It’s Barack Obama.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/92237849/496453116/952921772?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk2978-bu-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDQvMS84ODk1OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwODVmZGM0ZS1jNjZiLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=EOLsVfMZFE9pScj8Nbqw-005XqoMvxajyZ7GnwIXZso=)
I was in the White House the first day he took office in 2009, serving as a part of his national security staff. I staffed his meetings in the Situation Room and briefed him in the Oval Office. Later, I was honored to be nominated by him to serve in the Pentagon.
Despite his effortless charm in public, President Obama was a very tough boss. I don’t think I’ve ever had a tougher boss than him. He’s brilliant, and he’s got a lawyer’s training where he’ll grill you with difficult questions, one after another.
I learned pretty quickly to be prepared, because he was going to make sure you knew your stuff.
What’s more, he was going to hold you accountable to what you said. If you told him a fact or a plan, you’d better deliver on it. If you didn’t know something, you should say that and not try to fudge your way through it. That’s exactly the approach I try to take in Congress. I try my best to know the details, make thoughtful decisions, and be transparent about what I know and don’t know. Because I’ll never forget the lesson President Obama taught me: You better say what you mean, and mean what you say.
**[That’s the kind of senator I’ll be. And I’m building a grassroots movement in that same spirit to bring accountability to the U.S. Senate. With that in mind, will you chip in $5 to Jeanne Shaheen's campaign and my own to help us get there?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/92237851/496453118/952921772?refcode=jtk2978-bu-text&amounts=5,25,50,100,250&&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDQvMS84ODk1OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwODVmZGM0ZS1jNjZiLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=EOLsVfMZFE9pScj8Nbqw-005XqoMvxajyZ7GnwIXZso=)**

name: Tim Sheehy
subject: “wayyyyy too close for comfort!”
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY TIM SHEEHY FOR MONTANA
body:
Democrat smearster James Carville is ATTACKING my campaign and sending out desperate email pleas for Jon Tester. |
---

**
** **_James Carville Smeared My Name for Jon Tester_** __

Fellow American,

Lifelong political hack and Democrat smear artist James Carville had A LOT to say about me in a recent fundraising email:

_He called me a**“snake” and warned readers that I couldn’t be trusted.**_

**He must have seen the poll showing Jon Tester and me neck and neck in the Senate race that will determine the Senate majority. **

He even went so far as to say that my campaign left him _**“F*@%ING TERRIFIED.”**_

[**PUSH BACK ON CARVILLE'S LIES**](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=a54a6c24e4cf4ba2bc2bf8a232b26e8f&_e=j2DwWYMv5OQHRwhFsWIHN8whpareEWfZo1IC5a6UxFtP9Z5q0bcVemfihchFQoBORG-kPb69TRxELws9hIf7SfcejNeVODorD0g6gJZPtO1OD0GqHY9XFG1AgS-V2wWnz7KOz_xGEqVRoRqMpjt9Dgau5lquy6A1dKIM8tOw0qeSiE42wwIyUaWhf1BhQf6FH5CMxcnTgrZv_pYSA7nRtxg9g13EkrIAiHrsQXU7yMtQsg0yR1r9aznADn6qrZDg4ZynmiyQFpaIVrwP9tMasjf05QN9tK1KbACVexFyUsL3wU1g_vJGQCZqBYimCsHh-MDiiTrYSJvphY7DyVSyozfANQtGLn95JsK1I2qDkdSaNZDydGpwBq1cCGrLvfk99bjk6m1j14rLy7ErBK24nva9Pp0TI56UvqiN_oCx6hU%3D)
_**“His slimy attacks against Jon are working, and now the polls are tightening. This race is wayyyyy too close for comfort!”**_

I’ve never met James Carville; I know very little about him beyond that he likes to hear himself talk. But he’s a recognizable figure on the left, and using his name in an email surely raised my opponent some serious cash.

We’ve been playing catch-up since day one, and that likely will not change. But our poll numbers have changed. With less than 70 days until election day, this race is WAY too close to call.

We can’t leave anything to chance with the Senate majority at stake. **[Could you see yourself contributing $2 or even $4 right now to help us begin preparing for the final weeks of this campaign?](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=a54a6c24e4cf4ba2bc2bf8a232b26e8f&_e=j2DwWYMv5OQHRwhFsWIHN8whpareEWfZo1IC5a6UxFtP9Z5q0bcVemfihchFQoBORG-kPb69TRxELws9hIf7SfcejNeVODorD0g6gJZPtO1OD0GqHY9XFG1AgS-V2wWnz7KOz_xGEqVRoRqMpjt9Dgau5lquy6A1dKIM8tOw0qeSiE42wwIyUaWhf1BhQf6FH5CMxcnTgrZv_pYSA7nRtxg9g13EkrIAiHrsQXU7yMtQsg0yR1r9aznADn6qrZDguYq_qk1kjMCOFWTN8Wi0tcBVjld1a2FHojC5Dm4wtAkMlbpeN7qdE-gQslAnUugOi00ND-pMVRvkzm5_Gi0xPBQEGzoik3mMT-J7VE_QX3AijhQzp1OKWHmQu2xr4_QOwcaZnvvRu_-aejlxoViq0dAfvOZ0cM7R6srKVf9kCOo%3D)**

[**PUSH BACK ON CARVILLE'S LIES**](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=a54a6c24e4cf4ba2bc2bf8a232b26e8f&_e=j2DwWYMv5OQHRwhFsWIHN8whpareEWfZo1IC5a6UxFtP9Z5q0bcVemfihchFQoBORG-kPb69TRxELws9hIf7SfcejNeVODorD0g6gJZPtO1OD0GqHY9XFG1AgS-V2wWnz7KOz_xGEqVRoRqMpjt9Dgau5lquy6A1dKIM8tOw0qeSiE42wwIyUaWhf1BhQf6FH5CMxcnTgrZv_pYSA7nRtxg9g13EkrIAiHrsQXU7yMtQsg0yR1r9aznADn6qrZDgxyAAsRswlJYOyu4Nl8daya3O2Bvz1LfM2ahdAzDHrhPn9HGyeJkqDmf6AhofAAcI2hokzqH99hhfWhRbdD43_kUaxwtS7o2P3j7yc3y4BQAwfDwuM1zGQZIMY6DUnq-dxLYPquArJxjVdFgxWfrpx-sl81LxnEBprT9ka5phQi8%3D)
Jon Tester’s DC allies are trying to carpet-bomb Montana with their out-of-state money and outrageous lies about me, my family, and my character.

It is outrageous.

I want this article to serve as a reference point for people looking to quickly debunk propaganda from the NRA and gun lobby. We live in an America in which gun violence since 1968 [has killed more Americans](https://substack.com/redirect/dbb6f4b4-1948-4730-9c6e-5718578b7ce9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) than all Americans killed in all wars in American history -- combined. It does not have to be this way.
Yet this week four more innocent people are dead in a Georgia high school, including two children, because a 14-year-old got easy access to a firearm and committed [the 385th mass shooting of 2024](https://substack.com/redirect/d9031ba6-bb9c-4d0a-a6d7-c14ac2715c5b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). _That's 1 mass shooting every 16 hours_. The facts are that no good reasons exist to block gun safety laws, and those who continue to obstruct reform are complicit in the mass gun violence we suffer in America.
**Let 's Address This.**
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/2c80cb38-c96c-4478-85b3-8ad60e460d85?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

## Myth 1: This isn't the right time to talk about it
In fact, the right time was much earlier -- like after Uvalde, Parkland, Buffalo, or Aurora, Las Vegas, Orlando, or Sandy Hook, or Oak Creek, or El Paso, or Sutherland Springs, or Tree of Life, or Columbine -- hopefully you get the point.
Americans are suffering a mass shooting every 16 hours. So if you think it's too soon to talk about gun safety legislation after this particular mass shooting, then go ahead and assume we're talking about the one that happened more than 16 hours ago, that you were also silent on. Either way, stop standing in the way of gun safety legislation while innocent Americans are killed by preventible gun violence.
## Myth 2: Gun laws don't work because criminals don't obey laws
Every single study every done proves gun laws effectively reduce gun violence, homicides, and suicides. For example, [a Harvard University School of Public Health study found that](https://substack.com/redirect/24b88291-0787-428f-9288-f579d020332d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg):
> States with more key firearm laws had fewer firearm homicides and fewer firearm suicides, after controlling for poverty, unemployment, education, race and non-firearm violence-related deaths.
Another study by Third Way, a think tank that studies gun violence, found that red states that have lax gun laws have a 40% higher murder rate than do blue states that have stronger gun safety laws. They [report](https://substack.com/redirect/84b13f5a-69c7-4307-bcd3-3062986ee00d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg):
> Murder rates in the 25 states Trump carried in 2020 are 40% higher overall than in the states Biden won. (The report used 2020 data because 2021 data is not yet fully available.) The five states with the highest per capita murder rate -- Mississippi, Louisiana, Kentucky, Alabama and Missouri -- all lean Republican and voted for Trump.
Likewise, per the CDC, 16 of the top 17 states with the highest gun death rate are GOP states who refuse to enact gun safety laws (and instead repeal the weak laws already on the books), and 11 of the top 12 states with the lowest gun death rate are Democrat states who pass comprehensive gun safety legislation. Gun laws work.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/84b13f5a-69c7-4307-bcd3-3062986ee00d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
## Myth 3: People who obtain firearms legally do not commit mass shootings
Let this simple graphic debunk this myth once and for all. A system that allows such would be terrorists to acquire weapons of mass murder so easily is a broken and unjust system. Those who refuse to act to reform this system are knowingly complicit.

Friend, Cutting off water, power, and other essential services is a form of violence—from Detroit to Palestine. Last week in my district, about 400,000 residents went without power as temperatures reached 95 degrees. **Instead of spending their resources on maintaining or upgrading infrastructure for climate resilience, Detroit-based utility company DTE is spending hundreds of thousands each year on private jet flights for shareholders and executives.** DTE is one of the most expensive _and_ most unreliable utilities in the country, and now they’re trying to raise rates yet again. For families who can’t afford skyrocketing prices for gas and electricity, the for-profit utility company cruelly disconnects these life-sustaining services**.** People then face the risk of eviction and homelessness. Adding insult to injury, DTE even sells residential customers’ debt to a predatory debt collection firm. This kind of exploitation is happening across the country. So I’m leading efforts in Congress to guarantee our right to affordable and reliable utility services nationwide. [**Please sign to demand Congress urgently pass legislation to stop utility companies from shutting off essential public services like water and power. Basic human needs should not be treated as commodities for profit.**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm38Rl0EAMX48IJgQ7iCSWsbbgxbNu6bAMTnPu_wg1Ccc_RB_ZANY4MfzQY5MHok47Ee4ghR_qs_Z50cvhwrtnNAv9uQ-ccwxmJ4SLOnUFSBLG8mC8tTCnt7RAq8Fya4k98gIcxrG20UxAsT6ZRKz8kDxn7McZvgKSbvh3UOEPLyEJ_Br_R_5TbcbT7UihwM5w63GazR4ExWpTbD4Joyy3JOKTZPZ2GR1ZsETJ7b8J7ty7ajTW4IMkGi7nNWI7qjR-YI8lDKQJ7u0zKzrE5BpCmuj8xylC-oiEm8BEoo7MEQm55vfBM4Ly9cPuCjFZfHqOIxtDPDGkDVsnK1A5SEk-v4iDXBVanxbb7q3brVy4t-HifpeLyhcG-RP_HNL3tJ0CPVzN34QqyLqpLnGNwZZz6hsJzwoyWvtd2j95fddlOBjLQ/49i/X_Hs42ALQDq7Cp0jm6LT7w/h1/h001.knwDUGG8VvugzoKkJBXfpAm4S9pEcod1MwSjpmqOa98) | [SIGN ON](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm38Rl0EAMX48IJgQ7iCSWsbbgxbNu6bAMTnPu_wg1Ccc_RB_ZANY4MfzQY5MHok47Ee4ghR_qs_Z50cvhwrtnNAv9uQ-ccwxmJ4SLOnUFSBLG8mC8tTCnt7RAq8Fya4k98gIcxrG20UxAsT6ZRKz8kDx_b4WzlfUcW9kSO6NQ-XE7vVTIa3av89n2HFF73e-jOEGRhkFevq5cyfHvVeyUeHr2urgPImNWtlkr87TXLKCl_V1A-if1yT_EY88f5AyGBGtjiLn8a2qHWFAIqlTjSe1R0LtF_XDDJw19t17PHE5V0dkOGpmp1--rcZ2mHkE3IZdFklHv8mtWpc1h6q5Z-q1npGsV_5mR3Ea68oWgJ101E2bjLDpGVN5Bb0NwjfBHAJTqlHOPCl1ZLYnWdQgW7XGQGmZOkKQSUFda-D1wVzf9g/49i/X_Hs42ALQDq7Cp0jm6LT7w/h2/h001.tP0hIj4PgjbxsArROHq56TxFlHQdVZbicgHfxOg8Dwc)

Vulnerable communities are disproportionately harmed by power outages and water shutoffs, including elderly and disabled people who rely on electric medical equipment and refrigerated medication. Communities of color and low-wealth communities also spend a greater portion of their income on ever-increasing utility bills. In my hometown of Detroit, the median energy burden for Black households is 54% higher than white households.
As extreme weather events increase with climate change, we need to build resilient power systems that work for everyone. It’s time to change the conversation around what we all deserve, take the profit motive out of providing the basics of a good life, and give every resident the opportunity to thrive.
That’s why I’ve introduced the **_Resolution Recognizing the Human Rights to Utilities_** , which asserts that affordable and reliable utilities are a human right, and demands an end to utility shutoffs and the cancellation of household utility debt. It recognizes access to water, sanitation, electricity, heating, cooling, public transit, and broadband communications as basic human rights and public services.
I also introduced the **_Maintaining Access to Essential Services Act_** _,_ which would stop utility shutoffs, restore disconnected service, end sales of household utility debt to debt collectors, and eliminate household debt for essential utility services like power and water.
[**Please sign if you agree: Congress must pass bills like the**** _Resolution Recognizing the Human Rights to Utilities_****and the**** _Maintaining Access to Essential Services Act_****to stop deadly utility shutoffs, eliminate household debt for essential utility services, restore disconnected utility services, and assert that affordable and reliable utilities are a human right.**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm38Rl0EAMX48IJgQ7iCSWsbbgxbNu6bAMTnPu_wg1Ccc_RB_ZANY4MfzQY5MHok47Ee4ghR_qs_Z50cvhwrtnNAv9uQ-ccwxmJ4SLOnUFSBLG8mC8tTCnt7RAq8Fya4k98gIcxrG20UxAsT6ZRKz8kDxaUFcs2PQWxueXkENwxdSuwuWo_SNN3uXNMkZ9nSruqU_Edgw_a6GIGu7L1jVGCyYo1fCKtPg60EfOx7QLEZxftGIR-zrsNQRYELcKq5FNRBUsBEseneQimG2o2sa_DHLmOBIGxAQQsUFoJjxDCYzAS_BbCGabkPj1UqlwVwWeh3FaT8QcHE9GIaVL2o-OSYJM6xmA-EB3J8bqHKACFlL-LWIf14c43Yzm54prBAgih434LaNyba-ujW3v4zvEqd_im1m06ElZ64niYk9FCTW7g/49i/X_Hs42ALQDq7Cp0jm6LT7w/h3/h001.VGzYfca-pDchv3sWsJ_TXxiDY4oOo_tsFs3ktKvA6g0)
Thank you for demanding action. We’ve made some progress so far, but there’s so much more to do to ensure that everyone can survive and thrive.
For example, I passed legislation through the House of Representatives to stop water and power shutoffs during the pandemic, require reconnection of services, and aid families suffering due to limited water access. But it didn’t pass through the Senate.
I also secured more than $1.1 billion in federal funding to assist low-income households who need support in paying off their water bills and paying for fees to reconnect their water service. I promise you I won’t stop fighting for our rights In Congress.
Together, we’ll continue working to save lives at home and abroad. The push to value all life and respect human rights is connected across borders, from the United States to Palestine and beyond.
In solidarity,
Rashida

clean_body: Utilities like water and electricity are human rights that should be accessible to everyone. | | | Friend, Cutting off water, power, and other essential services is a form of violence—from Detroit to Palestine. Last week in my district, about 400,000 residents went without power as temperatures reached 95 degrees. Instead of spending their resources on maintaining or upgrading infrastructure for climate resilience, Detroit-based utility company DTE is spending hundreds of thousands each year on private jet flights for shareholders and executives. DTE is one of the most expensive and most unreliable utilities in the country, and now they’re trying to raise rates yet again. For families who can’t afford skyrocketing prices for gas and electricity, the for-profit utility company cruelly disconnects these life-sustaining services. People then face the risk of eviction and homelessness. Adding insult to injury, DTE even sells residential customers’ debt to a predatory debt collection firm. This kind of exploitation is happening across the country. So I’m leading efforts in Congress to guarantee our right to affordable and reliable utility services nationwide. | Vulnerable communities are disproportionately harmed by power outages and water shutoffs, including elderly and disabled people who rely on electric medical equipment and refrigerated medication. Communities of color and low-wealth communities also spend a greater portion of their income on ever-increasing utility bills. In my hometown of Detroit, the median energy burden for Black households is 54% higher than white households. As extreme weather events increase with climate change, we need to build resilient power systems that work for everyone. It’s time to change the conversation around what we all deserve, take the profit motive out of providing the basics of a good life, and give every resident the opportunity to thrive. That’s why I’ve introduced the Resolution Recognizing the Human Rights to Utilities , which asserts that affordable and reliable utilities are a human right, and demands an end to utility shutoffs and the cancellation of household utility debt. It recognizes access to water, sanitation, electricity, heating, cooling, public transit, and broadband communications as basic human rights and public services. I also introduced the Maintaining Access to Essential Services Act , which would stop utility shutoffs, restore disconnected service, end sales of household utility debt to debt collectors, and eliminate household debt for essential utility services like power and water. Thank you for demanding action. We’ve made some progress so far, but there’s so much more to do to ensure that everyone can survive and thrive. For example, I passed legislation through the House of Representatives to stop water and power shutoffs during the pandemic, require reconnection of services, and aid families suffering due to limited water access. But it didn’t pass through the Senate. I also secured more than $1.1 billion in federal funding to assist low-income households who need support in paying off their water bills and paying for fees to reconnect their water service. I promise you I won’t stop fighting for our rights In Congress. Together, we’ll continue working to save lives at home and abroad. The push to value all life and respect human rights is connected across borders, from the United States to Palestine and beyond. In solidarity, Rashida Rashida Tlaib for Congress PO Box 32777 Detroit, MI 48232 | Paid for by Rashida Tlaib for Congress | | Sent via . Hey friend,
We all know that prices are too high.
**Kamala has set the goal of her presidency on building up the middle class, making groceries more affordable, and cracking down on price gouging. **
**Donald is siding with corporations over American families, focused on giving them tax cuts and cutting deals with CEOs who swear allegiance to him. **

| **Meet Kevin Lincoln
**
My name is Kevin Lincoln, and my story, is the Valley’s story. I am a 3rd generation Stocktonian, raising a 4th generation in the city I love. I’m the grandson of Mexican immigrants, and my stepfather is an Army veteran.

Like many Stocktonians, my family has overcome economic setbacks. My own father struggled to survive on these streets, and was at one time, homeless. But I never let adversity define me. I joined the Marines and served in the White House Military Office, assigned to Marine One. I graduated college while working full-time and raising a family. I’ve worked in corporate America and served our community as a pastor, and as a non-profit leader.

I’m blessed with a beautiful wife, Bonnie, and two amazing children. I’ve lived a life of service, but the greatest honor of my life has been giving back to my community, through serving as Mayor of my hometown, Stockton.

Here’s a key excerpt: "Call it Democrats’ blue state dilemma, one that has helped make New York and California, two coastal bastions far from the presidential battlegrounds, the unlikely heart of the fight for control of the House of Representatives as summer turns to fall." = = = = = = The New York Times article even goes further to highlight some key races and regions that are up for grabs in this election: "In California, Republicans are defending four incumbents in highly competitive seats that stretch from the Central Valley to Palm Springs, including three in districts where Democrats outnumber Republicans by wide margins. Democrats are protecting just one, an Orange County seat vacated by Representative Katie Porter." The takeaway? We are in a GREAT position to retake control of the U.S. House with just seats we have here in California — and those seats are just INCHES away from being in our grasp. The only thing that could go wrong now is losing the momentum, energy, and funding that is necessary to keep fueling and growing our mobilization and GOTV programs. = = Thank you! \- CADEM | | = Our Democratic leaders are working hard to make California a better place to live. From fighting for good-paying jobs, combating climate change, to expanding healthcare access so all Californians can lead safe, healthy, prosperous lives — California’s Democratic leaders turn progressive ideas into meaningful action. | | I want to take a moment to share the successes of the Movement Labs and Contest Every Race teams with you. They took this summer as a challenge, and they did not disappoint. Their hard work – and your support – means we'll have a big advantage heading into the busy fall election season, flipping precincts and districts where it'll make the biggest impact. **We're ready to help put Kamala and Tim in the White House and good, progressive candidates in office to back them up.** Here's what we've done to put power back in the hands of the people:
* **Recruited nearly 3,325 ****prospective candidates** , including 93 candidates to run against far-right election deniers in battleground states
* **Completed over 17,889 ****volunteer shifts** knocking doors, making calls, and more, in counties that felt left behind
* **And funded 350 red, rural, or purple counties** across 29 states to support local Democratic activism, infrastructure, and voter turnout

Since Harris and Walz joined the ticket, new battlegrounds are popping up in unexpected places – and we buckled down to organize them and take advantage of as many as possible. From progressive zoning reform to housing density regulations to investments in transit, each candidate we can recruit and each voter we can contact is changing the face of our country for the better. I hope you've had a wonderful summer and that you're fired up and ready to go through November 5th! _Sarah_ Sarah Long

subject: No more thoughts and prayers

body:
This is not okay.
# [](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/852?refcode=em20240905-1&t=1&akid=1145%2E587540%2ECCrpkx)
**Back to school season shouldn’t be the start of school shooting season.**
Yesterday, we saw yet another school shooting. This time at a high school in Georgia. Two students and two teachers have lost their lives, with 30 others injured.
This is madness.
Gun violence continues to tear this country apart. Events like this have become the norm and have scarred our future generation – the effects of which we have only begun to see.
No other developed country has anywhere near the level of gun violence that we have in this country. It’s fucking unacceptable that we act like there’s nothing we can do about it. We deserve leaders who will act decisively to protect innocent lives in this country – because when they don't, children die.
Gun violence is the leading cause of death for young people in this country. It’s the main issue that Gen-Z takes to the ballots and that they protest for. My classmates and I called for decisive action to end gun violence after the Parkland shooting six years ago. While we have since passed the first national gun control legislation in decades, clearly, there is so much more that needs to be done to protect innocent children in this nation.
**Parents should not send their children to school scared that they will not return alive. It doesn’t have to be this way.** We need to end this epidemic of gun violence that runs rampant in our country.
**[Today, will you join me in sending your support to the children and families of Apalachee High School in Georgia through this verified GoFundMe that benefits the people and families affected directly?](https://www.gofundme.com/c/act/georgia-high-school-shooting-relief?source=em20240905-1)**
The time for thoughts and prayers has been over for years. It’s time we actually protect our children through meaningful policies and actual reform.
**David Hogg**
Leaders We Deserve

Friend,

I want to tell you why I’m inspired by Jennifer Atlas, a single mother, passionate advocate for public education, and candidate for Nevada State Senate.

But first, I need your help. Jennifer faces a tight race against incumbent senator and MAGA extremist Carrie Buck in a district evenly split between registered Democrats and Republicans. This is a huge opportunity to win a veto-proof majority in Nevada, but we all need to step up and help.

Can you rush a contribution to Jennifer’s campaign right now? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jennifer-atlas-split?refcode=20240905]

Jennifer understands the importance of quality, affordable healthcare. Her son, Beau, was placed in an induced coma and spent three weeks in the NICU when he was born. Once Jennifer and Beau made it home, Jennifer faced nearly $500,000 in medical debt. What she didn’t know — and so many Nevada families don’t know — is that any newborn requiring NICU care automatically qualifies for Medicaid. Parents simply need to enroll them, even if they already have insurance.

https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jennifer-atlas-split?refcode=20240905 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jennifer-atlas-split?refcode=20240905]

If elected, Jennifer’s first order of business will be to pass legislation that will automatically enroll infants requiring NICU care into Medicaid, shifting the system from opt-in to opt-out. This simple yet powerful change will allow parents to focus on what truly matters—the health of their newborns—without the stress of medical debt.

As a single mom, Jennifer understands the challenges families face. That is why she will always put Nevada’s interests ahead of special interests. She will champion quality public schools, access to reproductive care, and a healthy environment.

https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jennifer-atlas-split?refcode=20240905 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jennifer-atlas-split?refcode=20240905]

Jennifer is in a tough race against incumbent senator and MAGA extremist Carrie Buck, who has failed to pass a single piece of legislation in her four years in the Senate. Buck is an educator who voted against funding public schools and universal school lunches and against protections for reproductive healthcare.

Electing Jennifer would be a game-changer for Nevada. Flipping this seat will give the Democrats a legislative majority to override Republican Governor Lombardo, who has vetoed a record 75 bills, including universal school lunches and common-sense gun safety.

Jennifer is the kind of leader Nevada needs to improve the lives of working families. But first, we need to help her defeat Carrie Buck this November.

Will you rush a donation today to show Jennifer we have her back? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jennifer-atlas-split?refcode=20240905]

DONATE [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jennifer-atlas-split?refcode=20240905]

Thank you for your support, your activism, and everything you do.

In solidarity,
Ro

| | Caroleene Dobson is a distinguished attorney, wife, mother, District Two resident, and a lifelong advocate for conservative values. Born and raised in Beatrice, Alabama, Dobson grew up on her family's fifth-generation cattle farm, where she learned the meaning of hard work and developed a firsthand understanding of the challenges faced by hardworking families and entrepreneurs. Currently practicing real estate law at the Maynard Nexsen law firm, Dobson represents a diverse clientele, including homebuilders, retailers, small business owners, and private landowners. She has spent her career advocating for her client’s interests while also achieving tangible, positive outcomes. In Congress, she will hold true to her core conservative values while ensuring Washington D.C. is working for the people of District Two. A passionate advocate for families, farms, and faith, Dobson aims to preserve the bedrock values and moral backbone that have defined our nation. With a call for Alabama common sense, she is determined to challenge the far-left agenda in Washington, D.C., advocating for the rights of property owners and defending the freedom to think, speak, and act without interference. Caroleene, alongside her husband Bobby, is the proud parent of two daughters, Philippa and Lydia. Her decision to run for Congress is deeply rooted in a desire to secure a future for her children and to champion the principles that have made America the land of the free.

1. I'm proud to have served as a foreign policy advisor in the Senate, where I helped write landmark sanctions against Vladimir Putin and comprehensive immigration reform.

During my time in the Biden-Harris White House, we created a Reproductive Rights Task Force to defend abortion access across the country, and in Congress, I will continue to fight like hell to protect our reproductive freedom!

3. I've dedicated my career to standing up to bullies with too much power and fighting to lower health care, housing, and grocery costs for hard-working families to secure a fair deal for ALL Granite Staters.

subject: Who Bobby wants you to vote for

body:
No matter what state you live in, I urge you to vote for Donald Trump.

[](https://www.kennedy24.com/donate-em2?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=clarity_9_5_24_all_1&n=4)
---
|
---
Dear Peter,
A lot of people are asking me, if they live in a red state or a blue state, should they still vote for me? What about swing states?
The answer is easy. No matter what state you live in, I urge you to vote for Donald Trump. The reason is that is the only way we can get me and everything I stand for into Washington DC and fulfill the mission that motivated my campaign.
A lot is at stake. The health of our children, the integrity of our government agencies, even the survival of our species as the Democrats push us closer and closer to World War Three. But let me tell you one more reason why it is imperative we get Donald Trump into the White House.
Right now, free speech is under withering and relentless attack in America and across the globe, but we still have enough of it that you can at least read this email or follow me on X. We can still run an opposition political campaign.
Well in a lot of countries you can’t do that, because the state controls the media. The state censors the internet. Brazil just banned Twitter because Elon Musk refused to censor user speech. Kamala Harris says Musk better behave himself or he will “lose his privileges.”
She thinks — and the Democratic establishment thinks — free speech is a privilege. Well I think it is a right. And if Kamala Harris is elected, the powers behind her will quash that right. They are already halfway there. It will be too late by 2028. Once we are in the grips of totalitarianism, we won’t be able to vote our way out of it. This is our last chance to stop them.
After long conversations with President Trump and his team, I know that he is fully convinced of this priority. He sees the censorship machine for what it is. Remember, he was kicked off Twitter back in 2021\. And he has experienced directly how government agencies are being weaponized to destroy political opponents. He is going to be relying on me to help clean up that corruption, and that’s why I’m relying on my supporters to help him return to the White House.
As you know, this could be a very close election. A disputed election result would be a disaster for our divided nation. President Trump needs to win in a landslide both in the Electoral College and the popular vote. He can’t do it unless my supporters join him and look at the big picture. We have to unify if we are to overthrow the entrenched elites who are ruining our country.
**Here’s what that means for you:**
* **In every state,** if you support me and my vision of a government united around common goals, I encourage you to vote for President Trump.
* This isn’t about splitting votes or sending mixed signals. It’s about creating a united front that will carry us through these turbulent times and restore integrity to our government.

I am fully committed to this path. Any confusion or division at this stage could undermine the very progress we’ve fought for. And this means I need your financial support now more than ever.
---
[](https://www.kennedy24.com/donate-em2?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=clarity_9_5_24_all_1&n=5)
---
Our message and our priorities are resonating as never before. They are entering the very DNA of the MAGA movement and transforming the conversation about our country’s direction.
We need your support so we can continue generating powerful video content, ads, and interviews to raise the issues of **health, free speech, peace, and honest government** on a national scale.
Also, since the Biden-Harris Administration withdrew Secret Service protection immediately after I endorsed President Trump, I need your financial support to pay for critically necessary private security so that I can safely speak at events around the country.
Thank you for standing strong with me for the future of America.
| |
---
---
Sincerely,
Robert F. Kennedy, Jr.

Team,
Here’s some potentially shocking news: there are less than two months until Election Day.
That might sound like plenty of time, but when you’re in a tossup race where every vote matters, you have to make every day count. Now that it’s election season, undecided voters will start to tune in, and it’s critical that Democrats running for swing seats have the resources to reach them.
A lot of polls are coming back showing really encouraging numbers for the presidential race and key Senate seats.
But polls like these don’t mean our work is done — they mean we need to work twice as hard to keep our momentum up.
Polling is very unreliable, especially in presidential elections, especially two months before the election. Vice President Kamala Harris being ahead by one or two points in a poll right now means that the race for the White House is a tossup at best.
Michael has won some tough races. He knows that this two-month period before the election is the most critical for reaching undecided voters and mobilizing supporters.
That’s why he’s working hard to support Democrats in some of the most competitive races in the country — including those here at home in Colorado like Yadira Caraveo. I've never been too concerned with appearances, friend. That's why I've gained a bit of a reputation for my rumpled hair and wrinkled suits. If it wasn't for my wife, Connie, I'd probably still be wearing these shoes (I swear, I'd _just_ perfectly worn them in).

**I've spent my career fighting for the Dignity of Work and the good folks of Ohio, because I believe that when you love this country, you fight for the people who make it work.**

But my self-funding, MAGA opponent can't say the same. From banning abortion nationwide to cutting Social Security and Medicare (while giving a handout to his megadonors), he’s backing terrible pieces of Trump and Vance’s Project 2025.
**We can't let someone like that anywhere near the Senate. So in this final stretch, I'm asking you to lace up with me and get in this fight.**

#
Peter — in just a minute we’re going to ask you to join us in calling on the Army to release the Arlington National Cemetery incident report.
Please, let us explain why this is so important.
Trump violated federal law when he held a campaign event at Arlington National Cemetery. That, on its own, is disqualifying.
But this is about more than just Arlington. It’s about more than how Trump thinks Veterans and the fallen are “suckers” and “losers” — though we know for a fact that he does.
**Trump broke the law because he thinks he is above the law.**
The Supreme Court gave Trump immunity for “official acts” as president. His legal team argued that he could order Seal Team Six to conduct political assassinations. He’s had the sentencing for his 34 felonies delayed, seemingly indefinitely. He hasn’t faced any consequences for the insurrection on January 6th.
And his agenda — Project 2025 — fundamentally alters the United States Military and the federal government to ensure that he never answers to the law again.
If we continue to let Trump off the hook he will continue pushing. He can’t get away with this, and we’ll be damned if we’re going to let him. It is far, far past time for accountability.
To start, that means that we need the Army to release the Arlington National Cemetery incident report.
It’s time to make some noise. Are you with us?

Today we are just two months away from Election Day, and only 46 days away from the voter registration deadline. As Pennsylvanians grapple with the escalating impacts of climate change—from record-breaking heatwaves to devastating floods—voters are being confronted with a critical choice this November. Will they support leaders who prioritize the health of our environment and communities, or will they allow a future of worsening environmental crises to take hold? On August 29th we partnered with Climate Power to host a press conference for environmental justice at Temple University in Philadelphia. Pennsylvania State Representative Danilo Burgos, Philadelphia Councilwoman Dr. Nina Ahmad, and Delaware County Council Chair Dr. Monica Taylor, joined us and shared their insights on what elected officials should and will be doing to protect our environment and how that directly translates to our well-being. Additionally, Molly Parzen, Executive Director of Conservation Voters of Pennsylvania, and Flora Cardoni, Deputy Director of PennEnvironment mentioned how voters can help protect critical federal investments that safeguard the environment and how they are working to implement these laws in ways that put our communities first.

| | **“This had been the most difficult and challenging presidential election I‘ve ever worked in terms of trying to do voter registration,” said Kadida Kenner** , CEO of the New Pennsylvania Project and the New Pennsylvania Project Education Fund, both non-partisan voting advocacy groups.

“Usually you don’t have enough time. You don’t have enough clipboards. This time we couldn’t get folks to register. They were disengaged. Apathetic. They were disgusted and had no interest. clean_body: | | | | | Today we are just two months away from Election Day, and only 46 days away from the voter registration deadline. As Pennsylvanians grapple with the escalating impacts of climate change—from record-breaking heatwaves to devastating floods—voters are being confronted with a critical choice this November. Will they support leaders who prioritize the health of our environment and communities, or will they allow a future of worsening environmental crises to take hold? On August 29th we partnered with Climate Power to host a press conference for environmental justice at Temple University in Philadelphia. Pennsylvania State Representative Danilo Burgos, Philadelphia Councilwoman Dr. Nina Ahmad, and Delaware County Council Chair Dr. Monica Taylor, joined us and shared their insights on what elected officials should and will be doing to protect our environment and how that directly translates to our well-being. Additionally, Molly Parzen, Executive Director of Conservation Voters of Pennsylvania, and Flora Cardoni, Deputy Director of PennEnvironment mentioned how voters can help protect critical federal investments that safeguard the environment and how they are working to implement these laws in ways that put our communities first. | | | | | The voters of Pennsylvania won on August 30th. The New Pennsylvania Project is elated by the correct ruling of the Commonwealth Court in the suit brought by the affiliated organization the New PA Project Education Fund and many other partners. No voter should be disenfranchised due to an inconsequential misdated or incorrectly dated ballot. Ensuring our voices are heard at the ballot box is what matters. | | | | | All eyes are on the cohort of Gen Z voters, who like Ryan J. Klein (left) of the Penn State College Republicans and Baybars Charkas of the College Democrats, are poised to tip the outcome of the 2024 election. Image Source: Joe Hermitt | jhermitt@pennlive.com | | “This had been the most difficult and challenging presidential election I‘ve ever worked in terms of trying to do voter registration,” said Kadida Kenner , CEO of the New Pennsylvania Project and the New Pennsylvania Project Education Fund, both non-partisan voting advocacy groups. “Usually you don’t have enough time. You don’t have enough clipboards. This time we couldn’t get folks to register. They were disengaged. Apathetic. They were disgusted and had no interest. After July 21, it was a whole new switch.”Overnight, voter registration saw week-over-week increases as high as 64%. The majority of new voters registered by Kenner’s organizations are under 35.” | | | | | Image Source: Show Up Strong / The Keystone "Kadida Kenner has also seen an attitude shift in the voter climate. Kenner is CEO of the New Pennsylvania Project, an organization focused on getting people registered to vote, particularly those in minority communities and the younger generation. She said many of the people her organization spoke to prior to Harris announcing her candidacy were disgusted and disheartened by the options on the November ballot." "That isn’t the case anymore."“Our voter registration numbers have improved every week,” Kenner said. “Many want to take advantage of this historical opportunity. I think that is what has been the driving force, definitely on college campuses. This is a historical opportunity to vote for someone who represents the changing demographics.” | | | | | | | | Rural Progressive Summit II Saturday, September 7, 2024 Registration begins at 8:30 AM General Session Begins at 9:00 AM Gemmell Student CenterPennWest Clarion 840 Wood St, Clarion, PA 16214 The one-day, non-partisan event will bring together people from rural parts of the region who care about the future of our nation. Kadida Kenner will host a panel titled: Expand Democracy by Expanding the Electorate | | | Expand the Electorate Tuesday, September 10, 2024 7:30PMCampana Chapel217 N Campus Rd, Greensburg, PA 15601 CEO Kadida Kenner will kicking off the political and civic engagement series at the University of Pittsburgh at Greensburg. She will be discussing all things around expanding democracy by expanding the electorate. Following will be a presidential debate watch party! | | | New Pennsylvania Project & Climate Power Press Conference Tuesday, September 17, 2024 2:00PM The Soldiers and Sailors Monument Allentown, PA 18101 New Pennsylvania Project and Climate Power will host a press conference with elected officials to talk about how Pennsylvania is facing increasingly severe weather due to climate change and what elected officials can and should be doing to protect our future. Communities of color disproportionately bear the weight of extreme weather. | | | Opening the Prison Cage: Unerasing Women Behind Bars Thursday, September 19, 2024 5:30PM-8:30PM Parkway Central Library 1901 Vine St, Philadelphia, PA 19103 The evening will begin with a screening of the film "Kemba," which tells the harrowing yet inspiring story of Kemba Smith's journey from a college student to a federal prisoner, and her eventual pardon. The screening will be followed by a talk-back with Kemba Smith and Kadida Kenner. | | | | | NPP ON THE GROUND Raffle Fun and Back-to-School | | | Back-to-school season is going strong! Have you spotted us at any of your local events? We always have swag and some goodies up our sleeves. (We might as well have some fun while we're registering to vote, right?) On the left is one of our NPP members handing off a raffle win to a registered voter! | | You might also catch us at different cultural events, registering voters! Here we are at the Caribbean Festival in Easton, PA last week! | | | | RECENT EVENTS | | | | Press Conference in Philly On August 29th, our team hosted a press conference on Temple University's campus in Philadelphia that focused on the intersection between environmental justice and the upcoming elections. | | | | | | “A three-judge panel of the Pennsylvania Commonwealth Court ruled on September 5th, that Butler County had no legal basis to disqualify the provisional ballots of two mail voters who forgot to include the secrecy envelope with their ballot return packets in the 2024 primary election. In a 2-1 decision, the court ordered the county to count the provisional ballots of Faith Genser and Frank Matis, the two county voters who brought a lawsuit against the Butler County board of elections after the board refused to count their provisional ballots.” “In a 4-1 ruling, the Pennsylvania Commonwealth Court blocked enforcement of a law requiring election officials to reject otherwise valid mail-in ballots with missing or incorrect handwritten dates on their outer return envelopes.” “The Pennsylvania Supreme Court issued an order Tuesday that will expedite the appeals processes for 2024 election cases in commonwealth courts ahead of November... Under the Pennsylvania Supreme Court’s recent order, which takes effect on Thursday, parties will only have a three-day appeal period, which will include weekends and holidays.” “Three legal disputes over mail ballots in Pennsylvania are in line for possible rulings from statewide appellate courts ahead of November’s election. That could mean late-in-the-game changes to the rules that govern vote counting in a crucial swing state.” “The state Supreme Court often has the final say on major policy decisions that affect virtually every Pennsylvanian, from no-excuse mail voting to the commonwealth’s congressional map. However, the seven justices have few hard deadlines and can take years to render their opinions on critical issues.” “The Pennsylvania Commonwealth Court last Friday a lawsuit from two Republican legislators seeking to upend state laws governing where voters must return their completed absentee ballots to be tallied.” | “As Election Day 2024 approaches, election officials say there are not enough poll workers, though the situation isn’t as dire as it was in 2020. “This is not a one-year problem; this is an ongoing problem, and, in many cases, this is because lots of poll workers have been doing it for many years, and so it’s an older group of folks,” said Philip Hensley-Robin, the executive director of Common Cause Pennsylvania, a nonpartisan government watchdog group that runs a to educate and protect voters.” “The process of counting every vote in Pennsylvania takes days, and sometimes weeks — not hours. Relax, it just means democracy is working properly. It’s not a sign of voter fraud. It’s 11 p.m. on election night. TV pundits are breathlessly trying to make sense of early voting returns from Pennsylvania, a crucial battleground state in the presidential election with 19 electoral votes. Your text thread is blowing up, with everyone wondering why the final results from Pennsylvania haven’t been announced.” “On Nov. 5, Pennsylvanians will vote for president, U.S. House and Senate, state row offices (attorney general, auditor general, and treasurer), and the legislature. While many voters will head to their local polling place on Election Day, others will opt to vote by mail instead. All registered voters in the commonwealth have been able to vote by mail since 2020.” "Since these changes happen bit by bit over time at the local level, you could easily have missed them—but the big picture of how much things have changed since 2020, especially in some key swing states, is pretty troubling. Republican-controlled statehouses have created new barriers to voting and eliminated many of the COVID-era concessions that made voting easier. And in an election year when Vice President Kamala Harris and Donald Trump seem to be neck and neck, even a small blip in turnout because of these new laws could have a significant impact in states like North Carolina, Georgia, Arizona, and Michigan—exactly where some of the country’s most restrictive voting laws are being passed." “We're not talking about a few dollars,” said State Rep. Elizabeth Fiedler. “We're talking about millions of dollars over the life” of the panels. Coming to a school near you: solar panels on roofs.” “Vice President Kamala Harris has been the official Democratic nominee for president for less than a month, but her presence is already changing the dynamic in critical races down the ballot. On July 26, Pennsylvania’s Republican candidate for U.S. Senate, Dave McCormick, visited a fracking rig in Warren County. One reason for his trip? To link Harris with his opponent in the race, Democratic Sen. Bob Casey.” “Federal authorities in Philadelphia have seized more than 30 internet domains believed to be part of a wide-ranging, Russian-backed disinformation campaign aimed at influencing the outcome of the U.S. presidential election, Justice Department officials announced Wednesday.” “Pennsylvania drivers might begin seeing more billboards featuring ordinary people, like a white-haired, red-shirt wearing man named “Mike,” and a simple message: “I’m a former Trump voter. I’m a patriot. I’m voting for Harris.” The billboards are paid for by a group called Republican Voters Against Trump,.. On Tuesday, the group announced a new $11.5 million campaign...But the bulk of the spending, $4.5 million, will target Pennsylvania, which could end up being the decisive state in the 2024 election.” | | | | | | We're Hiring! The American Dream is alive, my friends.

Just look: [ ](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/49987?t=7&akid=21995%2E4449941%2EQo-hlt) This is a picture of my mom and my three sisters watching me speak at the DNC.

My immigrant mother raised the four of us on a secretary’s salary. I worked any job I could get to support the family. I slept on the floor, on the couch, on a roll-out mattress. I got into Harvard with no money, no connections. I fought in Iraq. And now, I’m running for the U.S. Senate in Arizona.

I believed it when I was a kid, and I believe it now: **Anything is possible in the United States of America.**

But there is no denying that the American Dream feels out of reach for far too many.

Kari Lake won’t fix that, and Trump won’t either. They’ll divide us further, cut taxes for their billionaire friends, and leave an economy that works for them — not working families, not the middle class.

It is up to us to keep the American Dream alive — to defend it, to strengthen it. And the best way we can do that right now is by defeating Trump and Kari Lake. name: Team AOC
subject: 1st day of school!
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
body:
#
Last month, we started distributing backpacks to kids and families who needed a little help affording school supplies this year. We had hoped to help as many families as we did last year — 1,115 — before the first day of school in NYC. We even gave out backpacks at two community events last night!
**Today 2,700 kids are starting off the year with a new backpack and supplies** — and it’s all thanks to the astronomical support of this grassroots movement.
[](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20240905.8dMWEE&refcode=em20240905-7152-P_FND_CTR_GOL&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=7152%2E2526796%2E05znuf)
We teamed up with public housing leaders, community organizations, houses of worship, food pantries and local elected officials to **give thousands of kids a strong start to the school year** with pencils, pens, crayons, erasers, notebooks, rulers, and a backpack.
We know you’re here because you support a different kind of elected leader: one building power for working communities, rooted in collective action, and fighting for a brighter future for all — and **there’s more work to do**.
[Alexandria doesn’t take any money from corporate lobbyists or Wall Street so that she works only for the everyday people that support her. Will you make a $5 contribution to help us keep fighting for real change for working people across the country? ](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20240905.8dMWEE&refcode=em20240905-7152-P_FND_CTR_GOL&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=7152%2E2526796%2E05znuf)
**[Contribute $5](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20240905.8dMWEE&refcode=em20240905-7152-P_FND_CTR_GOL&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=21&akid=7152%2E2526796%2E05znuf)**
Happy Back-to-School Season!
In solidarity,
Team AOC
[](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20240905.8dMWEE&refcode=em20240905-7152-P_FND_CTR_GOL&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=22&akid=7152%2E2526796%2E05znuf)

name: Royce White
subject: I won’t just shut up and dribble.
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY ROYCE WHITE FOR SENATE
body:
Allow me to introduce myself to you |
---

Fellow American,

You may already know who I am from my basketball career. Or, maybe you’re just hearing about me for the first time through my Senate Campaign. Either way, I wanted to formally introduce myself and share my story. [**_Afterward, I’m going to ask you to send a small contribution to my campaign as I continue to fight to Flip the Senate Red._**](http://links.roycewhiteformn.com/u/click?_t=a6fdeb8217c04ac2942bbb6b1eb9eb59&_m=9eefe1aa3c1643a1bb768ebc148144a6&_e=Mq5N4_THR9nIKRlfCe6Lpzmuy3WBddtw5Xd7dHtdbtTP6_RfICvE22zwYPQeSviDRf_L3DMx9-zuxDWCCFlYEpyRW64led24P0VKftcIwswzAKDbC8KnRqAYvl44HFinidU9UqD1DcLWO-K6uZy8lUju_VEvQO_ShBX1yrxTJWCiTsk3fgOUMcyIdQoiDdHr5Do1XP66XWtS2LA9ZRW2msz3awqXb3VGOSKiRCGH5RPoPUJKToQuCu_etPb0pjt5mS7Elrh5yupMQFbA5E_JfCyxXbS1PJnbKWrUujklf1tb11ha_xcqHsZmcPXrpQeXwRByHt9ICTJR9fhCRd3PczenZZf5yM7najOppvwrxes%3D)

I was born and raised in the Twin Cities in Minnesota, mainly in the Rondo Community of St. Paul. At the age of five, I started playing sports, and at nine years old, I was already playing basketball on the Northside of Minneapolis. My mother was a single mother who worked tirelessly to give me a better life. I went to school in Rondo and began to excel at basketball. By 10th grade, I was ranked as a top 20 player in the country. I remember dreaming of reaching the NBA one day– a dream shared by millions of kids.

[](http://links.roycewhiteformn.com/u/click?_t=a6fdeb8217c04ac2942bbb6b1eb9eb59&_m=9eefe1aa3c1643a1bb768ebc148144a6&_e=Mq5N4_THR9nIKRlfCe6Lpzmuy3WBddtw5Xd7dHtdbtTP6_RfICvE22zwYPQeSviDRf_L3DMx9-zuxDWCCFlYEpyRW64led24P0VKftcIwswzAKDbC8KnRqAYvl44HFinidU9UqD1DcLWO-K6uZy8lUju_VEvQO_ShBX1yrxTJWCiTsk3fgOUMcyIdQoiDdHr8WR_-EWR_KRcxEpZajsuzBH1VM3x83CuG97eEhA7AwXGfC0UfmivMMFfAZcu8Kb6qJWJw8ZTD4dIZt5p485Q_VNVES8ruDVRFW5-QdIUZJAf3XAihCKOK1KBSP8i3LkBM413TKR6DMMl024ddZJY7e9I6bO1ibCMyPpxQh42L7M%3D)
I accepted a scholarship at the University of Minnesota, but shortly after transferred to Iowa State. There, I won multiple basketball awards while working hard in class and being named on the Dean’s List for academics.

[](http://links.roycewhiteformn.com/u/click?_t=a6fdeb8217c04ac2942bbb6b1eb9eb59&_m=9eefe1aa3c1643a1bb768ebc148144a6&_e=Mq5N4_THR9nIKRlfCe6Lpzmuy3WBddtw5Xd7dHtdbtTP6_RfICvE22zwYPQeSviDRf_L3DMx9-zuxDWCCFlYEpyRW64led24P0VKftcIwswzAKDbC8KnRqAYvl44HFinidU9UqD1DcLWO-K6uZy8lUju_VEvQO_ShBX1yrxTJWCiTsk3fgOUMcyIdQoiDdHrLpjaanDGSvCN8tD_tgMN9812Za1sLbIV2Ga8XUjE7SIR7feGEzB-DBci6lN-Yx8VxTMCHCdIrrlE69SgARZHlgzw2VsH9jWDx4ctVESvb_3QCFh8mkWvH3ErEbk_uAQwQZT1i_zxnzXFLGLQCVTRSHbZ1GKzZ2UepFJGlkndBjQ%3D)
Finally, my dream came true. I was selected in the first round of the 2012 NBA Draft, going to the Houston Rockets. While playing at the highest level of basketball competition in the world, I began to voice concerns about the NBA’s Collective Bargaining Agreement (CBA), specifically regarding mental health policy, which at the time did not exist.

Eventually, my concerns became a dispute between the NBA and myself, until I demanded that the NBA spearhead the mental health conversation through policy. This led to the end of my NBA career, but my work led to the NBA implementing policies to support players’ mental health.

[](http://links.roycewhiteformn.com/u/click?_t=a6fdeb8217c04ac2942bbb6b1eb9eb59&_m=9eefe1aa3c1643a1bb768ebc148144a6&_e=Mq5N4_THR9nIKRlfCe6Lpzmuy3WBddtw5Xd7dHtdbtTP6_RfICvE22zwYPQeSviDRf_L3DMx9-zuxDWCCFlYEpyRW64led24P0VKftcIwswzAKDbC8KnRqAYvl44HFinidU9UqD1DcLWO-K6uZy8lUju_VEvQO_ShBX1yrxTJWCiTsk3fgOUMcyIdQoiDdHrju4YEyqoX1WXUbfJwlk3mOmUfcdAkwsysE6ua5mtQNX4qH4yKY2bQs_ZkE4dP-cNfHF2sRwWocsw5ThykteRO5AA7wX5fXbKLlznxEws3T8OZ73dDtcR0ufc2PhER0Bf6IuhaTOAWEnTjmpb7C8cTkjpqRqhwwWDxf5mJ28i5aY%3D)
I gave up my dream of playing in the NBA to stand up for something I fully believe in. That experience gave me the courage to run for Congress in 2022 and for Senate in 2024. More on that later.

After leaving the NBA, I took my talents to Canada, playing professional basketball and winning two championships. Then, I joined the BIG 3 Basketball Tournament, a professional 3 on 3 league; I still play today.

[](http://links.roycewhiteformn.com/u/click?_t=a6fdeb8217c04ac2942bbb6b1eb9eb59&_m=9eefe1aa3c1643a1bb768ebc148144a6&_e=Mq5N4_THR9nIKRlfCe6Lpzmuy3WBddtw5Xd7dHtdbtTP6_RfICvE22zwYPQeSviDRf_L3DMx9-zuxDWCCFlYEpyRW64led24P0VKftcIwswzAKDbC8KnRqAYvl44HFinidU9UqD1DcLWO-K6uZy8lUju_VEvQO_ShBX1yrxTJWCiTsk3fgOUMcyIdQoiDdHr_DyFN4fJiskkp_PhMEcS91PLGRcFNuaBaWLYQZXSkXJo4VtI6cmuvtiRvedz4r8MVbMAvC046E4I7JpdUyY4jsmOYaCd05lUyl3JNAoEaEy-_oADpKpFjfcVwLngf6RX_IBxytxGo3uLkMXqXke_STTnpUkLzp8vaBsW9TCycv0%3D)
It was at this point that I became increasingly vocal about standing up for the core principles that I believe in. I’ve continued to be outspoken on taboo subjects, like freeing the Uyghurs, the Federal Reserve, Julian Assange, Edward Snowden, Muammar Gaddafi, and many others. **I’m not afraid to speak up and say the silent part out loud. I will never just shut up and dribble.**

In 2022, I decided to run for Congress against Radical Leftist and Squad Founder, Ilhan Omar. The Deep State Democrats lined her pocket with millions of dollars to beat me, and I came up short.

[](http://links.roycewhiteformn.com/u/click?_t=a6fdeb8217c04ac2942bbb6b1eb9eb59&_m=9eefe1aa3c1643a1bb768ebc148144a6&_e=Mq5N4_THR9nIKRlfCe6Lpzmuy3WBddtw5Xd7dHtdbtTP6_RfICvE22zwYPQeSviDRf_L3DMx9-zuxDWCCFlYEpyRW64led24P0VKftcIwswzAKDbC8KnRqAYvl44HFinidU9UqD1DcLWO-K6uZy8lUju_VEvQO_ShBX1yrxTJWCiTsk3fgOUMcyIdQoiDdHrnLbh-Ycvy1ovuhU6J7oUdZPn5PbcRlUemYR3UFb9aCUGPhLWzDlQhY2ZnjoWdLwtvYzep2ZGv9C_opiwjc4TX4w-we66Swuma-6Bljflz6N7oSzBbbpSS825Ngr_kaBiIS-F0FuPpw9ejEoTDkQWtcx1DwpmCoFE10hkNhRe-5o%3D)
Now, I’m running for United States Senate to defeat lifelong politician Amy Klobuchar. She represents the Radical Left’s Elites who would rather see America become the next Communist China or Soviet Russia. The Industrial Media Complex will continue to spread false narratives claiming that I have little chance of winning. But they continue to ignore my strong grassroots movement with the American People, who are sick and tired of being overstepped, ignored, and told to accept the policies that our Liberal Leaders force down our throats.

We CAN win, but it’s going to take the help of a huge grassroots movement. That’s why I’m emailing you today, friend. We have a chance to make history by electing the youngest US Senator and the first one born in the 1990s.

[**I am humbly asking you to send my campaign a small donation of whatever you can afford. Whether it’s $5, $15, or $25, every single donation makes a difference.**](http://links.roycewhiteformn.com/u/click?_t=a6fdeb8217c04ac2942bbb6b1eb9eb59&_m=9eefe1aa3c1643a1bb768ebc148144a6&_e=Mq5N4_THR9nIKRlfCe6Lpzmuy3WBddtw5Xd7dHtdbtTP6_RfICvE22zwYPQeSviDRf_L3DMx9-zuxDWCCFlYEpyRW64led24P0VKftcIwswzAKDbC8KnRqAYvl44HFinidU9UqD1DcLWO-K6uZy8lUju_VEvQO_ShBX1yrxTJWCiTsk3fgOUMcyIdQoiDdHrz_Kp2Aafvm6qmFztBOwnJ4JJDktE4sjRCj6b9nLFe7HxIlGmycD8tVnXrcCsl7SHIAJsZhF4HWGPeAzBjLnmFrVMJS1c-iCGfRgB_i0XYCH3XdA7xyg5fd0DCw_E-O3JLXPzQZibFzV6plgL2IDXelMoNx5d9yiwdB7Xbuh2Gf8%3D)

I’m looking forward to getting to know you better, and I hope you’ll join my team.

Talk Soon,

Royce White

| PAID FOR BY ROYCE WHITE FOR SENATE
P.O. Box 5473 Hopkins, MN 55343

---

Talk Soon, Royce White | PAID FOR BY ROYCE WHITE FOR SENATE P.O. Box 5473 Hopkins, MN 55343 Copyright (C) 2024 Royce White For Senate, All rights reserved.

Dear Peter,
The return to school season is a time for growth and development. However, attending school currently means living in constant fear of gun violence. Guns are the number one cause of death for children and teenagers in the United States. [https://secure.ngpvan.com/9z4TC7NYkkSa-5JQO7nKbQ2?am=20&contactdata=ZdfjfDS2ef33N1LgL8HnWd9F8c6tsmcGfQyUBHYqftda1Qh6KwfSoN8RzU1SelH3ZCj8+ium0Ji/WoVjCqi3IIr8U/fTAq7PfExjH5TStqhruPsfPE1Nt+TFTOTLKfu/K9pHsGlpUuKoNxcDSLIPDRUVAvsiir70yGw4lLD6r5M=]
On yesterday, tragedy struck the Winder, Georgia, school community. A fourteen-year-old gunman opened fire, leaving four people dead and at least nine injured. Just one month into the school year, four individuals who got up yesterday to go to work or school will never come home.
The people of Barrow County, like many others before them, have experienced trauma. All of the district's schools were placed on lockdown while Apalachee High School's law enforcement response was underway. All the teachers, parents, and students in the county were afraid for their own lives or the lives of their loved ones.
We can no longer watch helplessly as our kids become victims of gun violence. I want to become your next Congressman because I will advocate for sensible gun safety laws at all governmental levels. Please join me by chipping in $100, $250, $500 or anything you can give up to $3,300 [https://secure.ngpvan.com/9z4TC7NYkkSa-5JQO7nKbQ2?am=20&contactdata=ZdfjfDS2ef33N1LgL8HnWd9F8c6tsmcGfQyUBHYqftda1Qh6KwfSoN8RzU1SelH3ZCj8+ium0Ji/WoVjCqi3IIr8U/fTAq7PfExjH5TStqhruPsfPE1Nt+TFTOTLKfu/K9pHsGlpUuKoNxcDSLIPDRUVAvsiir70yGw4lLD6r5M=] to join our movement and demand that lawmakers act to safeguard our communities.
The families of the Apalachee community members whose lives were taken or irrevocably altered are in our thoughts and prayers. I am more determined than ever to bring about a society in which families can live normal lives without having to worry about gun violence. Stand with me and join the movement.
[https://secure.ngpvan.com/9z4TC7NYkkSa-5JQO7nKbQ2?am=50.00&contactdata=ZdfjfDS2ef33N1LgL8HnWd9F8c6tsmcGfQyUBHYqftda1Qh6KwfSoN8RzU1SelH3ZCj8+ium0Ji/WoVjCqi3IIr8U/fTAq7PfExjH5TStqhruPsfPE1Nt+TFTOTLKfu/K9pHsGlpUuKoNxcDSLIPDRUVAvsiir70yGw4lLD6r5M=]

Dear Fellow American,

Dr. Arnn asked us to reach out to you. Do you have five minutes to take our survey on the Electoral College? We would greatly value your input.

If so, here is a link to the survey:

**[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey/](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=1eafbc734a7342399f736e844b3f4ab8&_e=UDqko9jW-R6cLzargeNO-aaHdTsPM_suWGe3cAO0sBBddkkZ3lyvn54THCo8DCtpFcFz_WIk64ohRcaCPB9TFNFpIKW6B1mTCI-N9SI79Y-2fiLHKe3NxqOrUmv1uHIWB81ZF4IjkfkWT2MjTfZsvAwrjHxnjNhVnYp-tLXhY6FQZ2iX-ciuiGQ6vkk7e1h7yMSkhPLORi9ShUIXGvNJvwlO0-4XtV8xHces66StbuYi55MmRgiL90kfgcS9k5IuzKXyXptPIW3uMgFX_GS0MVZIuy7s9Sw1pt8a4FEsliWLDRmzXhT5zrT0gTFh0KQ9JV_KMcByFWtbGXLIn6UPgEnTt1dslzrNzled01EXZoVVczyBXnv37St8KXtcX8Dg1f9i4q5WEktvZerR9gppFUBXy1TRQ4dOCl2yLGXZ7XI%3D)

** Sincerely,

Hillsdale College**
** \---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: Larry P. Arnn
Subject: Survey on an urgent matter Friend, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation's future. A movement is growing, led by progressives--but supported by many well-meaning Americans--to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. That's why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue--views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. You can complete the **National Survey on Presidential Selection **by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=1eafbc734a7342399f736e844b3f4ab8&_e=UDqko9jW-R6cLzargeNO-aaHdTsPM_suWGe3cAO0sBBddkkZ3lyvn54THCo8DCtpFcFz_WIk64ohRcaCPB9TFNFpIKW6B1mTCI-N9SI79Y-2fiLHKe3NxqOrUmv1uHIWB81ZF4IjkfkWT2MjTfZsvAwrjHxnjNhVnYp-tLXhY6FQZ2iX-ciuiGQ6vkk7e1h7yMSkhPLORi9ShUIXGvNJvwlO0-4XtV8xHces66StbuYi55MmRgiL90kfgcS9k5Iu4u-Ced91w9xbhM8ZH2g468WOpghc3vgEHpk0kL1-eDYYAy8t3oUJ3rDA26FCoGqGj3rvb9bVo_yiDxybKULhhzpw3EgkjvRljECQuKIeyWyZ2KU2bMxjdP-HySV52Gaf0yud1oZqqlZ8UFN91LeFwJ3pB7RVtHL4Dd4TXwpU_cI%3D)** For most of our nation's history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government. **But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.** This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America's schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics--too many Americans simply don't understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty. Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching **millions** of Americans in all 50 states. These efforts, which aim to counter the Left's domination over most of our schools, include:
* **Teaching** millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as "Constitution 101" and "The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;"
* **Reaching** over six million households and businesses nationwide with _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale's free digest of liberty;
* **Promoting** constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;
* **Sending** millions of pocket-size copies of America's founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America; and
* **Restoring** excellence to K-12 education by helping establish and guiding classical K-12 schools nationwide and providing, free of charge, Hillsdale's American classical K-12 curriculum (including American civics) to thousands of American educators and homeschoolers.

Your answers to the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty--including the importance of the Electoral College. **And this is especially important in this critical time for America 's future.** So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our **National Survey on Presidential Selection** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. **You can take the survey using this secure link I've provided below:

**[**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey**](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=1eafbc734a7342399f736e844b3f4ab8&_e=UDqko9jW-R6cLzargeNO-aaHdTsPM_suWGe3cAO0sBBddkkZ3lyvn54THCo8DCtpFcFz_WIk64ohRcaCPB9TFNFpIKW6B1mTCI-N9SI79Y-2fiLHKe3NxqOrUmv1uHIWB81ZF4IjkfkWT2MjTfZsvAwrjHxnjNhVnYp-tLXhY6FQZ2iX-ciuiGQ6vkk7e1h7yMSkhPLORi9ShUIXGvNJvwlO0-4XtV8xHces66StbuYi55MmRgiL90kfgcS9k5IuJ8UZFmnKK4bjJo8uq-LIGq7cTNXvXxVXBq8xH5_8Pz98hpNDpWZJ7xJhIcaPdsQNNIydmQPY1urDf2zkBakZ90N3YkpOtrfHzG64xCi-75sEJYh3TJi1nurD_bLmw7TFqxqNu5iL4TQccsnL8lVRn5-K1SVrwAJX6-o48u-fWDc%3D)**
** And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift. Since 1844, Hillsdale has been "pursuing truth and defending liberty." Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work. Please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Presidential Selection today**. Thank you for your time and attention--and for your friendship and support of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844
---
