name: Justice Democrats
subject: Netanyahu is invading the West Bank and decimating Gaza with the help of the United States
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY JUSTICE DEMOCRATS
body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Peter, day after
day, we continue to witness a genocide against Palestinians unfold before
our eyes.

The Israeli government is not only keeping up its indiscriminate assault
on Gaza — leaving more than 40,000 people dead, including 14,000 children,
and damaging $18.5 billion of critical infrastructure — but it is also
breaking further international law by invading the West Bank, where
Israeli soldiers have used children as human shields and killed at least
39 Palestinians in less than 10 days.

It’s unconscionable.

As Justice Democrats’ Rep. Rashida Tlaib — the only Palestinian American
in Congress — pointed out:

“The Israeli government has launched the largest invasion of the West Bank
in decades—with fighter jets, drones, armored vehicles, and ground forces.
The goal has always been the ethnic cleansing of Palestine.”

While the Israeli military drastically escalates conflict in the West
Bank, in Gaza they’ve recently bombed another shelter for displaced
people, killed a young child rollerblading in a targeted airstrike, and
opened fire on a World Food Program aid vehicle.

None of this will end until Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu
agrees to a permanent ceasefire deal, which he has so far refused to do,
even against the protests of Israeli citizens and hostages’ family
members.

Though President Biden claims he is doing everything he can to push a
ceasefire deal through, his words remain hollow as long as the United
States continues to funnel billions of dollars in weapons and bombs to aid
Israel in carrying out its crimes against humanity.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/signup/20240905-embargo/?source=em20240905-35967&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1002&akid=35967%2E1203867%2Ev7DE87 ]This carnage will not end until a ceasefire deal is reached, and that
is unlikely to happen if our government remains complicit in arming
Israel’s far-right military. Enough is enough: sign our petition to demand
President Biden issue an arms embargo against Israel NOW!

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/signup/20240905-embargo/?source=em20240905-35967&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1003&akid=35967%2E1203867%2Ev7DE87 ]ADD YOUR NAME

It’s beyond time for the Democratic Party and our Democratic
administration in the White House to stand on the right side of history
and come out strongly in support of both a permanent ceasefire and an
immediate arms embargo.

In solidarity,

Justice Democrats

Kruttiventi Unveils Innovative Plan to Resolve Ukraine-Russia Conflict

View this email in your browser (https://mailchi.mp/vin4congress/running-for-you-i-need-your-support-9292911?e=2d6bc17fc5)

** Dear Peter,
------------------------------------------------------------

** Vin Kruttiventi Unveils Innovative Plan to Resolve Ukraine-Russia Conflict
------------------------------------------------------------

PLEASANTON, CA – In an innovative and visionary view, Vin Kruttiventi, Top 2 candidate for California's 14th Congressional District, unveiled his peace plan for ending the Russia-Ukraine conflict.

Kruttiventi’s comprehensive strategy aims to achieve lasting peace through impartial intervention, democratic governance, and international cooperation. "The conflict between Ukraine and Russia is not just a regional issue; it's a global security concern, as well as affecting the food security of millions of poor families worldwide. WE need immediate and coordinated international action for lasting peace," Kruttiventi stated.

Kruttiventi’s approach is built around seven key pillars:
1. Establishing a Non-NATO Peacekeeping Force: To ensure an impartial and secure resolution, Kruttiventi proposes deploying a peacekeeping force led by India, with contributions from countries like Vietnam, Japan, the Philippines, Nepal, and Mongolia. This force would oversee the ceasefire and secure Ukrainian territories while facilitating the withdrawal of Russian military forces, except for a managed area around Sevastopol. Additionally, Russian-backed separatist forces would disarm under a negotiated amnesty.
2. Autonomy and Fair Elections: Kruttiventi advocates for the safe return of displaced Ukrainians and the oversight of free and fair elections by neutral observers. Local elections in regions such as Crimea, Luhansk, and Donetsk would be held every two years, supervised by third-party observers from India, South Korea, Japan, Greece, and Brazil. Local police forces would undergo reforms to ensure they are appropriately sized and equipped with non-lethal weapons.
3. Referendums for Regional Status: To address the future status of contested regions, Kruttiventi proposes scheduled referendums for Crimea, Luhansk, and Donetsk between 2034 and 2036. These referendums would be overseen by delegations from Ukraine, Russia, the OECD, and international bodies, with specific thresholds determining the outcomes.
4. Reconstruction and Sanction Relief: Recognizing the need for recovery, Kruttiventi’s plan includes creating a reconstruction fund for Ukraine, supported by Russia, the EU, and the US. Sanctions on Russia would be eased in phases as the country meets sensible withdrawal and reform commitments.
5. Accountability for War Crimes: To ensure justice, a war crimes tribunal would be held in Simla, India, beginning 18 months after a ceasefire. This tribunal would focus on major war crimes, with findings published for transparency.
6. Supporting India’s Role: Kruttiventi emphasizes India would be the best option as the mediator because of her prior experience in global Peacekeeping AND her cordial and trusted relationship with both sides of this war. If India can successfully bring the two sides to achieve peace, The United States, our worldwide allies, as well as Russia, will work together to elevate India as the 6th permanent member on the UN Security Council.
7. Vision for Russia’s Future: Many of Russia’s neighbors have legitimate concerns about leaving Russia under strongman rule and would want Sanctions to stay. To alleviate such concerns, we may explore transitioning to a constitutional monarchy similar to the Netherlands and Spain. Sanction relief can also be linked to NATO and Russia resolving existing territorial issues such as Kosovo and Transnistria.

"The resolution of the Ukraine conflict requires a multifaceted approach that balances immediate security needs with long-term stability and democratic principles," said Kruttiventi. "My broad strokes plan is designed to address the core issues of sovereignty, security, and justice while promoting a fair and balanced resolution that respects the rights and aspirations of all involved. I welcome any improvements to this plan."

During a recent meet-and-greet session, Vin Kruttiventi engaged in an insightful conversation with a high school student named Weycene Yang. This discussion inspired Kruttiventi to document her ideas and share this innovative approach to resolving the ongoing conflict, highlighting his vision for a more peaceful and stable world.

As he continues his campaign, Vin Kruttiventi remains committed to finding thoughtful, strategic solutions to domestic and international challenges and to promoting world peace.

For more information on Vin Kruttiventi’s campaign and his vision for California’s 14th District, visit Vin 4 Congress (https://vin4congress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2fff3097fedb124f94ce5344d&id=b197614a56&e=2d6bc17fc5) .
